commentary: (VINa) pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā'ti sace pāto asammaṭṭhaṃ sammaṭṭham'pi vā puna tiṇapaṇṇ'ādīhi uklāpaṃ pādappahārehi ca vikiṇṇavālikaṃ jātaṃ, sammajjitabbaṃ.

example_1: kammasamayo nāma antamaso pariveṇam'pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: considered as; deemed to be; thought to be; said to be; regarded as; agreed to be
example_1: mokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.
example_2: sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

example_2: atthi pana, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito, ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti, yaṃ tumhe eta'r'ahi paṭipādeyyāthā'ti?

meaning_1: is calmed; is cooled; is appeased

example_2: accayo ce na vijjetha, no'c'idh'āpagataṃ siyā, verāni na ca sammeyyuṃ, ken'īdha kusalo siyā'ti.

example_1: taṃ puttapasusammattaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.

example_1: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

meaning_1: with fixed destiny in goodness; with inevitable results from rightness
example_1: micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā
commentary: (DNa) sammāsabhāve niyato sammattaniyato. catunnaṃ ariyamaggānam'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: path with an inevitable destination; fixed correct course; (comm) noble path
example_1: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

meaning_1: drowsiness after eating; languor after a meal
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, arati tandī vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) bhattasammado nāma bhattamucchā bhattapariḷāho.

example_1: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?
example_2: ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

grammar: ger of sammā ājānāti, comp vb
example_1: tesaṃ sampannasīlānaṃ, appamādavihārinaṃ, samma'd'aññā vimuttānaṃ, māro maggaṃ na vindati.
example_2: yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā, paravādesu na nīyare, te sambuddhā samma'd'aññā, caranti visame saman'ti.
commentary: (SNa) samma'd'aññā'ti sammā hetunā kāraṇena jānitvā.

meaning_1: supreme gnosis; perfect knowledge; complete understanding; full awakening
example_1: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti

grammar: ger of sammā ājānāti, comp vb
example_1: ārogyaṃ samma'd'aññāya, āsavānaṃ parikkhayā, saṅkhāya sevī dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ n'opeti vedagū'ti.
example_2: anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.

meaning_1: who is liberated by perfect understanding; who is freed through complete comprehension; epithet of an arahant
example_1: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
example_2: khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya, diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
commentary: (SNa) sammā kāraṇehi jānitvā vimuttā'ti samma'd'aññāvimuttā. maggapaññāya catusaccadhammaṃ ñatvā phalavimuttiyā vimuttā'ti attho.

example_1: sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā, imasmiṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.
commentary: (ANa) samma'd'atthaṃ abhisameccā'ti sammā sabhāg'atthaṃ ñāṇena abhisamāgantvā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti

acir'ūpasampanno kho pan'āyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
example_2: evaṃ vutte, upāli gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sādhu sādhu, bhante tapassī! yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma'd'eva satthusāsanaṃ ājānantena evam'evaṃ dīghatapassinā nigaṇṭhena bhagavato byākataṃ.

example_1: omaddantī'ti sammaddanti. na ca acchinne theve pakkamitun'ti yāva rajanabindu gaḷitaṃ na chijjati, tāva na aññatra gantabbaṃ.

manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni ca sammaddantā, ek'indriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā'ti!
sammaddasā vedaguno, samma'd'aññāya paṇḍitā, abhibhuyya mārasaṃyogaṃ, na gacchanti punabbhavan'ti.
example_2: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu niranusayo sammaddaso acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) sammaddaso'ti sabbāsaṃ vedanānaṃ catunnam'pi vā saccānaṃ aviparītadassāvī. (SNPa) sammaddasā'ti sammādassanā.

meaning_1: having scoured; having scrubbed together; having rubbed together
example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ. tam'enaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anupadajjuṃ. tam'enaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā sammadditvā acche udake vikkhāleti.
commentary: (SNa) sammadditvā'ti temetvā khādetvā.

example_1: bhūtapubbaṃ, assalāyana, sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu sammantānaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo
upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.
commentary: (VINa) sīmaṃ sammannatī'ti navaṃ sīmaṃ bandhati. kurundiyaṃ pana udak'ukkhepaparicchindane'pi dukkaṭaṃ vuttaṃ.

example_1: yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma, yo no sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, sammā garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya. mayaṃ pan'assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmā'ti.
commentary: (VISMa) sammanneyyāmā'ti samanujāneyyāma.

meaning_1: should be authorized; should be appointed; should be elected; should be chosen
example_1: sace sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, sabbena saṅghena oloketabbaṃ. no ce sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, ye tattha honti bhikkhū byattā paṭibalā sārambhaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanaṃ jānituṃ te yācitvā sammannitabbā.

meaning_1: to authorize; to appoint; to elect; to choose

yasmā ca saṅgahā ete, sammapekkhanti paṇḍitā, tasmā mahattaṃ papponti, pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te'ti.
commentary: (DNa) sammapekkhantī'ti sammā pekkhanti. (JAa) sammapekkhantī'ti sammā nayena kāraṇena pekkhanti.

meaning_1: knowing perfectly; clearly comprehending; perfectly understanding
example_1: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.

tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ
example_2: bhūtam'idan'ti, sāriputta, passasī'ti? bhūtam'idan'ti, bhante, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.

meaning_2: grasps, touches, knows thoroughly, meditates on
example_1: yato yato sammasati, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, labhatī pītipāmojjaṃ, amataṃ taṃ vijānataṃ.
example_2: bhagavā etadavoca, sammasatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, antaraṃ sammasan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sammasatha no'ti sammasatha nu.

example_1: kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.
commentary: (DNa) sammasaddo'ti kaṃsatāḷasaddo.

example_1: akammaṃ h'etaṃ, mahārāja, jinaputtānaṃ yadidaṃ pūjā, sammasanaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ, yoniso manasikāro, satipaṭṭhān'ānupassanā, ārammaṇasāraggāho, kilesayuddhaṃ, sadattham'anuyuñjanā, etaṃ jinaputtānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, avasesānaṃ devamanussānaṃ pūjā karaṇīyā.
kālena dhammassavanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, kālena sammasanā, kālena vipassanā
ahaṃ kho veḷugumbasmiṃ, bhutvāna madhupāyasaṃ, padakkhiṇaṃ sammasanto, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, sānuṃ paṭigamissāmi, vivekam'anubrūhayan'ti.
commentary: (THa) sammasanto khandhānaṃ udayabbayan'ti pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ udayabbayañ'ca vipassanto, yadi'pi idāni katakicco, phalasamāpattiṃ pana samāpajjituṃ vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapento'ti adhippāyo.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammasamāno sammasati antaraṃ sammasaṃ, yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ.

meaning_2: grasped, touched, knew thoroughly, meditated on
grasped, touched, known thoroughly, meditated on
example_1: jātijarāmaraṇavasena visuṃ sammasan'ābhāve'pi jāti-jarā-maraṇa-vantesu'y'eva pana sammasitesu tāni'pi sammasitāni hontī'ti pariyāyena tesam'pi vasena sammasanaṃ vuttan'ti veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: should be grasped; should be understood; should be known
example_1: kathaṃ nu kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā? kathaṃ saṅkhārā sammasitabbā? kathaṃ saṅkhārā vipassitabbā'ti?
commentary: (ANa) evaṃ kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā'ti-ādīsu, āvuso, saṅkhārā nāma aniccato daṭṭhabbā, aniccato sammasitabbā, aniccato passitabbā. tathā dukkhato, anattato'ti evaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_1: to grasp; to understand; to thoroughly know
having grasped; having understood; having thoroughly known
example_1: tvaṃ āvikarohi bhūmipāla, bhattā bhārasaho tuvaṃ vade taṃ, tava chandarucīni sammasitvā, atha vakkhanti jan'inda pañca dhīrā.

meaning_1: is properly digested; is thoroughly digested
example_1: na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
example_2: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.

example_1: yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.
example_2: na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
synonym: asesato, asesaṃ, ekantaṃ, kevalaṃ, paripūraṃ, sādhukaṃ

example_1: sa ve vidvā sa vedagū, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito, sammā so loke iriyāno, na pihet'īdha kassaci.
example_2: etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi. ayaṃ kho sā, āvuso, majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: correct livelihood; right mode of earning a living
example_1: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) sammā vodāpanalakkhaṇo sammāājīvo.

meaning_1: with correct livelihood; having right mode of earning a living
example_1: pare micchāājīvā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāājīvā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) sammā samuṭṭhāpanalakkhaṇo sammākamm'anto.

example_1: pare micchākamm'antā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammākamm'antā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: correct livelihood; maintaining one's life in the correct way
example_1: micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, etth'ete akusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti
sammāvāyāmassa sammāsati pahoti, sammāsatissa sammāsamādhi pahoti, sammāsamādhissa sammāñāṇaṃ pahoti, sammāñāṇassa sammāvimutti pahoti
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.
commentary: (MNa) viditakaraṇ'aṭṭhena sammāñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: with correct understanding; with right wisdom
example_1: pare micchāñāṇī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāñāṇī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
commentary: (MNa) sammāñāṇī'ti ettha pana ek'ūnavīsatibhedaṃ paccavekkhaṇāñāṇaṃ sammāñāṇan'ti vuccati, tena samannāgatā puggalā sammāñāṇī.

example_1: sammādassanaṃ pana, bhante, kim'atthiyan'ti? sammādassanaṃ kho, rādha, nibbid'atthaṃ. nibbidā pana, bhante, kim'atthiyā'ti?
example_2: anattato manasikaronto nimittañ'ca pavattañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, tena vuccati, sammādassanaṃ. evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe dhammā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti.
commentary: (PMa) tena vuccati sammādassanan'ti tena yathābhūtajānanena taṃ ñāṇaṃ sammādassanan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: right view; correct outlook; correct belief
example_1: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) tattha sammādassanalakkhaṇā sammādiṭṭhi.

meaning_1: having right view; with correct outlook; with correct belief
example_1: seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo akkhaṇavedhī, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti. sammādiṭṭhi, sāḷha, ariyasāvako idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
example_2: pare micchādiṭṭhī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammādiṭṭhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: who has correct belief; who has the right outlook
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso… anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
example_2: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā

meaning_1: undertaking actions based on correct beliefs
example_1: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā

meaning_1: because of undertaking actions based on right view
example_1: samaṇo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā sammādiṭṭhiko sammādiṭṭhikammasamādāno sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

meaning_1: dependent on right view; due to correct belief
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena sammādiṭṭhi hoti, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
commentary: (SNa) sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'ti etthā'pi sammādiṭṭhisampayuttā vedanā'pi vaṭṭati, sammādiṭṭhiṃ upanissayaṃ katvā uppannā kusal'ākusalavedanā'pi vipākavedanā'pi.

meaning_1: with right view running in front; with correct outlook leading the way
example_1: hirī tassa apālambo, saty'assa parivāraṇaṃ, dhamm'āhaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi, sammādiṭṭhipurejavaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sammādiṭṭhipurejavan'ti vipassanāsammādiṭṭhipurejavā assa pubbayāyikā'ti sammādiṭṭhipurejavo, taṃ sammādiṭṭhipurejavaṃ.

example_1: anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sammādiṭṭhisamādānā'ti gahitasammādassanā.

meaning_1: due to the subsiding of right view
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
commentary: (PMa) sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitan'ti sammādiṭṭhivūpasamo nāma micchādiṭṭhi, tasmā yaṃ micchādiṭṭhipaccayā vedayitaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'ti veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: complete wearing away of suffering; total extinction of stress
example_1: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti, uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.

meaning_1: leading to the complete wearing away of suffering; leading to the total extinction of stress
example_1: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti, uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
example_2: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ ayaṃ pañcamī upanisā bhāvanāya.

meaning_lit: gives a rain shower; offers a downpour
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
notes: (PED) seasonable shower

example_1: lābh'ālābhe sukhe dukkhe, sammāne c'āvamānane, sabbattha samako hutvā, patto sambodhim'uttamaṃ.
example_2: sammannatī'ti sammānaṃ karoti.
synonym: ādara, garu, garukāra, gārava, cittikāra, cittīkāra, purekkhāra, sakkāra
commentary: (APAa) lābhe ca tesaṃ alābhe ca kāyikacetasikasukhe c'eva tathā dukkhe ca sādarajanehi kate, sammāne c'eva omāne, ca sabbattha samako samānamānaso upekkhāpāramiṃ pūretvā uttamaṃ sambodhiṃ patto pāpuṇeyyan'ti attho.

example_1: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, sammānanāya anavamānanāya anaticariyāya issariyavossaggena alaṅ'kār'ānuppadānena.
commentary: (DNa) sammānanāyā'ti devamāte tissamāte'ti evaṃ sambhāvita-kathākathanena.

meaning_1: teaches well (wrt); instructs correctly (regarding); advises perfectly (about)
example_1: tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) te ve maccā paralok'atthāya sammā anusāsantī'ti vadati.

example_1: mātari ca pitari ca. imesu kho, bhikkhave, dvīsu sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavatī'ti.
gihissa v'āhaṃ, māṇava, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi. gihī vā hi, māṇava, pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

meaning_1: correct practice; going the right way; following the correct path
example_1: sussūsā paripucchā paññāya āhāro, anuyogo paccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ āhāro, sammāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ āhāro

meaning_1: correct course; right path of action; right way
example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho, sammāpaṭipadā. tasmā eso dhammo araṇo.
example_2: gihino v'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipadaṃ vaṇṇemi. gihi vā, bhikkhave, pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

meaning_1: practising correctly; going the right way
meaning_2: rightly disposed, having the right view
example_1: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
example_2: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammāpaṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'ca anubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu pahit'attaṃ.

meaning_1: right resolve; proper aspiration; correct intention
example_1: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) sammāpaṇidhī'ti tassa attano sammā paṇidhānaṃ niyuñjanaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: having the right resolve; possessing the proper aspiration
example_1: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) sammāpaṇidhī'ti tassa attano sammā paṇidhānaṃ niyuñjanaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: well directed; correctly orientated; at a good angle
example_1: na taṃ mātā pitā kayirā, aññe vā'pi ca ñātakā, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, seyyaso naṃ tato kare.
example_2: ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo kalyāṇassa kammassa kiriyāya kalyāṇassa kammassa pavattiyā'ti?… sammāpaṇihitaṃ kho, mahāli, cittaṃ hetu, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ paccayo kalyāṇassa kammassa kiriyāya kalyāṇassa kammassa pavattiyā.

meaning_1: fact of being well directed; fact of being correctly orientated; fact of being at a good angle
example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? sammāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammāpaṇihitāya diṭṭhiyā sammāpaṇihitāya maggabhāvanāya avijjaṃ bhindati, vijjaṃ uppādeti, nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti?
ahañ'ca sīlasampanne, cirarattasamāhite, sammāpabbajite vande, brahmacariyaparāyane.

meaning_1: who correctly applies oneself; who engages in the right way

example_1: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.
commentary: (SNa) catūhi pariyaññehi yajitabbassa saddhiṃ bhūmiyā assamedhe vuttavibhavadakkhiṇassa yaññass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sammam'ettha pāsentī'ti sammāpāso.

meaning_1: due to proper attention; through right reflection
meaning_2: due to proper attention; through right reflection
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

meaning_1: correct intention; right volition; proper thought
example_1: sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) sammā abhiniropanalakkhaṇo sammāsaṅkappo.

meaning_1: with correct intention; having right volition; with proper thought
example_1: pare micchāsaṅkappā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsaṅkappā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: right mindfulness; perfect presence; correct awareness
example_1: iti'ss'ime tayo dhammā sammādiṭṭhiṃ anuparidhāvanti anuparivattanti, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati.
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) sammā upaṭṭhānalakkhaṇā sammāsati.

meaning_1: with correct present moment awareness; having perfect memory
example_1: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: with correct present moment awareness; having perfect memory
example_1: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: perfect stability of mind; correct meditative composure
example_1: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo sammāsamādhiṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (DNa) sammā samādhānalakkhaṇo sammāsamādhi.

meaning_1: having perfect stability of mind; with correct meditative composure
example_1: seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo dūrepātī, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammāsamādhi hoti. sammāsamādhi, sāḷha, ariyasāvako yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ… n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
example_2: pare micchāsamādhi bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsamādhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

meaning_1: dependent on perfect stability of mind
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

meaning_1: who has successfully achieved perfect stability of mind; with correct meditative composure
example_1: sīlavato, bhikkhave, sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ

meaning_lit: discourse on perfect stability of mind

meaning_1: who has failed in perfect stability of mind; without correct meditative composure
example_1: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, sīlavipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-vipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

meaning_1: due to the subsiding of correct meditative composure
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhivūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

meaning_1: perfectly awakened Buddha; fully enlightened being
example_1: tass'idaṃ, bhikkhave, manussattaṃ laddhaṃ, tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
example_2: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, yattha dukkhaṃ nirujjhatī'ti.

meaning_1: preached by the perfectly awakened Buddha; taught by the fully enlightened being
example_1: yamhā dhammaṃ vijāneyya, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, sakkaccaṃ taṃ namasseyya, aggihuttaṃ'va brāhmaṇo.
example_2: kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī, unnaḷā asamāhitā, na te dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite.

meaning_1: taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha
example_1: evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.

meaning_1: teaching and training taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha
teachings of the perfectly awakened Buddha; religion of a fully enlightened being
example_1: etañ'ce ruccati bhoto, sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ, mayam'pi pabbajissāma, varapaññassa santike.

meaning_1: disciple of the perfectly awakened Buddha; follower of the fully enlightened being
example_1: evaṃ saṅkārabhūtesu, andhabhūte puthujjane, atirocati paññāya, sammāsambuddhasāvako.
example_2: api dibbesu kāmesu, ratiṃ so n'ādhigacchati, taṇhakkhayarato hoti, sammāsambuddhasāvako.

meaning_1: wanting a bed; in need of a couch
meaning_2: who wants a bed; who is looking for a couch

commentary: (DNa) sayanasannidhimhi sayanan'ti mañco. ekassa bhikkhuno eko gabbhe, eko divāṭhāne'ti ukkaṃsato dve mañcā vaṭṭanti. tato uttari labhitvā aññassa bhikkhuno vā gaṇassa vā dātabbo, adātuṃ na vaṭṭati. sannidhi ca hoti, sallekhañ'ca kopeti.

commentary: (ANa) sayasaṃvutesū'ti sayam'eva saṃvaritvā piyāyitvā gahitagahaṇesu, diṭṭhigatikesū'ti attho. diṭṭhigatikā hi sayaṃ saṃvutā'ti vuccanti.

meaning_1: by one's own; oneself; one's own
example_1: atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ'ca lokaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti
example_2: sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.
notes: See SCPN §2

meaning_1: self-made; self constructed; self-created; done by oneself

example_2: tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca na paripūreti.

meaning_1: wanting (the heart of) monkhood; seeking (the essence of) asceticism

meaning_2: considered (the definition of) monkhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) ascetic life
example_1: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ime'pi kho, āvuso gotama, tapopakkamā etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmaññasaṅkhātā ca brahmaññasaṅkhātā ca.
commentary: (DNa) sāmaññasaṅkhātā'ti samaṇakammasaṅkhātā.

meaning_1: produced by ethical restraint; (comm) generated by the rest of ethical conduct
example_1: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni c'eva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca. aṭṭha kho, gāmaṇi, hetū, aṭṭha paccayā kulānaṃ upaghātāya.

meaning_1: suitable for monasticism; in conformity with asceticism
example_1: ye c'assa dhammā akkhātā, sāmaññass'ānulomikā, adhiggahitā tuṭṭhassa, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sāmaññass'ānulomikā'ti samaṇadhammassa anulomā. (ITIa) sāmaññass'ānulomikā'ti samaṇadhammassa samathavipassanābhāvanāya ariyamaggass'eva vā anucchavikā appicchat'ādayo.

commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) sāmaṇero nāma dasasikkhāpadiko.

commentary: (KVt) kammaṃ karonte ārāmike pesan'atthāya dātabbā sammuti ārāmikapesakasammuti. esa nayo sāmaṇerapesakasammutī'ti etthā'pi.

construction:

meaning_1: even oneself; just by oneself; even for oneself
example_1: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti. sāmam'pi kho etaṃ, sīvaka, veditabbaṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
commentary: (SNa) sāmam'pi kho etan'ti taṃ taṃ pittavikāraṃ disvā attanā'pi etaṃ veditabbaṃ.

example_1: chaṭṭham'pi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi. sattamam'pi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto sāmayikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
example_2: aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa, yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ, ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (SNa) sāmayikaṃ cetovimuttin'ti appit'appitakkhaṇe paccanīkadhammehi vimuccati, ārammaṇe ca adhimuccatī'ti lokiyasamāpatti sāmayikā cetovimutti nāma. (SNPa) sāmayikaṃ vimuttin'ti lokiyasamāpattiṃ. sā hi appit'appitasamaye eva paccanīkehi vimuccanato sāmayikā vimuttī'ti vuccati. taṃ sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ. aṭṭhānaṃ taṃ, na taṃ kāraṇaṃ vijjati saṅgaṇikāratassa, yena kāraṇena phassaye'ti etaṃ ādiccabandhussa paccekabuddhassa vaco nisamma saṅgaṇikāratiṃ pahāya yoniso paṭipajjanto adhigato'mhī'ti āha.

example_2: atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) sāman'ti sayaṃ.

example_1: so vat'ānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇik'ārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇ'ārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito sāmāyikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (MNa) sāmāyikan'ti appit'appitasamaye kilesehi vimuttaṃ.

meaning_1: name of a female lay disciple; foremost laywoman among those living in a state of friendliness
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ sāmāvatī.
commentary: (ANa) bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ, khujj'uttarā, mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ, sāmāvatī'ti bahussutānaṃ upāsikānaṃ khujj'uttarā, mettāvihārīnaṃ sāmāvatī aggā'ti dasseti. tā kira dve'pi padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā aparabhāge satthu dhammakathaṃ sossāmā'ti vihāraṃ agamaṃsu. tattha, khujj'uttarā, satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsikaṃ bahussutānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sāmāvatīpi ekaṃ upāsikaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. tāsaṃ dvinnam'pi yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā devaloke nibbattitvā devamanussesu saṃsarantīnaṃ'y'eva kappasatasahassaṃ atikkantaṃ.

example_1: candappabhāti sāmiatthe paccattaṃ, candappabhāyā'ti attho.

example_2: assāmikan'ti na añño koci sāmiko hoti, itthī vā puriso vā gahaṭṭho vā pabbajito vā.

example_2: seṭṭhi, sace me dhītā vijāyissati, tāya naṃ saddhiṃ nivesetvā seṭṭhiṭṭhānassa sāmikaṃ karissāmi. sace me putto vijāyissati, māressāmi nan'ti cintetvā taṃ gehe kāresi.

meaning_1: fleshly; carnal; physical; worldly; of the flesh
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, sāmisā sukhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā sukhā vedanā, atthi sāmisā dukkhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā dukkhā vedanā, atthi sāmisā adukkham'asukhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā adukkham'asukhā vedanā.

example_1: na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato.
commentary: (NIDD1a) lok'uttarassa dhammassa uppāditattā veneyy'ānurūpena yathāsukhaṃ lok'uttaradhammassa dānena ca dhammesu issaro'ti dhammassāmī. tathāgatapadaṃ heṭṭhā vuttatthaṃ.

meaning_1: right way; correct course; proper procedure (for)

commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) sikkhamānā nāma dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā.

meaning_1: you yourself must train yourself (in); you yourself should practice
meaning_2: you must train yourself; let you study by yourself
example_1: iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
example_2: ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū'ti
commentary: (THIa) sikkhassu sikkhāyā'ti adhisīlasikkh'ādikāya tividhāya sikkhāya sikkha, maggasampayuttā tisso sikkhāyo sampādehī'ti attho.

example_1: yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā
so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto.
example_2: kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sikkhā'ti tisso sikkhā, adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā. tatra y'āyaṃ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā sikkhā'ti.

example_1: sv'āhaṃ idha pañca sikkhā karitvā, paṭipajjitvā tathāgatassa dhamme, dvepatham'agamāsiṃ coramajjhe, te maṃ tattha vadhiṃsu bhogahetu.
example_2: parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
commentary: (SNa) sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti tividhā'pi sikkhā kātabbā. yog'ādīsu yogo'ti payogo. chando'ti kattu'kamyatākusalacchando. ussoḷhī'ti sabbasahaṃ adhimattavīriyaṃ.

meaning_1: a precept to be observed; a training rule to be practised
example_1: na bhuñjamāno sabbaṃ hatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmī'ti sikkhākaraṇīyā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti tividhā'pi sikkhā kātabbā. yog'ādīsu yogo'ti payogo. chando'ti kattu'kamyatākusalacchando. ussoḷhī'ti sabbasahaṃ adhimattavīriyaṃ.

meaning_1: desiring to train; wanting to practice
example_1: tama't'agge mete, ānanda, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā'ti
example_2: ye te bhikkhū app'icchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissatī'ti!

meaning_1: respectful towards the training; giving weight to the practice
example_1: ye c'aññe bhikkhū sikkhāgāravā tesañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena. attanā ca sikkhāgāravo hoti, sikkhāgāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī.

meaning_1: fact of having respect for the training; fact of giving weight to the practice
example_1: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sikkhāgāravatā'ti tīsu sikkhāsu garubhāvo.

meaning_1: weakness with regard to the training; lack of capability to practice
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu raj'aggaññ'eva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.
commentary: (ANa) sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā'ti sikkhāya dubbalabhāvaṃ pakāsetvā.

meaning_1: suffered from weakness with regard to the training; kept the training rules badly
example_1: yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅ'kato, so bhagavatā byākato, sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti. saraṇāni sakko sikkhādubbalyam'āpādi, majjapānaṃ apāyī'ti.

meaning_1: benefit of training; profit of practice; (comm) training is the benefit

meaning_lit: discourse on the benefits of training

meaning_1: excellency of training; best kind of practice
example_1: cha anuttariyāni, dassan'ānuttariyaṃ, savan'ānuttariyaṃ, lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) hatthisipp'ādi-sikkhanaṃ na sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkhattayapūraṇaṃ pana sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ nāma.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudd'ānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
commentary: (ANa) sikkhati sikkhāpadesū'ti taṃ taṃ sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyitvā sikkhati. apica samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesū'ti yaṃkiñci sikkhāpadesu sikkhākoṭṭhāsesu sikkhitabbaṃ kāyikaṃ vā vācasikaṃ vā, taṃ sabbaṃ sammā ādāya sikkhati.

meaning_1: counting the precepts; enumerating the training rules
concerned with training rules; related to precepts
example_1: atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāyā'ti sikkhāsaṅkhātehi padehi paṭisaṃyuttāya, tīhi sikkhāhi samannāgatāyā'ti attho.

meaning_1: one hundred training rules; one hundred precepts
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so vajjiputtako bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sādhikam'idaṃ, bhante, diyaḍḍhaṃ sikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. n'āhaṃ, bhante, ettha sakkomi sikkhitun'ti.
commentary: (ANa) diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasatan'ti paṇṇās'ādhikaṃ sikkhāpadasataṃ. tasmiṃ samaye paññattāni sikkhāpadān'eva sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. so kira bhikkhu ajjavasampanno ujujātiko avaṅko akuṭilo, tasmā ahaṃ ettakāni sikkhāpadāni rakkhituṃ sakkuṇeyyaṃ vā na vā'ti cintetvā satthu ārocesi.

meaning_1: disparaging the training rules; speaking badly of the precepts
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (KVa) sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake'ti evaṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ vivaṇṇake garahaṇe pācittiyaṃ hotī'ti attho.

example_1: pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.
example_2: daharakālato paṭṭhāya hi naṃ mārāpento'va seṭṭhi māretuṃ n'āsakkhi, kiṃ akkharasamayaṃ sikkhāpessati?
commentary: (DNa) sippaṃ sikkhāpentī'ti attano ovāde ṭhitabhāvaṃ ñatvā vaṃs'ānugataṃ muddāgaṇan'ādi-sippaṃ sikkhāpenti.

meaning_2: to cause to train; to make learn

example_1: sikkhāpentā'pi therehi, bālā cīvaradhāraṇaṃ, na suṇissanti dummedhā, pākaṭā kāmakāriyā.
example_2: tatr'idaṃ vatthu, eko kira naṭako suvapotakaṃ gahetvā sikkhāpento vicarati. so bhikkhun'upassayaṃ upanissāya vasitvā gamanakāle suvapotakaṃ pamussitvā gato. taṃ sāmaṇeriyo gahetvā paṭijaggiṃsu.
commentary: (THa) sikkhāpentā'pī'ti sikkhāpiyamānā'pi. kammatthe hi ayaṃ kattuniddeso.

example_1: tassa na tādiso chando hoti adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
commentary: (DNa) sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hotī'ti sikkhattayapūraṇe bahalacchando hoti. (DNt) sikkhāya samma'd'eva ādānaṃ sikkhāsamādānaṃ, taṃ pan'assā pāripūriyā veditabban'ti āha sikkhattayapūraṇe'ti. sikkhāya vā samma'd'eva ādito paṭṭhāya rakkhaṇaṃ sikkhāsamādānaṃ, tañ'ca atthato pūraṇe paricchinnaṃ arakkhaṇe sabbena sabbaṃ abhāvato, rakkhaṇe ca paripūraṇato.
(VINa) sikkhāsammutiṃ dātun'ti kasmā dāpesi? mātugāmo nāma lolo hoti dve vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitvā sīlāni pūrayamāno kilamati, sikkhitvā pana pacchā na kilamissati, nittharissatī'ti dāpesi.

meaning_1: training and lifestyle; practice and precepts (of)
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
example_2: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.
commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti.

meaning_1: undertaken the training and lifestyle; engaged in the practice and precepts (of)
example_1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti. (ANa) sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno'ti yā bhikkhūnaṃ adhisīlasaṅkhātā sikkhā, tañ'ca, yattha c'ete saha jīvanti, ekajīvikā sabhāgavuttino honti, taṃ bhagavatā paññattasikkhāpadasaṅkhātaṃ sājīvañ'ca tattha sikkhanabhāvena samāpanno'ti bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno.

meaning_1: precepts and practices; ethics and observances; rites and rituals
example_1: mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.
example_2: ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbaten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

meaning_1: clinging to precepts and practices; adherence to rites and rituals (as a means of liberation)
example_1: tassa evaṃ yoniso manasikaroto tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā
example_2: sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo, imāni pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
commentary: (DNa) sīlañ'ca vatañ'ca parāmasatī'ti sīlabbataparāmāso.

meaning_1: obsessed by clinging to precepts and practices; consumed by adherence to rites and rituals
example_1: sīlabbataparāmāsa-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati sīlabbataparāmāsaparetena, uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto oram'bhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.

meaning_1: afflicted with clinging to precepts and practices; filled with adherence to rites and rituals
example_1: sīlabbataparāmāsa-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati sīlabbataparāmāsaparetena, uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto oram'bhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.

meaning_1: underlying tendency to cling to precepts and practices; propensity to adhere to rites and rituals
example_1: daharassa hi, mālukyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sīlā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pan'assa uppajjissati sīlesu sīlabbataparāmāso? anusetv'ev'assa sīlabbataparāmās'ānusayo.

meaning_1: consummate in precepts and practices; accomplished in ethics and observances
example_1: yo sīlabbatasampanno, pahit'atto samāhito, cittaṃ yassa vasībhūtaṃ, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

meaning_1: grasping precepts and practices; clinging to ethics and observances; adherence to rites and rituals
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ? cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, upādānāni, kām'upādānaṃ, diṭṭh'upādānaṃ, sīlabbat'upādānaṃ, attavād'upādānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ.
example_2: te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na sīlabbat'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na attavād'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti.
commentary: (DNa) iminā suddhī'ti evaṃ sīlavatānaṃ gahaṇaṃ sīlabbat'upādānaṃ.

meaning_1: ethical failure; loss of virtue; disastrous morality
example_1: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa
commentary: (DNa) sīlabyasanaṃ dussīlyass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: because of loss of virtue; due to ethical failure
example_1: n'āvuso, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. sīlabyasanahetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhibyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_1: merely regarding ethics; about mere morality
example_1: appamattakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, oramattakaṃ sīlamattakaṃ, yena puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
commentary: (DNa) sīlam'eva sīlamattakaṃ.

meaning_1: defined by ethical behaviour; identified with morality
meaning_2: made by morality; produced by behaviour
example_1: idha, thapati, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti no ca sīlamayo, tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatth'assa te kusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
commentary: (MNa) no ca sīlamayo'ti alam'ettāvatā, n'atthi ito kiñci uttari karaṇīyan'ti evaṃ sīlamayo na hoti.

meaning_1: undertaking ethical precepts; taking up morality
example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.
commentary: (DNa) sīlasamādāne'ti pañcasīla-dasasīla-catupārisuddhisīla-pūraṇakāle. (DNt) sīlasamādāne'ti sīlassa samma'd'eva ādāne, gahaṇe pavattane'ti attho. taṃ pavattikālena dassento pūraṇakāle'ti āha.

meaning_1: ethical conduct, meditative composure and understanding
compound_construction: sīla ca samādhi ca paññā ca

meaning_1: successful attainment of ethical conduct, meditative composure and understanding
meaning_2: successful attainment of ethical conduct, stability of mind and understanding

meaning_1: moral conduct, meditative composure and insight
moral conduct, meditative composure, insight, path, fruition and Nibbāna
who has virtue; who has integrity
example_1: dukkaraṃ vā'pi karonti, sekhā sīlasamāhitā, ṭhitattā anagāriy'upetassa, tuṭṭhi hoti sukh'āvahā'ti.
example_2: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sīlasamāhitā'ti sīlena samāhitā samupetā.

meaning_1: attainment of virtue; moral success; being accomplished in ethical conduct
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca sīlasampanno sīlasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: appamatto samāno sīlasampadaṃ ārādheti. so tāya sīlasampadāya attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. so tāya sīlasampadāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū dussīlā pāpadhammā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) sīlasampadā'ti, tattha katamā sīlasampadā? kāyiko avītikkamo'ti evaṃ pubbe vuttasoraccam'eva sīlassa sampādanato paripūraṇato sīlasampadā'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: talk on the attainment of virtue; discussion about moral success
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca sīlasampanno sīlasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: for the benefit of the attainment of virtue; for the advantage of being accomplished in ethical conduct
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ. yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

meaning_1: because of the successful attainment of virtue; due to moral excellence
example_1: n'āvuso, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. sīlasampadāhetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_1: of excellent morality; accomplished in virtue
example_1: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
example_2: kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.

meaning_1: more skilled in morality; more accomplished in virtue (than)
example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya attanā sīlasampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

meaning_1: moral restraint; ethical conduct and self-control
example_1: kuto pan'assa, bhante, dussīlassa pāpadhammassa evarūpo sīlasaṃyamo bhavissatī'ti?
sa kho so, mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
commentary: (DNa) na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato'ti yāni asaṃvaramūlakāni bhayāni uppajjanti, tesu yaṃ idaṃ bhayaṃ sīlasaṃvarato bhaveyya, taṃ kutoci ekasaṃvarato'pi na samanupassati. kasmā? saṃvarato asaṃvaramūlakassa bhayassa abhāvā.

meaning_1: restrained by ethics; moderated by morality
example_1: etam'atthavasaṃ ñatvā, paṇḍito sīlasaṃvuto, nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, khippam'eva visodhaye.

meaning_1: with virtue in common; with ethical conduct in harmony (with)
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi c'eva raho ca.
commentary: (MNa) sīlasāmaññagato viharatī'ti tesu tesu disābhāgesu viharantehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ samānabhāv'ūpagatasīlo viharati.

example_1: katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sīlasāro'ti sārasampāpakaṃ sīlaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: precepts and practices; ethics and observances; rites and rituals
example_1: yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.
example_2: etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) sīlavatānī'ti pātimokkh'ādīni sīlāni āraññik'ādīni dhutaṅgavatāni ca. (NIDD1) yo tattha saṃyamo saṃvaro avītikkamo, idaṃ sīlaṃ. yaṃ samādānaṃ taṃ vataṃ. saṃvar'aṭṭhena sīlaṃ, samādān'aṭṭhena vataṃ.

grammar: adj, fem nom sg of sīlavant
example_1: soḷas'ākārasampannā, aṭṭh'aṅgasusamāgatā, tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, upapajjati devalokaṃ manāpan'ti.
example_2: itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.

meaning_1: having precepts and practices; endowed with ethics and observances
example_1: hito bahunnaṃ paṭipajja bhoge, taṃ devatā rakkhati dhammaguttaṃ, bahussutaṃ sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ, dhamme ṭhitaṃ na vijahati kitti.
example_2: satthā hi loke paṭhamo mahesi, tassanvayo sāvako bhāvit'atto, ath'āparo pāṭipado'pi sekho, bahussuto sīlavat'ūpapanno.
commentary: (ITIa) pātimokkhasaṃvar'ādi-sīlena c'eva āraññik'aṅg'ādi-dhut'aṅgavatehi ca upapanno sampanno samannāgato'ti sīlavat'ūpapanno. (SNPa) catupārisuddhisīlena dhut'aṅgavatena ca upapannattā sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ (THa) sīlavat'ūpapanno'ti ukkaṃsagatena catupārisuddhisīlena, dhutadhammasaṅkhātehi vatehi ca upapanno samannāgato.

meaning_1: observance of morality; good conduct; ritual behaviour
example_1: yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.
commentary: (SNa) vatasīlavattan'ti sīlam'eva vuccati. (JAa) vatasīlavattan'ti vatasamādānañ'ca sīlavattañ'ca.

example_1: diṭṭhiñ'ca anupaggamma, sīlavā dassanena sampanno, kāmesu vineyya gedhaṃ, na hi jātu gabbhaseyya punaretī'ti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) sīlavantan'ti pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirataṃ, adinn'ādānā paṭivirataṃ, musāvādā paṭivirataṃ.

meaning_1: benefit of principled behaviour; advantage of ethical conduct
who professes a doctrine of ethical conduct; who teaches ethics
meaning_2: who profess a doctrine of ethical conduct; who teaches ethics
example_1: santi, kassapa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavādā. te anekapariyāyena sīlassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.

meaning_1: failure in morality; going wrong ethically
example_1: idha, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamād'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati. ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
commentary: (ANa) sīlavipattī'ti sīlassa vipann'ākāro.

example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhivipatti. sīlavipattihetu… cittavipattihetu… diṭṭhivipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_1: who has transgressed the moral precepts; who has broken the moral code (regarding)
meaning_2: who has trespassed the moral precepts
example_1: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti
commentary: (VINa) adhisīle sīlavipanno'ti-ādīsu pārājikañ'ca saṅgh'ādisesañ'ca āpanno adhisīle sīlavipanno nāma. (DNa) sīlavipanno'ti vipannasīlo bhinnasaṃvaro.

meaning_1: for the sake of purity of ethical conduct; for the purpose of purification of moral behaviour
example_1: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

meaning_1: purity of ethical conduct; purification of moral behaviour
example_1: sīlavisuddhiṃ kho ahaṃ, sāḷha, aññataraṃ sāmaññ'aṅgan'ti vadāmi. ye te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā tapojigucchāvādā tapojigucchāsārā tapojigucchāallīnā viharanti, abhabbā te oghassa nittharaṇāya.
example_2: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

meaning_1: by means of purity of ethical conduct; based on purification of moral behaviour
example_1: santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā dvayena oghassa nittharaṇaṃ paññapenti, sīlavisuddhihetu ca tapojigucchāhetu ca. idha, bhante, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

meaning_1: growth in ethical conduct; increase in virtue
example_1: katamā tisso? saddhāvuddhi, sīlavuddhi, paññāvuddhi, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vuddhiyo'ti.

meaning_1: relying on ethical conduct; supported by morality
commentary: (ANa) sesapadesu pan'ettha ayam'adhippāyo, brāhmaṇā tāva mante labhitvā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti, gahapatikā yaṃkiñci sippaṃ, itthī kuladāyajjasāmikaṃ puttaṃ, corā yaṃkiñci āvudhasatthaṃ, samaṇā sīlaparipuṇṇā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti. tasmā mant'ādhiṭṭhānā'tiādīni vuttāni.

meaning_1: ruled by ethical conduct; governed by morality
example_1: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

meaning_1: supported by virtue; assisted by good conduct
example_1: idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassan'ānuggahitā ca hoti.
commentary: (MNa) sīl'ānuggahitā'ti-ādīsu sīlan'ti catupārisuddhisīlaṃ.

meaning_1: recollection of one's virtue; remembering one's conduct
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

meaning_1: reliance on ethical conduct; dependence on morality
in the habit of; accustomed to; of such nature
example_1: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.
example_2: niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

meaning_1: who takes conduct as the highest ideal
example_1: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.
commentary: (SNPa) sīlaṃ'y'eva uttaman'ti maññamānā sīl'uttamā (NIDD1) sīl'uttamā … sant'eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīl'uttamavādā

meaning_1: chanting of ethical conduct; recitation of precepts

example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako sīl'uposathaṃ upavasati, sīlena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, sīlañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. evaṃ kho, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
commentary: (ANa) sīl'uposathan'ti attano sīl'ānussaraṇavasena upavuttho uposatho sīl'uposatho nāma.

meaning_1: in virtuous conduct one should be
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti… sīsena'pi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehi'pi kammaṃ karoti

notes: See SCPN §10 (Eastern Forms)

example_1: ārammaṇasañjānanañ'c'eva vipassanāya ca visayabhāvaṃ upagantvā nibbidājananaṃ. dahanakiccamiva hi sukh'odake tejodhātu sañjānanakiccaṃ p'esā paṭuṃ kātuṃ na sakkoti.
sukhakāmāni bhūtāni, yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati, attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhaṃ.
example_2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo
commentary: (UDa) sukhakāmānī'ti ek'anten'eva attano sukhassa icchanato sukh'ānugiddhāni.

example_1: sukhajīvino pure āsuṃ, bhikkhū gotamasāvakā, anicchā piṇḍam'esanā, anicchā sayan'āsanaṃ, loke aniccataṃ ñatvā, dukkhass'antaṃ akaṃsu te.
patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti sukhañ'ca etaṃ puggalaṃ adhivattati, avattharatī'ti attho.

example_1: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sukha
meaning_1: as ease; as comfort; as pleasant; as good
example_1: yaṃ pare sukhato āhu, tadariyā āhu dukkhato, yaṃ pare dukkhato āhu, tadariyā sukhato vidū.
tatra, bhante, y'āyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khipp'ābhiññā, ayaṃ pana, bhante, paṭipadā ubhayen'eva paṇītā akkhāyati sukhattā ca khippattā ca. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, paṭipadāsu.

meaning_1: for the purpose of ease; for the sake of comfort
example_1: sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā, pāmojjaṃ pīt'atthaṃ pīt'ānisaṃsaṃ, avippaṭisāro pāmojj'attho pāmojj'ānisaṃso
kiṃdado balado hoti, kiṃdado hoti vaṇṇado, kiṃdado sukhado hoti, kiṃdado hoti cakkhudo, ko ca sabbadado hoti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
example_2: annado balado hoti, vatthado hoti vaṇṇado, yānado sukhado hoti, dīpado hoti cakkhudo.
commentary: (SNa) sukhado hotī'ti yānassa sukh'āvahanato sukhado nāma hoti.

meaning_1: ease and discomfort; pleasure and pain; happiness and sorrow
example_1: yadā ca attanā vedi, muni monena brāhmaṇo, atha rūpā arūpā ca, sukhadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
example_2: sādhu sādhu, ānanda, yathā taṃ sāriputto sammā byākaramāno byākareyya. paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho, ānanda, sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ mayā.
commentary: (DNa) sukhadukkhe'ti sukhadukkhaṃ. (THIa) sukhadukkhe'ti sukhe ca dukkhe ca, iṭṭh'āniṭṭhavisayasamāyoge vā.
notes: See SCPN §10 (Eastern Forms)

meaning_1: having ease and discomfort; with pleasure and pain; including happiness and sorrow
example_1: so sabyābajjhehi'pi abyābajjhehi'pi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjham'pi abyābajjham'pi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ, seyyathā'pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. iti kho, puṇṇa, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti, yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati.
commentary: (ANa) vokiṇṇasukhadukkhan'ti vomissakasukhadukkhaṃ.

meaning_1: experiencing ease and discomfort; feeling pleasure and pain
example_1: khattiyo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena dvayakārī, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī, vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādāno vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
commentary: (DNa) sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī hotī'ti ekakkhaṇe ubhayavipākadānaṭṭhānaṃ nāma n'atthi. yena pana akusalaṃ bahuṃ kataṃ hoti, kusalaṃ mandaṃ, so taṃ kusalaṃ nissāya khattiyakule vā brāhmaṇakule vā nibbattati. atha naṃ akusalakammaṃ kāṇam'pi karoti khujjam'pi pīṭhasappim'pi. so rajjassa vā anaraho hoti, abhisittakāle vā evaṃbhūto bhoge paribhuñjituṃ na sakkoti. aparassa maraṇakāle dve balavamallā viya te dve'pi kusal'ākusalakammāni upaṭṭhahanti. tesu akusalaṃ balavataraṃ hoti, taṃ kusalaṃ paṭibāhitvā tiracchānayoniyaṃ nibbattāpeti. kusalakammam'pi pavattivedanīyaṃ hoti. tam'enaṃ maṅgalahatthiṃ vā karonti maṅgalaassaṃ vā maṅgalausabhaṃ vā. so sampattiṃ anubhavati. idaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ sukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī hotī'ti.

meaning_1: touched by ease and discomfort; experiencing pleasure and pain; affected by happiness and sorrow
example_1: gāme araññe sukhadukkhaphuṭṭho, n'ev'attato no parato dahetha, phusanti phassā upadhiṃ paṭicca, nirūpadhiṃ kena phuseyyu phassā'ti.

meaning_1: occurrence of ease and discomfort; arising of pleasure and pain
example_1: tath'ev'imasmiṃ kāyasmiṃ, samuppajjanti vedanā, sukhadukkhasamuppatti, adukkham'asukhā ca yā.

meaning_1: experiencing ease and discomfort; enjoying pleasure and suffering pain; having happiness and sorrow
example_1: ek'antasukhī attā hoti… ek'antadukkhī attā hoti. sukhadukkhī attā hoti. adukkham'asukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā saññī'ti naṃ paññapenti.

meaning_lit: discourse on experiencing ease and discomfort

meaning_1: happiness; pleasant experience; state of ease; good thing
example_1: bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā'ti.

cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sukhadhātū'ti-ādīsu sukhañ'ca taṃ nissattasuññat'aṭṭhena dhātu cā'ti sukhadhātu. esa nayo sabbattha.

example_1: tā piṇḍāya caritvā, bhatt'atthaṃ kariya dhotapattāyo, rahitamhi sukhanisinnā, imā girā abbhudīresuṃ.
commentary: (THIa) sukhanisinnā'ti pabbajjāsukhena vivekasukhena ca sukhanisinnā.

meaning_1: this is comfortable; this is pleasant
example_1: kiñ'ca vijānāti? sukhan'ti'pi vijānāti, dukkhan'ti'pi vijānāti, adukkham'asukhan'ti'pi vijānāti. vijānāti vijānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇan'ti vuccatī'ti.

sukhakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena sukhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā. sukhasaṃvattanikā hi'ssa paṭipadā paṭipannā sukhapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. so lābhī hoti sukhassa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
commentary: (DNt) sukhapaṭilābhā'ti sukhasamadhigamā.

meaning_1: experiencing ease; feeling comfort; experiencing contentment
example_1: pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati. sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

meaning_1: brought up in comfort; raised with a silver spoon in one's mouth
example_1: evaṃ vutte, raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa mātāpitaro raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ, tvaṃ kho'si, tāta raṭṭhapāla, amhākaṃ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukh'edhito sukhaparibhato.
commentary: (MNa) sukhaparibhato'ti sukhena paribhato, jātakālato pabhuti dhātīhi aṅkato aṅkaṃ āharitvā dhāriyamāno assakarathak'ādīhi bālakīḷanakehi kīḷayamāno sādurasabhojanaṃ bhojayamāno sukhena parihaṭo.

meaning_1: comfortably taken care of; raised in comfort
example_1: anujānātha maṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā'ti. evaṃ vutte, raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa mātāpitaro raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ, tvaṃ kho'si, tāta raṭṭhapāla, amhākaṃ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukh'edhito sukhaparihato.
commentary: (VINa) sukhaparihato'ti sukhena parihato, jātakālato pabhuti dhātīhi aṅkato aṅkaṃ haritvā dhāriyamāno assakarathak'ādīhi bālakīḷanakehi kīḷamāno sādurasabhojanaṃ bhojiyamāno sukhena parihato.

meaning_1: experiencing ease; feeling comfort; sensitive to pleasure
example_1: sukhappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sukhappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
example_2: so anattan'tapo aparan'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
commentary: (ANa) jhāna-magga-phala-nibbāna-sukhāni paṭisaṃvedetī'ti sukhappaṭisaṃvedī.

meaning_1: giving rise to comfort; resulting in ease
example_1: ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.
example_2: na pīḷitā attadukhena dhīrā, sukhapphalaṃ kamma pariccajanti, sammohitā vā'pi sukhena mattā, na pāpakammañ'ca samācaranti.

meaning_1: suffusion with ease; fact of pervading with comfort
example_1: pañc'aṅgiko sammāsamādhi, pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā, ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ. ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.
commentary: (DNa) sukhaṃ pharamānaṃ uppajjatī'ti tīsu jhānesu paññā sukhapharaṇatā nāma.

meaning_1: with pleasant fruit; with nice results
example_1: dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti, n'ādinnaṃ hoti taṃ tathā, corā haranti rājāno, aggi ḍahati nassati.
commentary: (JAa) sukhapphalan'ti, samma abhipāraka, paṇḍitā attano dukkhena phuṭṭhā samānā na sukhavipākadāyakakammaṃ pariccajanti, sammohitā vā'pi hutvā mohena mūḷhā sukhena mattā pāpakammaṃ nāma na samācaranti.

example_1: so āyudāyī vaṇṇadāyī, sukhabaladado naro, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.

meaning_1: abundantly comfortable; with lots of good
example_1: tam'enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena tassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā sukhabahulā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) sukhabahulā vedanā'ti manussaloke khattiyakul'ādīsu sukhabahulā vedanā vedayitabbā hoti, tā vedayamānaṃ nipannaṃ vā nisinnaṃ vā passāmī'ti dasseti.
(ANa) sukham'anuttaran'ti etadeva maggaphalasukhaṃ anuttaraṃ sukhaṃ nāma.

example_1: atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santiṃ, jetvāna senaṃ piyasātarūpaṃ, eko'haṃ jhāyaṃ sukham'anubodhiṃ, tasmā janena na karomi sakkhiṃ, sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci me'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sukham'anubodhin'ti arahattasukhaṃ anubujjhiṃ.

meaning_1: indulges in pleasure; engages in gratification
example_1: sukhavinicchayaṃ jaññā, sukhavinicchayaṃ ñatvā ajjhattaṃ sukham'anuyuñjeyya.

grammar: aor of sukhaṃ seti, comp vb
example_1: kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sukham'asayitthā'ti sukhaṃ sayittha.

grammar: aor, reflx 3rd sg of sukhamasayi, comp vb
meaning_1: one slept well; one rested comfortably
example_1: kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sukham'asayitthā'ti sukhaṃ sayittha.

grammar: aor, reflx 1st sg of sukhamasayi, comp vb
meaning_1: I slept well; I rested comfortably
example_1: kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.

meaning_1: is conducive to comfort; brings happiness; confers ease
example_1: kiṃsū'dha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, kiṃsu suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati, kiṃsu have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, kathaṃjīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhan'ti.
example_2: dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati, es'ānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
commentary: (SNa) sukham'āvahatī'ti sabbam'pi sāsav'ānāsavaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasukhaṃ āvahati.

meaning_1: is conducive to comfort; brings happiness; confers ease
example_1: kiṃsū'dha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, kiṃsu suciṇṇaṃ sukham'āvahāti, kiṃsu have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, kathaṃjīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhan'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) sukhamāvahātī'ti soṇa-seṭṭhiputta-raṭṭhapāl'ādīnaṃ viya manussasukhaṃ, sakk'ādīnaṃ viya dibbasukhaṃ, pariyosāne ca mahāpadum'ādīnaṃ viya nibbānasukhañ'ca āvahatī'ti.
(VINa) sukh'edhito'ti sukhena edhito, sukhasaṃvaḍḍhito'ti attho.

meaning_1: thrives comfortably; prospers in comfort; (comm) gains ease
example_1: satīmato sadā bhaddaṃ, satimā sukham'edhati, satīmato suve seyyo, verā ca parimuccatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sukham'edhatī'ti, sukhaṃ paṭilabhati.
(VINa) sukh'edhito'ti sukhena edhito, sukhasaṃvaḍḍhito'ti attho.

meaning_2: easily made stiff (with fear); easily hindered

example_1: na ca, bhante, bhagavā kāmesu kāmasukhallik'ānuyogam'anuyutto hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyutto dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) sukhallik'ānuyogan'ti sukhalliyan'ānuyogaṃ, sukhasevan'ādhimuttan'ti attho.

meaning_1: indulgence in pleasure; devotion to sensuality; hedonism
example_1: evaṃvādino, cunda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam'assu vacanīyā, katamo so, āvuso, sukhallik'ānuyogo? sukhallik'ānuyogā hi bahū anekavihitā nānappakārakā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) sukhallik'ānuyogan'ti sukhalliyan'ānuyogaṃ, sukhasevan'ādhimuttan'ti attho.

meaning_1: devoted to the enjoyment of pleasure
example_1: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, cunda, vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, sukhallik'ānuyogam'anuyuttā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā viharantī'ti. evaṃvādino, cunda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam'assu vacanīyā, katamo so, āvuso, sukhallik'ānuyogo?

meaning_1: benefit of devotion to worldly pleasure
perception of ease; awareness of comfort
example_1: yasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgato kāyam'pi citte samodahati cittam'pi kāye samodahati, sukhasaññañ'ca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati, tasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro c'eva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.
commentary: (SNa) sukhasaññañ'ca lahusaññañ'cā'ti abhiññācittasahajātasaññā. sā hi santasukhasamannāgatattā sukhasaññā nāma hoti, kilesadandhāyitattassa ca abhāvā lahusaññā nāma.

example_1: anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.
ete dhamme bhāvayitvā, tayo sukhasamuddaye, abyāpajjhaṃ sukhaṃ lokaṃ, paṇḍito upapajjatī'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) sukhasamuddaye'ti sukh'ānisaṃse, ānisaṃsaphalam'pi nesaṃ sukham'evā'ti dasseti.

meaning_1: pleasant to the touch; soft to the touch
example_1: manāpikaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ upasaṃharati sukhasamphassaṃ mudusamphassaṃ, iminā phuṭṭho alābhakena sussitvā marissatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. tena phuṭṭho alābhakena sussati, āpatti thull'accayassa.
commentary: (ADha) sukhasamphassan'ti sukhavedanāpaccayaṃ iṭṭhaphoṭṭhabbaṃ.

meaning_1: pleasantness to the touch; fact of being soft to the touch
example_1: ye kho pan'assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjanti, tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. idam'assa sukhasamphassatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi taṃ, bhikkhave, kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.

meaning_1: easy to talk to; pleasant to converse with
example_1: nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.
example_2: samaṇo kira gotamo abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho sukhasambhāso paṭisanthārakusalo, sakkā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paṭisanthāraṃ labhitun'ti.
commentary: (VINa) sukhasambhāsā'ti idaṃ purimassa kāraṇavacanaṃ. yesañ'hi sukhasambhāsā sammodanīyakathā nelā hoti kaṇṇasukhā, te sakhilā'ti vuccanti. ten'āhaṃsu, sakhilā sukhasambhāsā'ti.

meaning_1: considered to be happiness; regarded as pleasure; deemed comfortable
example_1: sadevakassa lokassa, ete vo sukhasammatā, yattha c'ete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.
ek'antadukkhan'ti ek'anten'eva dukkhaṃ, na sukhasammissaṃ.

imāni c'assu, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni akhaṇḍāni apūtikāni avāt'ātapahatāni sār'ādāni sukhasayitāni, pathavī ca n'āssa, āpo ca n'āssa, api nu'māni, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun'ti?
commentary: (SNa) sukhasayitānī'ti cattāro māse koṭṭhe pakkhittaniyāmen'eva sukhaṃ sayitāni.

meaning_1: accompanied by comfort; filled with ease
example_1: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato sukhasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

meaning_1: conducive to happiness; leading to comfort

example_2: tassa yā purimā upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. adukkham'asukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, adukkham'asukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

example_2: tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti. tassa tayo pāsādā honti, eko hem'antiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.

meaning_1: delicacy; fact of being refined; tenderness

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.
te santaṃ'y'eva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā. ayaṃ tatiyā sukh'ūpapatti.
