example_1: yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi evaṃgatāni puthusipp'āyatanāni, te diṭṭh'eva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti, te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mitt'āmacce sukhenti pīṇenti
commentary: (DNa) sukhentī'ti sukhitaṃ karonti. pīṇentī'ti pīṇitaṃ thāmabal'ūpetaṃ karonti.

example_1: viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette'ti.

meaning_1: brought up in comfort; delicately nurtured; cossetted; pampered
example_1: evaṃ vutte, raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa mātāpitaro raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ, tvaṃ kho'si, tāta raṭṭhapāla, amhākaṃ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukh'edhito sukhaparibhato.
commentary: (MNa) sukh'edhito'ti sukhena edhito, sukhasaṃvaḍḍhito'ti attho.

grammar: nt, abstr, instr sg of sukha
meaning_1: with ease; by comfort; with happiness
example_1: sabbattha ve sappurisā cajanti, na kāmakāmā lapayanti santo, sukhena phuṭṭhā atha vā dukhena, na ucc'āvacaṃ paṇḍitā dassayanti.
example_2: so imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
commentary: (DNa) sukhenā'ti sukhasomanassen'eva katena, na dukkhinā dummanena hutvā'ti attho.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sukha

example_1: saritāni sinehitāni ca, somanassāni bhavanti jantuno, te sātasitā sukh'esino, te ve jātijar'ūpagā narā.
example_2: passa puññānaṃ vipākaṃ, kusalānaṃ sukh'esino, mettaṃ cittaṃ vibhāvetvā, satta vassāni bhikkhavo, sattasaṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamiṃ.
commentary: (ANa) sukh'esino'ti sukhapariyesake satte āmanteti.

meaning_1: faring well; going well; doing well; fortunate; who has reached the destination
example_1: cutiṃ yo vedi sattānaṃ, upapattiñ'ca sabbaso, asattaṃ sugataṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
example_2: so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākamm'ūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ
commentary: (MNa) sugatā'ti suṭṭhugatā suppaṭipannā kārakā yuttapayuttā. evarūpā'pi hi ekacce bhikkhū atthi.

meaning_1: Accomplished One; Fortunate One; epithet of the Buddha
example_1: ucchinda sineham'attano, kumudaṃ sāradikaṃ'va, santimaggam'eva brūhaya, nibbānaṃ sugatena desitaṃ.
example_2: rūpam'eva nu kho, bhagavā, rūpam'eva nu kho, sugatā'ti? rūpam'pi, rāhula, vedanā'pi, rāhula, saññā'pi, rāhula, saṅkhārā'pi, rāhula, viññāṇam'pi, rāhulā'ti.
commentary: (THIa) sugatena sammāsambuddhena

meaning_1: standard; commonly accepted; (comm) indication that a given measure is to be multiplied by three
example_1: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
example_2: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭh'aṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugat'aṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) sugatavidatthiyā'ti sugatavidatthi nāma idāni majjhimassa purisassa tisso vidatthiyo vaḍḍhakīhatthena diyaḍḍho hattho hoti.

meaning_1: standard inch; commonly accepted finger breadth
example_1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭh'aṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugat'aṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (KVt) sugat'aṅgulaṃ nāma idāni majjhimassa purimassa tīṇi aṅgulāni, tena sugat'aṅgulena aṭṭh'aṅgulaṃ vaḍḍhakihatthappamāṇan'ti attho.

meaning_1: Buddha's robe; robe of the Fortunate One
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeyya, atirekaṃ vā, chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: tatr'idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ, dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo.

meaning_1: measurement of the Buddha's robe; size of the Fortunate One's robe; (or) measurement of a standard robe
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeyya, atirekaṃ vā, chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: tatr'idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ, dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo, idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇanti.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.9.12) sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ nāma dīghaso nava vidatthiyo, sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo.

commentary: (SNa) sugatappasatthan'ti sugatena vaṇṇitaṃ.

meaning_1: preached by the Fortunate One; spoken by the Buddha
example_1: dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito, ayañ'ca puggalo nirayaṃ upapanno hoti.

meaning_2: great robe of the Fortunate One

meaning_1: measure of length; standard span; well-gone span; from outstretched thumb to baby finger; (comm) three hand spans in length
example_1: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
example_2: nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
commentary: (VINa) sugatavidatthiyā'ti sugatavidatthi nāma idāni majjhimassa purisassa tisso vidatthiyo vaḍḍhakīhatthena diyaḍḍho hattho hoti.

meaning_1: discipline of the Fortunate One; Buddha's training
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi … sammāsamādhi. ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, n'āññatra sugatavinayā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) n'āññatra sugatavinayā'ti sugat'ovādaṃ vinā na uppajjantī'ti.

meaning_lit: discourse on the discipline of the Fortunate One

meaning_1: leftovers of the Fortunate One; Buddha's scraps
example_1: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) sugat'ātirittānī'ti tesaṃ kira bhojanāni dadamānā buddhānañ'ca buddhasāvakānañ'ca datvā pacchā avasesaṃ sāyanhasamaye denti. evam'esa sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjati nāma.

meaning_1: glory of the Fortunate One; legend of the Buddha
example_1: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) sugat'āpadānesū'ti sugatalakkhaṇesu. sugatassa sāsanasambhūtāsu tīsu sikkhāsu. kathaṃ pan'esa tattha jīvati? etassa hi cattāro paccaye dadamānā sīl'ādiguṇasampannānaṃ sambuddhānaṃ demā'ti denti, tena esa abuddho samāno buddhānaṃ niyāmitapaccaye paribhuñjanto sugat'āpadānesu jīvati nāma.
notes: see sugatāpadāna 2

meaning_1: scraps of the Fortunate One; leftovers of the Buddha
example_1: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.
notes: see sugatāpadāna 1

meaning_2: dwelling place of the Buddha, imitation of the Buddha

meaning_1: good destination; happy fate; state of happiness
example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? parisuddhattā, bhikkhave, vatthassa. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, citte asaṃkiliṭṭhe, sugati pāṭikaṅkhā.
example_2: bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?

meaning_1: leading to a good destination; going to a happy fate
example_1: idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, maggaṃ sugatigāminaṃ, nandino devalokasmiṃ, modanti kāmakāmino'ti.
commentary: (ANa) maggaṃ sugatigāminan'ti sugatigāmikamaggasaṅkhātaṃ dhammaṃ caritvā.

meaning_1: bound for a good destination; destined for a happy fate
example_1: vītikkamitabba-vatthu-samāyoge c'assa sammukhā satthāraṃ passato viya hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti. uttari appaṭivijjhanto pana sugatiparāyano hoti.

meaning_1: reaching a good destination; arriving at a good place
example_1: ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.
gabbham'eke uppajjanti, nirayaṃ pāpakammino, saggaṃ sugatino yanti, parinibbanti anāsavā.
padumaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, pāto siyā phullam'avītagandhaṃ, aṅgīrasaṃ passa virocamānaṃ, tapantam'ādiccam'iv'antalikkhe'ti.
example_2: idaṃ pupphaṃ idāni vaṇṇena'pi suvaṇṇaṃ, gandhena'pi sugandhaṃ, saṇṭhānena'pi susaṇṭhānaṃ. khippam'eva dubbaṇṇaṃ, duggandhaṃ, dussaṇṭhānaṃ, aniccataṃ pāpunissati.
commentary: (DNa) sugandho'ti dibbagandhaṃ vāyati.

example_1: yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ sugandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, saphalā hoti kubbato.

meaning_1: good or bad smell; pleasant or unpleasant odour
sweet smelling; deliciously fragrant; well perfumed
example_1: sugandhikāyavadanaṃ, anantaguṇagandhinaṃ, sugandhin'āhaṃ gandhena, pūjayāmi tathāgataṃ.
avivādavaḍḍhanakariṃ sugiraṃ, bhinn'ānusandhijananiṃ abhaṇi, kalahaṃ janassa panudī samaṅgī, sahitehi nandati pamodati ca.

meaning_1: well recited; well spoken; well stated
example_1: sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.

meaning_1: well guarded; well protected; carefully kept watch over (by)
example_1: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
example_2: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā sudantā suguttā surakkhitā susaṃvutā sukh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ sudantaṃ suguttaṃ surakkhitaṃ susaṃvutaṃ sukh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti

meaning_1: good destination; happy fate; state of happiness
example_1: idha nandati pecca nandati, katapuñño ubhay'attha nandati, puññaṃ me katan'ti nandati, bhiyyo nandati suggatiṃ gato.
example_2: tasmā pattapuṭass'eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.

meaning_1: well grasped; correctly understood; well-learned; taken in the right way
example_1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi, sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni
example_2: yassa c'atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhonti. tesaṃ te dhammā suggahitā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
commentary: (UDa) suggahitānī'ti sammā uggahitāni.

meaning_1: taken hold of tightly; properly grasped; held firmly
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca appamatto goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otareyya. tam'enaṃ kiṭṭh'ārakkho nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya.
example_2: so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggahitvā, gīvāya suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya.

meaning_1: who remembers what is learned; who retains well what is taught
example_1: dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito suvaco, dullabho suggahitaggāhī, dullabho padakkhiṇaggāhī, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
commentary: (ANa) suggahitaṃ katvā gaṇhātī'ti suggahitaggāhī

meaning_1: fact of being well grasped; fact of being taken in the right way
example_1: tesaṃ te dhammā suggahitā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti. taṃ kissa hetu? suggahitattā bhikkhave dhammānaṃ.
theyyasattho nāma corā katakammā vā honti akatakammā vā, rājānaṃ vā theyyaṃ gacchanti suṅkaṃ vā pariharanti.
example_2: dinno suṅko yassa rañño so'yaṃ dinnasuṅko, rājā.

example_1: suṅkaghātaṃ nāma raññā ṭhapitaṃ hoti pabbatakhaṇḍe vā nadītitthe vā gāmadvāre vā, atra paviṭṭhassa suṅkaṃ gaṇhantū'ti.
commentary: (VINa) suṅkaṃ tato hanantī'ti suṅkaghātaṃ, suṅkaṭṭhānass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tañ'hi yasmā tato suṅk'ārahaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ suṅkaṃ adatvā nīharantā rañño suṅkaṃ hananti vināsenti, tasmā suṅkaghātan'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: customs house; duty office; excise office
example_1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso mah'agghaṃ maṇiṃ ādāya aññatarena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti. atha kho so puriso suṅkaṭṭhānaṃ passitvā tassa bhikkhuno ajānantassa thavikāya maṇiṃ pakkhipitvā suṅkaṭṭhānaṃ atikkamitvā aggahesi.
example_2: accayo accagamā'ti aparādho atikkamitvā madditvā gato, aham'ev'ettha aparādhiko. suṅkadāyakaṃ'va bhaṇḍasmin'ti yathā suṅkaṭṭhānaṃ pariharitvā nīte bhaṇḍasmiṃ suṅkadāyakaṃ aparādho abhibhavati, so ca tattha aparādhiko hoti, na rājāno na rājapurisā'ti attho.

meaning_1: tax payer; who must pay customs duty (on)
example_1: anattamano samāno paresaṃ ārocesiṃ. iti mam'eva tattha accayo accagamā suṅkadāyakaṃ'va bhaṇḍasmin'ti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, āpanno bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā'va attānaṃ paccavekkhati.
commentary: (ANa) suṅkadāyakaṃ'va bhaṇḍasmin'ti yathā suṅkaṭṭhānaṃ pariharitvā nīte bhaṇḍasmiṃ suṅkadāyakaṃ aparādho abhibhavati, so ca tattha aparādhiko hoti, na rājāno na rājapurisā'ti attho.

commentary: (VINa) suṭṭhu caritāni sundarāni vā caritāni sucaritāni.

meaning_1: remainder of the results of good conduct
example_1: mahiñ'ca pana ṭhito anonamanto, phusati karehi ubhohi jaṇṇukāni, mahiruhaparimaṇḍalo ahosi, sucaritakammavipākasesakena.

meaning_1: time of being finely crafted; time of being well prepared
example_1: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

meaning_1: well practised; well rehearsed; well consolidated

example_1: atha kho taṃ, ānanda, hatthiratanaṃ, seyyathā'pi nāma gandhahatth'ājāniyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto, evam'eva damathaṃ upagacchi.

meaning_1: completely finished; perfectly completed; fully accomplished

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

meaning_1: well rubbed all around; very pliant
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.
commentary: (MNa) suparimadditā'ti anto ca bahi ca samantato suparimadditā.

meaning_1: truly well restrained; self-controlled in every way
example_1: kāyena saṃvutā dhīrā, atho vācāya saṃvutā, manasā saṃvutā dhīrā, te ve suparisaṃvutā.
commentary: (DHPa) te idha lokasmiṃ susaṃvutā surakkhitā sugopitā supihitadvārā'ti attho.

example_1: catutthe addasā'ti gaṅgātīre paññattavarabuddh'āsane nisinno addasa. vuyhamānan'ti caturassaṃ tacchetvā pabbat'antare ṭhapitaṃ vāt'ātapena suparisukkhaṃ pāvussake meghe vassante udakena uplavitvā anupubbena gaṅgāya nadiyā sote patitaṃ tena sotena vuyhamānaṃ.
pubb'eva kho pan'assa kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ ājīvo suparisuddho hoti. evam'ass'āyaṃ ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
api ca, bhāradvāja, suparivitakkitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi suparivitakkitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
yo sīlavā dussīlesu dadāti dānaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ supasannacitto, abhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, sā dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati.
commentary: (APAa) supasannacittā suppasannamanā

example_1: suppiyānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. suppiyā, bhikkhave, manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti, dvīhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?
commentary: (ANa) supāpikā'ti suṭṭhu pāpikā suṭṭhu lāmikā. dassanāyā'ti passituṃ.

meaning_1: (of a metal) well quenched; properly hardened in water
example_1: asī yathā sunisito, nettiṃso'va supāyiko, sattī'va urasi khittā, kāmā dukkhatarā tato.
notes: refers to the metallurgical process of quenching used to harden steel.

example_1: aparaṃ pana ekadivasaṃ uyyānaṃ gacchanto tath'eva devatāhi nimmitaṃ sunivatthaṃ supārutaṃ pabbajitaṃ disvā, ko nām'eso sammā'ti sārathiṃ pucchi.

construction:
su + pa + sāde + a + ika
supasāda + ika
example_1: pāsādiko vat'āyaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo, supāsādiko vat'āyaṃ bhante, dhammapariyāyo, ko nām'āyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, upavāṇa, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ pāsādiko tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti.
samaṇā'ti bhoti supi, samaṇā'ti pabujjhasi, samaṇān'eva kittesi, samaṇī nūna bhavissasi.
commentary: (THIa) samaṇā'ti bhoti supī'ti bhoti tvaṃ supanakāle'pi samaṇā samaṇā'ti kittentī samaṇapaṭibaddhaṃ'y'eva kathaṃ kathentī supasi.

example_1: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.
abhijānāti kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo divā supitā'ti?
notes: agent noun used verbally see Perniola §292

example_1: evam'āvuso'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, āvuso seyyasaka, yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñja yāva'd'atthaṃ supa yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāya. yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ supitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā te anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocehī'ti.
sukhaṃ supati, sukhaṃ paṭibujjhati, na pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati
example_2: supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.

example_1: āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.
example_2: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

example_1: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti
example_2: aṅgārakās'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. supinak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

meaning_1: like a dream; similar to a dream
example_1: evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, supinak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
example_2: aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā… maṃsapes'ūpamā… tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā… aṅgārakās'ūpamā… supinak'ūpamā… yācitak'ūpamā… rukkhaphal'ūpamā… asisūn'ūpamā… sattisūl'ūpamā… sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) supinak'ūpamā ittarapaccupaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena.

example_1: sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.
example_2: m'āyaṃ viya aggato kataṃ, supin'ante'va suvaṇṇapādapaṃ, upagacchasi andha rittakaṃ, janamajjhe'r'iva rupparūpakaṃ.
commentary: (THa) supinam'eva supinantaṃ

example_1: satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.
commentary: (MNa) supinā'ti mahāsupinā. supinasatānī'ti khuddakasupinasatāni.

meaning_1: in full bloom; abounding in blossoms; covered with flowers
example_1: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya. andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
example_2: daharā ca apāpikā c'asi, kiṃ te pabbajjā karissati, nikkhipa kāsāyacīvaraṃ, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
commentary: (THa) supupphite'ti suṭṭhu pupphite.

meaning_1: having a flowering crest; with flowers on top
example_1: supupphit'aggaṃ upagamma bhikkhuni, ekā tuvaṃ tiṭṭhasi sālamūle, na c'atthi te dutiyā vaṇṇadhātu, bāle na tvaṃ bhāyasi dhuttakānan'ti.

meaning_1: foot of a sal tree in full bloom
example_1: sāvatthinidānaṃ. atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā … aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
ye, bhikkhave, sattā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, supubb'aṇho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.

meaning_1: well revered; highly honoured; deeply venerated
meaning_2: well worshipped; highly honoured; deeply venerated
example_1: mātari pitari c'āpi, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari, ācariye catutthamhi, tesu na mānaṃ kayirātha, tesu assa sagāravo, ty'assa apacitā assu, ty'assu sādhu supūjitā.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

meaning_1: very well-behaved; extremely good; very honest

example_1: dīgham'āyu manussānaṃ, na naṃ hīḷe suporiso, careyya khīramatto'va, n'atthi maccussa āgamo'ti.
commentary: (VISMa) suporiso'ti sādhupuriso paññavā.

meaning_1: easy to support; easy to care for
fact of being easy to support; fact of being easy to maintain; fact of low maintenance

example_1: yehi, bhikkhave, jacc'andhehi hatthissa kaṇṇo diṭṭho ahosi, te evam'āhaṃsu, ediso, deva, hatthī seyyathā'pi suppo'ti.

meaning_1: well explained; clearly illustrated; well taught (by)
example_1: ayaṃ loko paro loko, jānatā suppakāsito, yañ'ca mārena sampattaṃ, appattaṃ yañ'ca maccunā.
example_2: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) suppakāsito'ti sukathito.

meaning_1: extremely bold; very reckless; excessively impudent
example_1: bhāyāmi nāgadattaṃ suppagabbhaṃ, kulesu vinibaddhaṃ, mā h'eva maccurañño balavato, antakassa vasaṃ upesī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) suppagabbhan'ti suṭṭhu pagabbhaṃ.

example_1: paricitā'ti samantato citā ācitā upacitā. susamāraddhā'ti suppaguṇakaraṇena suṭṭhu samāraddhā.
gopālo suppagedho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

meaning_1: easy to give up; easily abandoned

example_1: suppaṭicchanno antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
commentary: (VINa) suppaṭicchannenā'ti na sasīsaṃ pārutena, atha kho gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā anuvātantena gīvaṃ paṭicchādetvā ubho kaṇṇe samaṃ katvā paṭisaṃharitvā yāva maṇibandhaṃ paṭicchādetvā antaraghare gantabbaṃ. dutiyasikkhāpade, galavāṭakato paṭṭhāya sīsaṃ maṇibandhato paṭṭhāya hatthe piṇḍikamaṃsato ca paṭṭhāya pāde vivaritvā nisīditabbaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, pañc'aṅgikassa tūriyassa suvinītassa suppaṭitāḷitassa sukusalehi samannāhatassa saddo hoti vaggu ca rajanīyo ca khamanīyo ca madanīyo ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, tāsaṃ tālapantīnaṃ vāt'eritānaṃ saddo ahosi vaggu ca rajanīyo ca khamanīyo ca madanīyo ca.
commentary: (DNa) suppaṭitāḷitassā'ti pamāṇe ṭhitabhāvajānan'atthaṃ suṭṭhu paṭitāḷitassa.

meaning_1: fact of giving up easily; fact of relinquishing quickly; fact of abandoning easily
construction:
su + pati + nī + √sajj > sagg + ī + tā
suppaṭinissaggī + tā
example_1: sandiṭṭhiparāmāsi-ādhānaggāhi-duppaṭinissaggissa purisapuggalassa asandiṭṭhiparāmāsi-anādhānaggāhi-suppaṭinissaggitā hoti parikkamanāya.

meaning_1: giving up easily; relinquishing quickly; abandoning easily
example_1: pare sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti, anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
commentary: (MNa) suppaṭinissaggī'ti kiṃ nāma ahaṃ āpanno, kadā āpanno'ti vā tvaṃ āpanno, tava upajjhāyo āpanno'ti vā ekaṃ dve vāre vatvā'pi asukaṃ nāma asukadivase nāma, bhante, āpannattha, saṇikaṃ anussarathā'ti saritvā tāva'd'eva vissajjeti.

meaning_1: gone the right way; practised well
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā. ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
example_2: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho.

meaning_1: fact of going the right way; fact of practising well
construction:
su + pati + √pad + na + tā
suppaṭipanna + tā

meaning_1: totally subsided; internally calmed; completely settled
example_1: yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
example_2: so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho, opakkamikā ce'pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

meaning_1: fact of having completely subsided; fact of (something) having completely settled
construction:
su + pati + pa + √sambh + ta + tta
suppaṭippassaddha + tta
example_1: so kāyaduṭṭhullassa'pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassa'pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa'pi suppaṭivinītattā na andh'andhaṃ viya jhāyati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddh'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

meaning_1: well understood; fully perceived; thoroughly comprehended
example_1: yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā, paravādesu na nīyare, te sambuddhā samma'd'aññā, caranti visame saman'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
example_2: tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manas'ānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sutadhanaṃ
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā'ti atthato ca kāraṇato ca paññāya suṭṭhu paṭividdhā paccakkhaṃ katā.

meaning_1: fact of being thoroughly penetrated; fact of being completely understood (by)
construction:
su + pati + √vidh + ta + tta
suppaṭividdha + tta
example_1: sā hi, rājakumāra, tathāgatassa dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ tathāgataṃ paṭibhātī'ti.
commentary: (MNt) suppaṭividdhattā'ti suṭṭhu paṭividdhabhāvato, sammā adhigatattā'ti attho.

meaning_1: thoroughly removed; totally dispelled; completely subdued
example_1: kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.

meaning_1: fact of (something) being thoroughly removed; having been totally dispelled; fact of being completely subdued
construction:
su + pati + vi + √nī + ta + tta
suppaṭivinīta + tta
example_1: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullam'pi suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti, thinamiddham'pi susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccam'pi suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti. so kāyaduṭṭhullassa'pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassa'pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa'pi suppaṭivinītattā na andh'andhaṃ viya jhāyati.

meaning_1: well disposed; properly inclined; well directed
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāti, n'atthi kho me taṃ pariyuṭṭhānaṃ ajjhattaṃ appahīnaṃ, yen'āhaṃ pariyuṭṭhānena pariyuṭṭhitacitto yathābhūtaṃ nappajāneyyaṃ na passeyyaṃ. suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasaṃ saccānaṃ bodhāyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasan'ti mayhaṃ cittaṃ suṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ.

meaning_1: easy to pay back; easy to recompense (by)
example_1: yaṃ h'ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, imass'ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi
commentary: (ANa) na suppatikāraṃ vadāmī'ti patikāraṃ kātuṃ na sukaran'ti vadāmi. abhivādan'ādīsu anekasatavāraṃ anekasahassavāram'pi hi pañcapatiṭṭhitena nipatitvā vandanto āsanā vuṭṭhāya paccuggacchanto diṭṭhadiṭṭhakkhaṇe añjaliṃ paggaṇhanto anucchavikaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ karonto divase divase cīvarasataṃ cīvarasahassaṃ piṇḍapātasataṃ piṇḍapātasahassaṃ dadamāno cakkavāḷapariyantena sabbaratanamayaṃ āvāsaṃ karonto sappi-navanīt'ādi-nānappakāraṃ bhesajjaṃ anuppadajjamāno n'eva sakkoti ācariyena katassa patikāraṃ nāma kātun'ti evam'attho veditabbo.

meaning_1: well established; firmly grounded; firmly planted; fully centred
example_1: catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo
example_2: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya.

meaning_1: with a mind well established; with a mind fully centred (in)
example_1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacitto, satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.
example_2: santi hi, kandaraka, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sekkhā santatasīlā santatavuttino nipakā nipakavuttino, te catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharanti.
commentary: (MNa) suppatiṭṭhitacittā'ti catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suṭṭhapitacittā hutvā.

meaning_1: having firmly grounded feet; first of the thirty-two marks of a great man; (comm) with flat feet
example_1: suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
commentary: (MNa) suppatiṭṭhitapādo'ti yathā hi aññesaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pādaṃ ṭhapentānaṃ aggatalaṃ vā paṇhi vā passaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ phusati, vemajjhaṃ vā pana chiddaṃ hoti, ukkhipantānam'pi aggatal'ādīsu ekakoṭṭhāso'va paṭhamaṃ uṭṭhahati, na evaṃ tassa. tassa pana suvaṇṇapādukatalaṃ viya ekappahāren'eva sakalaṃ pādatalaṃ bhūmiṃ phusati, bhūmito uṭṭhahati. tasmā suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo'ti vadati.

meaning_1: fact of having firmly grounded feet
construction:
su + patiṭṭhita + pāda + tā
suppatiṭṭhitapāda + tā
example_1: kammasarikkhakaṃ nāma daḷhena hutvā katabhāvaṃ sadevako loko jānātū'ti suppatiṭṭhitapāda-mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ. lakkhaṇaṃ nāma suppatiṭṭhitapādatā. lakkhaṇ'ānisaṃso nāma paccatthikehi avikkhambhanīyatā.
commentary: (DNt) pādānaṃ bhūmiyaṃ samaṃ nikkhipanaṃ, pādatalānaṃ sabbabhāgehi phusanaṃ, samam'eva uddharaṇaṃ, tasmā suṭṭhu samaṃ sabbabhāgehi patiṭṭhitā pādā etassā'ti suppatiṭṭhitapādo, tassa bhāvo suppatiṭṭhitapādatā'ti vuccati lakkhaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: auspicious mark of having firmly grounded feet

example_1: vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatito nāma rājā pitā ahosi. vassavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.

meaning_1: with beautiful banks; with beautiful bathing places
example_1: ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.
commentary: (DNa) suppatitthā'ti sundaratitthā.

example_1: suhutaṃ suyiṭṭhaṃ suppattaṃ, dakkhiṇeyyesu yaṃ kataṃ, yañño ca vipulo hoti, pasīdanti ca devatā.
commentary: (ANa) suppattan'ti suṭṭhu pattaṃ.

meaning_1: easily overwhelmed; easily overcome; easily knocked over (by)
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettācetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.

meaning_1: well rubbed; well washed; thoroughly cleansed (with)
example_1: te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ telena abbhañjitvā sukhumena cuṇṇena tikkhattuṃ suppadhotaṃ karothā'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pabuddha
construction:
su + pa + √budh + ta + aṃ
suppabuddha + aṃ
example_1: suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ buddhagatā sati.
sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo uddhato hoti unnaḷo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākat'indriyo. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo suppameyyo.
commentary: (ANa) sukhena metabbo'ti suppameyyo.

meaning_1: fully engaged; totally devoted; diligently practising
example_1: ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena, nikkāmino gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha, laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

meaning_2: very clear, very pleased, full of faith
example_1: mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā suppasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero, tissatthero arogo hotu app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.
commentary: (MNt) suppasannānī'ti suṭṭhu pasannāni.

meaning_1: easy to overturn; easily tipped over; easily knocked over
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hotī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) suppavattiyo'ti suppavattaniyo. yathā icchit'icchitaṃ disaṃ pavattento dhāvati, evaṃ pavattetuṃ sakkā hotī'ti attho.

example_1: ubhayāni kho pana me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.

meaning_1: tightly woven; with the warp well stretched
example_1: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha
commentary: (VINa) suppavāyitan'ti suṭṭhu pavāyitaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu samaṃ katvā tante pasāritaṃ.

meaning_1: name of a female lay disciple; foremost laywoman in giving fine things; Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā
construction:
su + pa + √vas > vās + *a + ā
suppavāsa + ā
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti.
commentary: (ANa) paṇītadāyikānan'ti paṇītarasadāyikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, suppavāsā koliyadhītā, aggā'ti dasseti. sā kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattā satthu dhammadesanaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsikaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde koliyanagare khattiyakule nibbatti, suppavāsā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sā vayappattā ekassa sakyakumārassa gehaṃ gatā, paṭhamadassane'y'eva satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā sot'āpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi. sā aparabhāge sīvaliṃ nāma dārakaṃ vijāyi. tassa vatthu heṭṭhā vitthāritam'eva. (UDa) suppavāsā'ti tassā upāsikāya nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: well taught; well explained; correctly preached
example_1: evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.

meaning_1: easily abandoned; easy to renounce; easy to give up
example_1: satto guhāyaṃ bahun'ābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.

meaning_1: thoroughly abandoned; completely dispelled; totally eliminated; completely free (from)
example_1: yo ca n'esaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
example_2: t'āmatamadasaṅghasuppahīnā, bhekā mandavatī panādayanti, n'ājja girinadīhi vippavāsasamayo, khemā ajakaraṇī sivā surammā'ti.
commentary: (THa) t'āmatamadasaṅghasuppahīnā'ti amataṃ vuccati agadaṃ, tena majjantī'ti amatamadā, sappā, tesaṃ saṅgho amatamadasaṅgho, tato suṭṭhu pahīnā apagatā.

example_1: tatra su'daṃ suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
commentary: (DNa) suppiyo'ti tassa nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: name of the people previously living on Vepulla mountain
construction:
su + √pī > piy + a + ā
suppiya + ā
example_1: suppiyānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. suppiyā, bhikkhave, manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti, dvīhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

meaning_1: name of a crow in a Jātaka story
construction:
su + √phus > phass + a + ā
suphassa + ā
example_1: tassa dohaḷinī bhariyā, suphassā bhakkhitum'icchati, rañño mahānase pakkaṃ, paccagghaṃ rājabhojanaṃ.
atīva saṅgatā'ti ativiya suṭṭhu saṅgatā suphassitā nibbivarā. idañ'ca sippiviracite kittimarathe labbhamānavisesaṃ tattha āropetvā vuttaṃ.

meaning_2: blossoming beautifully; with a beautiful flower

meaning_1: fully experienced; totally attained; completely realized (by)
example_1: atthi nissaraṇaṃ loke, paññāya me suphussitaṃ, pamattabandhu pāpima, na tvaṃ jānāsi taṃ padaṃ.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.
tasmiñ'ca dhamme sāvako viharati dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, idam'ahaṃ subījasmiṃ vadāmi. kim'aṅgaṃ pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ!

meaning_1: fact of being well awakened; fact of having fully understood

example_1: ye sattasārā anīghā nirāsā, paccekam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ subodhiṃ, tesaṃ visallāna nar'uttamānaṃ, nāmāni me kittayato suṇātha.
āraññiken'āvuso, bhikkhunā saṅghagatena saṅghe viharantena subbacena bhavitabbaṃ kalyāṇamittena.
example_2: purā āgacchate etaṃ, anāgataṃ mahabbhayaṃ, subbacā hotha sakhilā, aññam'aññaṃ sagāravā.
commentary: (THa) subbacā'ti vacanakkhamā sovacassakārakehi dhammehi samannāgatā, garūnaṃ anusāsaniyo padakkhiṇaggāhino hothā'ti attho.
notes: A mispelling with -bb- following the pattern of dubbaca.

meaning_1: easier to instruct; more obedient; more compliant
construction:
su + √vac > bac + a + tara
subbaca + tara
example_1: tatra ce tumhākaṃ evam'assa, imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato c'eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānan'ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ subbacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evam'assa vacanīyo, āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c'eva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.

meaning_1: well rubbed in circles; properly scoured (with)
example_1: te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyaṃ paṇḍumattikāya tikkhattuṃ subbaṭṭitaṃ ubbaṭṭethā'ti.
pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.

meaning_1: virtuous person; one of good conduct; religious person
example_1: udakañ'hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti subbatā.

meaning_1: easily instructed; easily guided; easily converted
example_1: nivissavādī na hi subbināyo, pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito tattha subhaṃ vadāno, suddhiṃvado tattha tath'addasā so.

phonetic:
v > b
a > u (sk ṛ)
st > ṭṭh
example_1: atha naṃ sesajanā, amma, tayā katasassaṃ n'eva accodakena, na anudakena nassati, subbuṭṭhidubbuṭṭhibhāvaṃ ñatvā kammaṃ karosi, kiṃ nu kho etan'ti pucchiṃsu.
notes: The spelling with -bb- is influenced by dubbuṭṭhi, suvuṭṭhi is more correct.

grammar: masc, atta group, irreg, from brahma
example_1: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho subrahmā devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
commentary: (SNt) subrahmā'ti tassa devaputtassa nāmaṃ.

grammar: masc, atta group, irreg, from brahma
example_1: subrahmā paramatto ca, puttā iddhimato saha, sanaṅkumāro tisso ca, s'opāga samitiṃ vanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) subrahmā'ti eko brahmā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
example_2: anattani, bhikkhave, attā'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. asubhe, bhikkhave, subhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
commentary: (SNa) subho'ti sundaro.

example_1: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
example_2: nivissavādī na hi subbināyo, pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito subhaṃ vadāno, suddhiṃvado tattha tath'addasā so.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena subho māṇavo todeyyaputto sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati aññatarassa gahapatissa nivesane kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
commentary: (MNa) subho'ti so kira dassanīyo ahosi pāsādiko, ten'assa aṅgasubhatāya subhotv'eva nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.

meaning_1: name of a heavenly realm; name of a class of deities
example_1: atthi kho, brahme, subhakiṇho nāma kāyo, vehapphalo nāma kāyo, abhibhū nāma kāyo, taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi passāmi.
example_2: subhakiṇhe subhakiṇhato sañjānāti, subhakiṇhe subhakiṇhato saññatvā subhakiṇhe maññati, subhakiṇhesu maññati, subhakiṇhato maññati, subhakiṇhe me'ti maññati, subhakiṇhe abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
commentary: (VIBHa) subhena okiṇṇā vikiṇṇā, subhena sarīrappabhāvaṇṇena ekagghanā, suvaṇṇamañjusāya ṭhapita-sampajjalita-kañcana-piṇḍa-sassirīkā'ti subhakiṇhā.

meaning_1: epithet of a class of devas
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
example_2: so abyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyābajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ek'antasukhaṃ, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā.
commentary: (VIBHa) subhena okiṇṇā vikiṇṇā, subhena sarīrappabhāvaṇṇena ekagghanā, suvaṇṇamañjusāya ṭhapita-sampajjalita-kañcana-piṇḍa-sassirīkā'ti subhakiṇhā.

meaning_1: fact of being a subhakiṇha deity
example_1: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… ābhassarānaṃ ābhassarattena ananubhūtaṃ, subhakiṇhānaṃ subhakiṇhattena ananubhūtaṃ, vehapphalānaṃ vehapphalatte ananubhūtaṃ, abhibhussa abhibhuttena ananubhūtaṃ, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ.
ekam'id'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.
example_2: tassā yo jāyati poso, sūro hoti disampati, tādisā subhagiyā putto, rajjam'pi anusāsatī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) subhagavane'ti ettha subhagattā subhagaṃ, sundarasirikattā sundarakāmattā cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNa) tādisā subhagiyā'ti tādisāya subhariyāya.

meaning_1: creating good luck; good luck charm
example_1: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ
commentary: (DNa) subhagakaraṇan'ti piyamanāpakaraṇaṃ vā sassirīkakaraṇaṃ vā.

meaning_1: name of a wood in Ukkaṭṭhā
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharati subhagavane sālarājamūle. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) subhagañ'ca taṃ vanañ'cā'ti subhagavanaṃ

meaning_1: from Subhaga forest; living in Subhaga wood
example_1: samaṇo gotamo pāpito bhavissatī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, brāhmaṇo, bho gotama, pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko evam'āha, evam'eva pan'idh'ekacce samaṇabrāhmaṇā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ paṭijānanti.
commentary: (MNa) subhagavaniko'ti ukkaṭṭhāya subhagavanassa issaro.

example_1: subhaṭo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

meaning_1: continuously attractive; remaining beautiful; in a state of glory
example_1: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
gihino'pi ijjhati yathā bhaṇato, atha ce pabbajati so manujo, ādiyantissa vacanaṃ janatā, bahuno bahuṃ subhaṇitaṃ bhaṇato'ti.
example_2: bahukā tava dinnābharaṇā, ucc'āvacā subhaṇitamhi, muttāmaṇiveḷuriyā, etaṃ te pacchimakaṃ dānaṃ.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk; last person to get ordained under the Buddha
meaning_2: personal name of an arahant monk; last person to get ordained under the Buddha
family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: aññataro kho pan'āyasmā subhaddo arahataṃ ahosi. so bhagavato pacchimo sakkhisāvako ahosī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) subhaddo nāma paribbājako'ti udiccabrāhmaṇamahāsālakulā pabbajito channaparibbājako.

meaning_1: name of a monk who rejoiced news of the Buddha's death
meaning_2: name of a monk who rejoiced news of the Buddha's death
example_1: atha kho subhaddo vuddhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca, alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha, sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. upaddutā ca homa, idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) subhaddo nāma vuḍḍhapabbajito'ti subhaddo'ti tassa nāmaṃ. vuḍḍhakāle pana pabbajitattā vuḍḍhapabbajito'ti vuccati. kasmā pana so evam'āha? bhagavati āghātena.

example_1: subhaddo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

meaning_2: truly fine; of very good quality; just excellent; highly valuable
example_1: bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti.

meaning_1: story of Subhadda the wandering ascetic
meaning_2: the story of Subhadda the wandering ascetic

meaning_1: name of a queen; wife of king Mahāsudassana
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītiitthisahassāni ahesuṃ subhaddādevippamukhāni.

meaning_1: with queen Subhaddā as the foremost (among them)
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītiitthisahassāni ahesuṃ subhaddādevippamukhāni.

meaning_1: state of beauty; element of attractiveness

meaning_1: story of the young Brahman Subha

meaning_1: fact of being easy to support; fact of being low maintenance

meaning_1: easy to support; easy to maintain

example_1: subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.

example_2: anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.
commentary: (ANa) subhāsitenā'ti subhāsitakathanena.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of subhāsita
meaning_1: as good speech; as eloquent words

meaning_1: to know the meaning of what is well spoken and what is badly spoken
example_1: so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo, nappaṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānam'attham'aññātuṃ. ayaṃ aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.

commentary: (ANa) subhāsitaṃ dhajo etesan'ti subhāsitadhajā.

meaning_1: beautiful and ugly; attractive and repulsive

yathā agāraṃ suchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati, evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhati.
example_2: ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañc'indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni. katamasmiṃ ekadhamme? appamāde.

example_1: yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.
example_2: gacchatha, tātā, pabbatapādaṃ pavisitvā jīvantā subhikkhakāle mama santikaṃ āgantu'kāmā āgacchatha, anāgantu'kāmā tattha tatth'eva jīvathā'ti.

meaning_1: abundance of food; prosperity; enough food to eat

meaning_1: with beautiful arms; having strong arms
example_1: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in living without conflict; foremost monk worthy of gifts
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: atha kho āyasmā subhūti saddhena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti.
commentary: (THa) subhūtī'ti nāmakittanaṃ. so hi sarīrasampattiyā'pi dassanīyo pāsādiko, guṇasampattiyā'pi. iti sundarāya sarīr'āvayavavibhūtiyā sīlasampattiy'ādivibhūtiyā ca samannāgatattā subhūtī'ti paññāyittha
notes: Theragāthā verse 1 (TH1.1, TH1) is attributed to him.

family_set: names of arahants; names of monks

commentary: (PMa) subhūtitthero pana ayaṃ micchāpaṭipadā, ayaṃ sammāpaṭipadā'ti dhammavasen'eva dhammaṃ desesi. ten'eva bhagavā taṃ'y'eva araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti ca vaṇṇesi, etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūtī'ti (a. ni. 1.198, 201) ca araṇavihārīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesī'ti.
notes: Theragāthā verse 1 (TH1.1, TH1) is attributed to him.

meaning_1: with good earth; having fertile soil
example_1: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha sukhette subhūme suvihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhapeyya akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avāt'ātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni. devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo.

meaning_1: seeing the sights; looking at the scenery
meaning_2: seeing the sights; looking at the scenery

sumajjhanha + ika
example_1: ye, bhikkhave, sattā majjh'anhikasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, sumajjh'anhiko, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.

meaning_1: paid good attention to; well attended to; applied the mind well

example_2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi, sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni

commentary: (ANa) sumanā rājakumārī'ti mahāsakkāraṃ katvā patthanaṃ patthetvā evaṃ laddhanāmā rājakaññā. vipassi-sammāsambuddha-kālasmiṃ hi nāgaresu yuddham'pi katvā satthāraṃ amhākaṃ gaṇhissāmā'ti senāpatiṃ nissāya buddhappamukhaṃ saṅghaṃ labhitvā paṭipāṭiyā puññāni kātuṃ āraddhesu sabbapaṭhamadivaso senāpatissa vāro ahosi. tasmiṃ divase senāpati mahādānaṃ sajjetvā ajja yathā añño koci ekabhikkham'pi na deti, evaṃ rakkhathā'ti samantā purise ṭhapesi. taṃdivasaṃ seṭṭhibhariyā rodamānā pañcahi kumārikāsatehi saddhiṃ kīḷitvā āgataṃ dhītaraṃ āha, sace, amma, tava pitā jīveyya, ajj'āhaṃ paṭhamaṃ dasabalaṃ bhojeyyan'ti. sā taṃ āha, amma, mā cintayi, ahaṃ tathā karissāmi, yathā buddhappamukho saṅgho amhākaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhikkhaṃ bhuñjissatī'ti. tato satasahassagghanikāya suvaṇṇapātiyā nirudakapāyāsaṃ pūretvā sappimadhusakkhar'ādīhi abhisaṅkharitvā aññissā pātiyā paṭikujjitvā taṃ sumanamālāguḷehi parikkhipitvā mālāguḷasadisaṃ katvā bhagavato gāmaṃ pavisanavelāya sayam'eva ukkhipitvā dhātigaṇaparivutā gharā nikkhami.

meaning_1: giving good counsel; discussing good topics
example_1: sumantamantino dhīrā, tuṇhībhūtā samañ'carā, devā viruddhā asurehi, puthu maccā ca mātali.
commentary: (SNa) sumantamantino'ti dhammaṃ sajjhāyissāma, dhut'aṅgaṃ samādiyissāma, amataṃ paribhuñjissāma, samaṇadhammaṃ karissāmā'ti evaṃ subhāsitabhāsino.

example_1: addasā kho āyasmā ānando jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ. setā sudaṃ assā yuttā honti set'ālaṅ'kārā, seto ratho, setaparivāro, setā rasmiyo, setā patodalaṭṭhi, setaṃ chattaṃ, setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ, setāni vatthāni, setā upāhanā, setāya sudaṃ vālabījaniyā bījīyati.

commentary: (DHPa) vanañ'ca vanathañ'cā'ti ettha mahantā rukkhā vanaṃ nāma, khuddakā tasmiṃ vane ṭhitattā vanathā nāma. pubbuppattikarukkhā vā vanaṃ nāma, aparāparuppattikā vanathā nāma.
notes: see vanatha 2

example_1: yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.
example_2: yassa vanathajā na santi keci, vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) evam'eva mahantamahantā bhavākaḍḍhanakā kilesā vanaṃ nāma, pavattiyaṃ vipākadāyakā vanathā nāma. pubbappattikā vanaṃ nāma, aparāparuppattikā vanathā nāma.
notes: see vanatha 1

meaning_1: born from desire; born from craving
example_1: yassa vanathajā na santi keci, vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) yassa vanathajā'ti ettha'pi darathajā viya vanathajā veditabbā. vacan'atthe pana ayaṃ viseso, vanute, vanotī'ti vā vanaṃ yācati sevati bhajatī'ti attho. taṇhāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sā hi visayānaṃ patthanato sevanato ca vanan'ti vuccati.

example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.
commentary: (MNa) dāyo'ti avisesena araññass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

example_1: atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi
commentary: (MNa) vanadevatā'ti andhavanasubhagavan'ādīsu vanesu adhivatthā devatā.

meaning_1: forest region; edge of the forest
example_1: ek'āsanaṃ ekaseyyaṃ, eko caram'atandito, eko damayam'attānaṃ, van'ante ramito siyā.
example_2: sa jhānapasuto dhīro, van'ante ramito siyā, jhāyetha rukkhamūlasmiṃ, attānam'abhitosayaṃ.

meaning_1: inner forest; dense forest; deep jungle
example_1: kakusandho mahāvīro, sabbadhammāna pāragū, gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho so, agamāsi van'antaraṃ.
commentary: (DNt) vanassa antaraṃ vivaraṃ van'antaraṃ

meaning_1: forest; woodland plain; (comm) uncultivated land beyond the outskirts of the village
meaning_2: place far away in the forest
example_1: dv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi. katame dve? attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno.
example_2: tassa taṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati na upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ'ca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā na parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ n'ānupāpuṇāti.
commentary: (ANa) vanapatthan'ti atikkamitvā manussānaṃ upacāraṭṭhānaṃ, yattha na kasanti na vapanti. ten'ev'āha vanapatthan'ti dūrānam'etaṃ sen'āsanānaṃ adhivacanan'tiādi. (MNa) vanesu patthaṃ gahanaṭṭhāne sen'āsanaṃ vanapatthaṃ.

example_1: vanapatthapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) vanapatthapariyāyan'ti vanapatthakāraṇaṃ, vanapatthadesanaṃ vā.

example_1: vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

meaning_2: big tree which bears fruit without flowers
sanskrit: vanaspati, śākhin, vṛkṣa, pādapa, mahīruha, kuja, aga, taru, druma
example_1: atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi
example_2: vanappati nāma yo manussānaṃ pariggahito hoti rukkho paribhogo. theyyacitto chindati, pahāre pahāre āpatti dukkaṭassa.
commentary: (MNa) osadhitiṇavanappatīsū'ti harītakīāmalakī'ādīsu osadhīsu tālanāḷiker'ādīsu tiṇesu vanajeṭṭhakesu ca vanappatirukkhesu adhivatthā devatā. (ANa) vanappatī'ti vanajeṭṭhakā.

meaning_1: forest; woodland plain; (comm) uncultivated land outside the village
example_1: catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu n'ālaṃ araññavanappatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevituṃ. katamehi catūhi? kāmavitakkena, byāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, duppañño hoti jaḷo elamūgo
example_2: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
commentary: (MNa) vanapatthan'ti atikkamitvā manussānaṃ upacāraṭṭhānaṃ, yattha na kasanti na vapanti. (MNa) vanesu patthaṃ gahanaṭṭhāne sen'āsanaṃ vanapatthaṃ.
(ANa) vanabhaṅgenā'ti vanato bhañjitvā āhaṭena pupphaphal'ādipaṇṇākārena.

meaning_1: middle of the wood; centre of the forest
example_1: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanamajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.
example_2: kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) vehāyasā te vanamajjhappattā'ti te ākāsen'eva imaṃ mahāvanaṃ sampattā.

meaning_1: gone to the middle of the wood; entered amidst the forest
example_1: kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.

meaning_1: reached the middle of the wood
example_1: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) vehāyasā te vanamajjhappattā'ti te ākāsen'eva imaṃ mahāvanaṃ sampattā.
notes: Alternativly, vanamajjha + patta.

example_1: yo nibbanatho van'ādhimutto, vanamutto vanam'eva dhāvati, taṃ puggalam'etha passatha, mutto bandhanam'eva dhāvati.

meaning_1: eating roots and fruits of the forest
example_1: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
example_2: te tattha sākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, sāmākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, nīvārabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, daddulabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, haṭabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, kaṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, ācāmabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, piññākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, tiṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, gomayabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, vanamūlaphal'āhārā yāpesuṃ pavattaphalabhojī.

meaning_1: entering the forest; plunging into the wood
example_1: sojja bhaddo anutrāsī, pahīnabhayabheravo, jhāyati vanam'ogayha, putto godhāya bhaddiyo.
example_2: kānanaṃ vanam'ogayha, vasāmi vipine ahaṃ, vipassiṃ addasaṃ buddhaṃ, āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ.

meaning_1: delightfulness of a wood; loveliness of a grove
example_1: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti.
example_2: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti
commentary: (ANa) vanarāmaṇeyyakan'ti nāgavana-sālavana-campakavan'ādi-sadisaṃ vaṅkapabbata-himavantapabbata-pades'ādīsu araññavanaṃ veditabbaṃ.

example_1: ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) vanaropā'ti sayaṃjāte aropimavane sīmaṃ parikkhipitvā cetiya-bodhi-caṅkamana-maṇḍapa-kuṭi-leṇa-rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭṭhānānaṃ kārakā chāy'ūpage rukkhe ropetvā dadamānā'pi vanaropāy'eva nāma.

meaning_lit: discourse on the planter of forests

example_1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe
example_2: tatth'addasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañ'ca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñ'ca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
commentary: (THa) vanasaṇḍamhī'ti vanagahane, ghana-nicita-rukkha-gaccha-latā-samūhe vane'ti attho.

example_1: tam'anugacchanto addasaṃ purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. taṃ, bhante, nagaraṃ māpehī'ti.

meaning_2: big tree which bears fruit without flowers
sanskrit: vanaspati, śākhin, vṛkṣa, pādapa, mahīruha, kuja, aga, taru, druma

meaning_1: resorted to the forest; living in the wood
example_1: na yattha gītaṃ na'pi yattha vāditaṃ, eko araññe van'avassito muni, accherarūpaṃ paṭibhāti maṃ idaṃ, yadekako pītimano vane vase.
commentary: (SNa) van'avassito munī'ti vanaṃ avassito buddhamuni.

meaning_1: inclined to the forest; inclined to the monk's life
example_1: yo nibbanatho van'ādhimutto, vanamutto vanam'eva dhāvati, taṃ puggalam'etha passatha, mutto bandhanam'eva dhāvati.

meaning_1: who lives in the forest; living in the wood
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīhassa migarañño nadato saddaṃ suṇanti, yebhuyyena bhayaṃ saṃvegaṃ santāsaṃ āpajjanti, bilaṃ bil'āsayā pavisanti, dakaṃ dak'āsayā pavisanti, vanaṃ van'āsayā pavisanti, ākāsaṃ pakkhino bhajanti.
commentary: (SNa) van'āsayā'ti vanavāsino hatthi-assa-gokaṇṇa-mig'ādayo.

example_1: yo brāhmaṇaṃ samaṇaṃ vā, aññaṃ vā'pi vanibbakaṃ, musāvādena vañceti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
example_2: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) vanibbakā'ti ye, iṭṭhaṃ, dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena, anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'ti-ādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti.

example_1: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, sirī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī. tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇaddhika-vanibbakayācakānaṃ. atha kho maṃ, bhante, itthāgāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati.
commentary: (SNa) vanibbakā'ti ye iṭṭhaṃ, dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena, anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'tiādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti. yācakā'ti ye pasatamattaṃ detha, sarāvamattaṃ dethā'ti-ādīni ca vatvā yācamānā vicaranti.

meaning_1: living in the forest; of the wood
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraññakānaṃ yadidaṃ revato khadiravaniyo.
commentary: (ANa) revato khadiravaniyo'ti dhammasenāpatittherassa kaniṭṭhabhātiko. so yathā aññe therā araññe vasamānā vanasabhāgaṃ udakasabhāgaṃ bhikkhācārasabhāgañ'ca sallakkhetvā araññe vasan'ti, na evaṃ vasi. etāni pana sabhāgāni anādiyitvā ujjaṅgalasakkharapāsāṇavisame khadiravane paṭivasati. tasmā āraññakānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti?
example_2: evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante.
commentary: (MNa) vante'ti taṃ vantaṃ.
notes: See SCPN §10 (Eastern Forms)

example_1: taṇhā avijjā ca piy'āpiyañ'ca, subhāni rūpāni sukhā ca vedanā, manāpiyā kāmaguṇā ca vantā, vante ahaṃ āvamituṃ na ussahe.
example_2: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
notes: See SCPN §10 (Eastern Forms)

meaning_2: who has left behind all fault
example_1: yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.
commentary: (DHPa) vantakasāvassā'ti catūhi maggehi vantakasāvo chaḍḍitakasāvo pahīnakasāvo assa. (JAa) yo ca vantakasāvassā'ti yo pana puggalo yathāvuttasseva kasāvassa vantattā vantakasāvo assa.

meaning_1: free from ill-will; without aversion; purged of hatred
example_1: yassa c'etaṃ samucchinnaṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ samūhataṃ, sa vantadoso medhāvī, sādhurūpo'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: free from faults; without wrong; purged of defect
example_1: yassa c'etaṃ samucchinnaṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ samūhataṃ, sa vantadoso medhāvī, sādhurūpo'ti vuccati.
yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo, sa ve vantamalo dhīro, thero iti pavuccati.

meaning_1: free from worldliness; disgorged the bait of the world
example_1: akathaṃkathissa tusitassa, vantalok'āmisassa muditassa, katasamaṇassa manujassa, antimasārīrassa narassa, anopamassa virajassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
commentary: (MNa) vantalok'āmisassā'ti vantakāmaguṇassa

meaning_1: vomited one's food; given up hope
example_1: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.
notes: see vantāsa 2

meaning_1: free from desire; given up all wants
example_1: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.
commentary: (DHPa) catūhi maggehi kattabbakiccassa katattā, sabbā āsā iminā vantā'ti vant'āso.
notes: see vantāsa 1

meaning_1: who has given up; who has renounced; who has cast off

meaning_2: heap of what is thrown up by ants

grammar: pp, nt nom sg of vanta
example_1: aduñ'hi, bhante, bhattaṃ paṭikūlasammatan'ti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante.
commentary: (MNa) se vante'ti taṃ vantaṃ. aṭṭhasamāpattilābhino hi heṭṭhāsamāpattiyo vantasadisā hutvā upaṭṭhahanti, puna samāpajjissāmī'ti cittaṃ na uppajjati. ten'etaṃ vuttaṃ.
notes: See SCPN §10 (Eastern Forms)

example_1: tassā te svāgataṃ bhadde, tato te adurāgataṃ, evañ'hi dantā āyanti, satthu pādāni vandikā, vītarāgā visaṃyuttā, katakiccā anāsavā.
example_2: pūjako labhate pūjaṃ, vandako paṭivandanaṃ, yaso kittiñ'ca pappoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
commentary: (JAa) vandako'ti buddh'ādīnaṃ kalyāṇamittānaṃ vandako hutvā punabbhave paṭivandanaṃ labhati.

example_1: samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.
example_2: taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.
commentary: (SNPa) vandati satthuno'ti evaṃ bhaṇanto gopphakesu pariggahetvā pañcapatiṭṭhitaṃ vandi.

example_1: āraddhavīriye pahit'atte, niccaṃ daḷhaparakkame, samagge sāvake passa, etaṃ buddhāna'vandanaṃ.
example_2: vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.
commentary: (THIa) vandanaṃ dāni me vajjāsī'ti mama vandanaṃ vadeyyāsi, mama vacanena lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ vadeyyāsī'ti attho.

meaning_1: for the sake of worship; for the sake of adoration
example_1: āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.
āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

meaning_1: made of reverence; composed of devotion
meaning_2: made of devotion; composed of reverence
example_1: iti me pasannamatino, ratanattayavandanāmayaṃ puññaṃ, yaṃ suvihatantarāyo, hutvā tass'ānubhāvena.
example_2: yadi'pi taṃ vandanāmayaṃ puññaṃ pavattikkhaṇavasena parittaṃ, khettamahantatāya pana phalamahantatāya ca ativiya mahantam'evā'ti āha pahūtakatakalyāṇā'ti.
commentary: (DNt) vandīyate vandanā, sā'va vandanāmayaṃ yathā dānamayaṃ sīlamayan'ti. vandanā c'ettha kāya-vācā-cittehi tiṇṇaṃ ratanānaṃ guṇaninnatā, thomanā vā. apica tassā cetanāya sahajātādopakāreko saddhāpaññāsativīriy'ādi-sampayuttadhammo vandanā, tāya pakatan'ti vandanāmayaṃ yathā sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayan'ti, atthato pana yathāvuttacetanā'va.

example_1: candaṃ yathā khay'ātītaṃ, pecca pañjalikā janā, vandamānā namassanti, lokasmiṃ gotamaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) vandamāno namassāmi namo karomi.

synonym: apacita, garukata, pūjita, vandita, sakkata, sammata

meaning_1: related to wisdom; pertaining to understanding; playing a part in knowledge

commentary: (MNa) vijjābhāgiyā'ti ettha sampayogavasena vijjaṃ bhajantī'ti vijjābhāgiyā. vijjābhāge vijjākoṭṭhāse vattantī'ti'pi vijjābhāgiyā. (ANa) vijjābhāgiyā'ti vijjākoṭṭhāsikā.

meaning_1: who makes an end through understanding

meaning_1: attainment of wisdom; achievement of understanding

meaning_1: endowed with knowledge; accomplished in understanding; perfect in wisdom
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako vijjāsampanno iti'pi caraṇasampanno iti'pi vijjācaraṇasampanno iti'pi.
commentary: (MNa) vijjāsampanno iti'pī'ti tīhi vijjāhi vijjāsampanno iti'pi.

meaning_1: liberation and understanding; release and discernment; (or) emancipation through wisdom
example_1: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
example_2: vijjāvimuttim'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro vijjāvimuttiyā? satta bojjh'aṅgā'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ
commentary: (ANa) vijjāvimuttin'ti phalañāṇañ'c'eva sesasampayuttadhamme ca.

meaning_1: for personal experience of the fruit of liberation and understanding

construction:
vijjāvimutti + phalasacchikiriya + attha + aṃ

example_1: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha… vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriy'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti…
commentary: (SNt) vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriy'atthan'ti ettha vijjā'ti aggamaggavijjā. vimuttī'ti aggamaggasamādhi adhippeto. tesaṃ phalaṃ aññā'ti āha, vijjāvimuttiphalena arahattaṃ kathitan'ti.

meaning_1: personal experience of the fruit of liberation and understanding
example_1: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
commentary: (ANa) vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāyā'ti vijjāvimuttīnaṃ phalassa paccavekkhakaraṇ'atthāya. ettha ca vijjā'ti maggapaññā, vimuttī'ti taṃsampayuttā sesadhammā. tesaṃ phalaṃ nāma arahattaphalaṃ, tassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti attho.

meaning_1: for the purpose of (experiencing) the fruit of release and discernment; (or) for the benefit of (experiencing) the fruit of liberation through understanding
example_1: so tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsañ'c'eva kathaṃ kathente upārambh'ānisaṃsañc'a, bhavaṃ pana gotamo kim'ānisaṃso viharatī'ti? vijjāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃso kho, kuṇḍaliya, tathāgato viharatī'ti.
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā
example_2: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, pukkusa, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā'ti?
example_2: dharaṇī ca siñcati vāti, māluto vijjutā carati nabhe, upasamanti vitakkā, cittaṃ susamāhitaṃ mamā'ti.
commentary: (THa) vijjutā carati nabhe'ti tattha tattha gajjatā gaḷagaḷāyatā mahāmeghato niccharantiyo sateratā ākāse ito c'ito ca vicaranti.

meaning_1: flash of lightning; streak of lightning
example_1: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

meaning_1: with the appearance of a flash of lightning
example_1: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

meaning_1: arising of understanding; birth of wisdom; appearance of knowledge
example_1: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti? avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijj'uppādā taṇhānirodhā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti.
example_2: idh'assa, vappa, kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā. passasi no tvaṃ, vappa, taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan'ti?
commentary: (ANa) vijj'uppādā'ti maggavijjāya uppādena.

meaning_1: wreathed in lightning; garlanded with lightning
example_1: yathā hi megho thanayaṃ, vijjumālī satakkaku, thalaṃ ninnañ'ca pūreti, abhivassaṃ vasun'dharaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) vijjumālī'ti mālāsadisāya meghamukhe carantiyā vijjulatāya samannāgato.

meaning_1: forks of lightning; flashes of lightning
example_1: idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā

commentary: (ADha) puna anajjhottharaṇabhāvena kilesandhakāraṃ viddhaṃsetuṃ asamatthatāya vijju upamā etesan'ti vijj'ūpamā.

example_1: tayo'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo? aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo, vijj'ūpamacitto puggalo, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo.
commentary: (ANa) vijj'ūpamacitto'ti ittarakāl'obhāsanena vijjusadisacitto.

example_1: tā disvā māṇavo kim'etan'ti ito c'ito ca vilokento addasa bhagavantaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ sant'indriyaṃ dvattiṃsāya mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi asītiyā anubyañjanehi byāmappabhāya ketumālāya ca vijjotamānaṃ anupamāya buddhasiriyā acinteyyena buddh'ānubhāvena virocamānaṃ.
synonym: obhāsayanta, jalamāna, jotayanta, tapanta, tapamāna, virocamāna, sobhamāna

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
commentary: (MNa) vijjotalantesū'ti viparivattantesu.

example_1: tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, sarapattāni ca gattāni vilekheyyuṃ.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisaṃ sallena vijjheyya. tam'enaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ vijjheyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso dvisallena vedanaṃ vedayati.

example_1: te tattha usūhi'pi vijjhanti, sattiyā'pi vijjhanti, asinā'pi sīsaṃ chindanti. te tattha maraṇam'pi nigacchanti, maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.
ettha tuttaṃ vuccati kaṇṇamūle vijjhana-ayadaṇḍako. tomaran'ti pād'ādīsu vijjhanadaṇḍatomaraṃ.
agamāsi kho, bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ padesaṃ. tam'enaṃ luddo papatāya vijjhi.

meaning_1: to shoot; to hit a target
example_1: ṭhānakusalo'ti yena ṭhānena ṭhito avirādhetvā vijjhituṃ sakkoti, tasmiṃ ṭhāne kusalo. sesaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ.
