tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, luddo vijjhitvā tasmiṃ'y'eva kaṭṭhakat'aṅgāre avassajjetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati. evaṃ so taṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.
sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā, adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti, assutaṃ sutaṃ me'ti, amutaṃ mutaṃ me'ti
commentary: (VINa) vācasikā viññattī'ti vacīviññatti.

example_1: abandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji na hoti. bandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji hoti. navo nāma patto viññattiṃ upādāya vuccati.

meaning_1: asking too much; begging a lot
example_1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti, gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilān'upaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā'ti. jīvako'pi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.
commentary: (VINa) yācanā eva bahulā etesaṃ mandaṃ aññaṃ kamman'ti yācanabahulā. evaṃ viññattibahulā veditabbā. atthato pan'ettha nānākaraṇaṃ n'atthi, anekakkhattuṃ purisaṃ detha, puris'atthakaraṃ dethā'ti yācantānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tattha mūlacchejjāya purisaṃ yācituṃ na vaṭṭati, sahāy'atthāya kammakaraṇ'atthāya purisaṃ dethā'ti yācituṃ vaṭṭati.
(VINa) viññatti bahulā etāsan'ti viññattibahulā. viññattī'ti het'ūdāharaṇ'ādīhi vividhehi nayehi ñāpanā veditabbā, na yācanā.

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… viññatvā viññātabbaṃ, viññātaṃ na maññati, aviññātaṃ na maññati, viññātabbaṃ na maññati, viññātāraṃ na maññati.

meaning_1: will comprehend; will understand; will recognize; will distinguish
example_1: atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī, upamā viññūhi desitā, viññassanti mahānāgā, nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) viññassanti… vijānissanti.

meaning_1: awareness; consciousness; cognition; mind; fifth of the five aggregates
example_1: viññāṇaṃ viññāṇan'ti, āvuso, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, viññāṇan'ti vuccatī'ti? vijānāti vijānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇan'ti vuccati.
example_2: ettha dīghañ'ca rassañ'ca, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, etthamañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, viññāṇassa nirodhena, etth'etaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.

example_1: vīmaṃsakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena tathāgate samannesanā kātabbā sammāsambuddho vā no vā iti viññāṇāyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) iti viññāṇāyā'ti evaṃ vijānan'atthāya.

meaning_lit: discourse on not making consciousness evident
sanskrit: vijñāna + na + prātyakṣa + karman + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇ'āyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ viññāṇakasiṇaṃ eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. evaṃsaññino'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā.
etaṃ vā pan'ekesaṃ upātivattataṃ viññāṇakasiṇam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ. ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato abhijānāti.
commentary: (MNa) tattha viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ tāva dassetuṃ viññāṇakasiṇam'eke'ti vuttaṃ. parato ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke'ti vakkhati.

meaning_1: classes of consciousness; categories of awareness
example_1: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
example_2: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: aggregate of consciousness; mass of awareness; fifth of the five aggregates
example_1: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

meaning_1: related to consciousness; concerning awareness; connected with sentience; kind of consciousness
example_1: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
commentary: (ANa) rūpam'eva rūpagataṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ neyyan'ti.
example_2: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
commentary: (VISM) viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti ettha pana n'āssa anto'ti anantaṃ. anantam'eva ānañcaṃ. viññāṇaṃ ānañcaṃ viññāṇ'ānañcan'ti avatvā viññāṇ'añcan'ti vuttaṃ. ayañ'h'ettha rūḷhīsaddo. taṃ viññāṇ'añcaṃ adhiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena āyatanamassa sasampayuttadhammassa jhānassa devānaṃ dev'āyatanam'ivā'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ.

meaning_1: state of the dimension of infinite consciousness; element of the dimension of infinite consciousness
example_1: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?
commentary: (SNa) rūpaṃ paṭiccā'ti rūp'āvacarasamāpattiṃ paṭicca. rūp'āvacarasamāpattiyā hi sati ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpatti nāma hoti rūpasamatikkamo vā, tasmā evam'āha. viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātuādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: dependent on the dimension of infinite consciousness; based on the dimension of infinite consciousness
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about the dimension of infinite consciousness

meaning_1: having the dimension of infinite consciousness as peak; with the dimension of infinite consciousness as apex
example_1: sabbaso vā pana ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, muditācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
commentary: (SNa) muditāvihārissa pana tena tena pāmojjakāraṇena uppannapāmojjasattānaṃ viññāṇaṃ samanupassantassa muditāya pavattisambhavato viññāṇaggahaṇaparicitaṃ hoti, ath'assa anukkam'ādhigataṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ atikkamma ākāsanimittagocare viññāṇe cittaṃ upasaṃharato appakasiren'eva tattha cittaṃ pakkhandati. iti muditā viññāṇ'añc'āyatanassa upanissayo hoti, na tato paraṃ, tasmā viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaparamā'ti vuttā.

meaning_1: recognition of dimension of infinite consciousness; perception of dimension of infinite consciousness (in)
example_1: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti

meaning_1: aware of the dimension of infinite consciousness; percipient of the dimension of infinite consciousness (in)
example_1: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… na ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññī assa, na viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññī assa
commentary: (ADha) viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-saññā-sahagatan'ti, ettha pana anantan'ti manasikātabbavasena n'āssa anto'ti anantaṃ. anantam'eva ānañcaṃ. viññāṇaṃ ānañcaṃ viññāṇ'ānañcan'ti avatvā viññāṇ'añcan'ti vuttaṃ. ayañ'h'ettha rūḷhīsaddo.

meaning_1: attainment of the dimension of infinite consciousness
example_1: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino'ti. so tāya viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
example_2: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayam'pi kho viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

meaning_1: associated with the dimension of infinite consciousness; connected with the base of infinity of consciousness
example_1: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato viññāṇ'añc'āyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

meaning_1: refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
meaning_2: refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
example_1: tassa yā purimā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_1: with a refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
meaning_2: with refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
example_1: tassa yā purimā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_lit: discourse on the dimension of infinite consciousness

meaning_1: gone to the dimension of infinite consciousness; epithet of a class of devas
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā viññāṇ'añc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā viññāṇ'añc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

meaning_1: station of consciousness; plane of awareness
example_1: viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbā, abhijānaṃ tathāgato, tiṭṭhantam'enaṃ jānāti, vimuttaṃ tapparāyaṇaṃ.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātu, evaṃ catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo daṭṭhabbā. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āpodhātu, evaṃ nandirāgo daṭṭhabbo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni, evaṃ viññāṇaṃ sāhāraṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
commentary: (DN 33) catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. rūp'ūpāyaṃ… vedan'ūpāyaṃ… saññ'ūpāyaṃ… saṅkhār'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.

example_1: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti
commentary: (SNa) yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati
notes: see viññāṇatta 2

example_1: evam'eva kho, bho gotama… saṅkhār'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo saṅkhāresu patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati, viññāṇ'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo viññāṇe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavatī'ti.
notes: see viññāṇatta 1

example_1: cha'y'imā, āvuso, dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katamā cha? pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu
example_2: pathavīdhātū'ti patiṭṭhānadhātu. āpodhātū'ti ābandhanadhātu. tejodhātū'ti paripācanadhātu. vāyodhātū'ti vitthambhanadhātu. ākāsadhātū'ti asamphuṭṭhadhātu viññāṇadhātū'ti vijānanadhātu.
commentary: (DNa) viññāṇadhātū'ti vijānanadhātu.

meaning_1: dependent on the mind; supported by consciousness; based on mentality
example_1: viññāṇadhātuṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, na attato upagacchiṃ, na ca viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ.
example_2: ye ca viññāṇadhātunissitā upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.

example_1: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of awareness; cessation of consciousness
example_1: tāsaṃ ce, āvuso, naḷakalāpīnaṃ ekaṃ ākaḍḍheyya, ekā papateyya, aparaṃ ce ākaḍḍheyya, aparā papateyya. evam'eva kho, āvuso, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho
example_2: nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.

meaning_1: path of practice leading to the cessation of consciousness
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

meaning_1: leading to the cessation of consciousness
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
example_2: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako viññāṇañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

example_1: evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of viññāṇapaccaya
meaning_1: dependent on consciousness; due to consciousness
example_1: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ viññāṇapaccayā, viññāṇ'ūpasamā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
example_2: avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā

meaning_1: produced by consciousness; generated by conscious awareness
example_1: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

meaning_1: imprisoned by consciousness; held captive by felt awareness
meaning_lit: bound with the bond of consciousness
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano viññāṇabandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

meaning_1: class of consciousness; type of awareness
example_1: ajjhattikañc'eva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n'eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
commentary: (MNa) viññāṇabhāgassā'ti viññāṇakoṭṭhāsassa.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in consciousness; delighting in awareness
example_1: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: freed by the exhaustion of consciousness; liberated through the dissolution of awareness
example_1: viññāṇasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.
notes: saṅkhāvimutta is the preferable reading

meaning_1: free from classification in terms of consciousness
example_1: yena viññāṇe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ viññāṇaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tāl'āvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ. viññāṇasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

meaning_1: source of consciousness; arising of consciousness
example_1: nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.
example_2: viññāṇasamudayā nāmarūpasamudayo, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo nāmarūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā

meaning_1: with consciousness as source; originating from awareness
example_1: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) viññāṇasamudayā'ti ettha pana yaṃ viññāṇaṃ yassa nāmassa yassa ca rūpassa yassa ca nāmarūpassa paccayo hoti, tassa vasena visuddhimagge paṭiccasamuppādaniddese vuttanayen'eva viññāṇasamudayā nāmarūpasamudayo veditabbo.

meaning_1: happy with consciousness; pleased with awareness
example_1: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: accompanied by consciousness; sentient; filled with awareness
example_1: evam'eva kho, rājañña, yadā'yaṃ kāyo āyusahagato ca hoti usmāsahagato ca viññāṇasahagato ca, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.

meaning_1: stream of consciousness; flow of awareness
example_1: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati. purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti, ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke patiṭṭhitañca paraloke patiṭṭhitañ'ca. ayaṃ tatiyā dassanasamāpatti.
commentary: (DNa) viññāṇasotan'ti viññāṇam'eva. (DNt) avicchedena pavattiyā sotasadisatāya viññāṇam'eva viññāṇasotaṃ

example_1: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ, mama viññāṇan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
commentary: (PM) kathaṃ viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati? idh'ekacco rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho me attā. so kho pana me ayaṃ attā iminā viññāṇena viññāṇavā'ti. viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. seyyathā'pi rukkho chāyāsampanno assa. tam'enaṃ puriso evaṃ vadeyya, ayaṃ rukkho, ayaṃ chāyā. añño rukkho, aññā chāyā. so kho pan'āyaṃ rukkho imāya chāyāya chāyāvā'ti. chāyāvantaṃ rukkhaṃ samanupassati. evam'evaṃ idh'ekacco rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho me attā. so kho pana me ayaṃ attā iminā viññāṇena viññāṇavā'ti. viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.

example_1: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā. evaṃ kho, gahapati, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca.

meaning_1: produced by rolling around after the change of consciousness
example_1: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

meaning_1: born from rolling around after the change of consciousness
example_1: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.
commentary: (SNa) vipariṇām'ānuparivattijā'ti vipariṇāmassa anuparivattito vipariṇām'ārammaṇacittato jātā.

meaning_1: rolling around after the change of consciousness
example_1: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

meaning_1: (abhi) sequence of conscious events; series of consciousness
example_1: me sutan'ti ettha mayā-sadd'attho me-saddo, sotadvāraviññāṇ'attho sutasaddo. tasmā evaṃ me sutan'ti evaṃ mayā sotaviññāṇapubbaṅ'gamāya viññāṇavīthiyā upadhāritan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: fact of impermanence of consciousness; fact of instability of awareness
example_1: viññāṇaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, viññāṇ'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. viññāṇaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto, viññāṇ'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

meaning_lit: discourse on not making consciousness evident
sanskrit: vijñāna + na + prātyakṣa + karman + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

meaning_1: field of consciousness; dimension of knowing
example_1: kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasi? mam'eva, samaṇa, sotaṃ, mama saddā … mam'eva, samaṇa, ghānaṃ, mama gandhā, mam'eva, samaṇa, jivhā, mama rasā, mam'eva, samaṇa, kāyo, mama phoṭṭhabbā, mam'eva, samaṇa, mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassaviññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasī'ti?
commentary: (SNa) mama cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. manodvāre pana mano'ti sāvajjanakaṃ bhav'aṅgacittaṃ.

meaning_1: enjoying consciousness; taking pleasure in awareness
example_1: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: sustenance of consciousness; fuel of consciousness
example_1: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

meaning_1: accumulation of consciousness that is clung to; aggregate of awareness that is grasped
example_1: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
example_2: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ… yaṃ dūre santike vā sāsavaṃ upādāniyaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, pañc'upādānakkhandhā'ti.

meaning_2: having destroyed, having ruined, having scattered
example_1: titthiye nihanitvāna, mārañ'cā'pi sasenakaṃ, tam'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā, dhammanagaraṃ amāpayi.
commentary: (APAa) tam'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā'ti tamasaṅkhātaṃ moh'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā viddhaṃsetvā.

example_1: kathaṃ, bhante, obhāsanalakkhaṇā paññā'ti? paññā, mahārāja, uppajjamānā avijj'andhakāraṃ vidhameti, vijj'obhāsaṃ janeti, ñāṇ'ālokaṃ vidaṃseti, ariyasaccāni pākaṭāni karoti. tato yog'āvacaro aniccan'ti vā dukkhan'ti vā anattā'ti vā sammappaññāya passatī'ti.
evaṃ pamatto rasagārave ratto, bālo yadī āyati n'āvabujjhati, vidhamma putte caji ñātake ca, parivattiya attānam'eva khādati.
duggat'āhaṃ pure āsiṃ, vidhavā ca aputtikā, vinā mittehi ñātīhi, bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) vidhavā'ti matapatikā.

example_1: katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārikāgocaro vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.

meaning_1: having destroyed; having demolished; having crushed
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodalaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukh'ādhānaṃ vidhaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
samo visesī uda vā nihīno, yo maññatī so vivadetha tena, tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno, samo visesī'ti na tassa hoti.
example_2: dukkhe anattasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) tīsu vidhāsū'ti tīsu mānesu… tisso imā, bhikkhave, vidhā. katamā tisso? seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā'ti
notes: tisso vidhā 1. seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 2. sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 3. hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā

example_1: vaṭṭani'r'iva koṭar'ohitā, majjhe pubbuḷakā sāssukā, pīḷakoḷikā c'ettha jāyati, vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca piṇḍitā.
synonym: kaṇḍa, koṭṭhāsa, pada, padesa, bhāga, sambhāra
commentary: (THIa) cakkhuvidhā'ti cakkhubhāgā cakkh'uppakārā vā tassa anekakalāpagatabhāvato.

grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from vidahati
example_1: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ
commentary: (DNa) iddhividhan'ti iddhikoṭṭhāsaṃ.

example_1: paññavā buddhisampanno, vidhānavidhikovido, kālaññū samayaññū ca, sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
commentary: (JAa) vidhānavidhikovido'ti nānappakāresu dāsakammakaraporis'ādīnaṃ saṃvidahana-koṭṭhāsesu cheko.

example_1: dukkhe anattasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) vidhāsamatikkantan'ti tisso vidhā atikkantaṃ.
notes: tisso vidhā 1. seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 2. sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 3. hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā

meaning_1: roams around; wanders about; runs astray; is scattered
example_1: yena sallena otiṇṇo, disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam'eva sallam'abbuyha, na dhāvati na sīdati.
example_2: taṇhā janeti purisaṃ, cittam'assa vidhāvati, satto saṃsāram'āpādi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) vidhāvatī'ti parasamudd'ādigamanavasena ito c'ito ca vidhāvati. (SNt) vidhāvatī'ti vividhaṃ rūpaṃ padhāvati, yathākāmaṃ pavattatī'ti attho.

meaning_1: fans out; spreads out; flows out; goes (in)
example_1: tathāgatena hi, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena purisadammo sārito aṭṭha disā vidhāvati.
kileseh'ābhibhūtā te, tena tena vidhāvitā, narā kilesavatthūsu, sasaṅgāme'va ghosite.
commentary: (THa) tena tenā ti tena tena ārammaṇabhāgena. vidhāvitā'ti virūpaṃ dhāvitā asāruppavasena paṭipajjantā.

meaning_1: having run about; having raced around
example_1: ādhāvitvā vidhāvitvā kīḷanakāle pana lobhanīyavayasmiṃ vā ṭhitakāle dārakaṃ oloketvā mātāpitūnaṃ cittaṃ sappimaṇḍe pakkhittasatavihatakappāsapicupaṭalaṃ viya mudukaṃ hoti āmoditaṃ pamoditaṃ, tadā tesaṃ muditā labbhati.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of vidhi
meaning_2: in due method; by means of

example_1: sakuṇo yathā paṃsukunthito, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajaṃ, evaṃ bhikkhu padhānavā satimā, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) vidhunan'ti vidhunanto.

meaning_1: having shaken off; having shaken loose; having removed
example_1: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ ten'eva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñ'c'āpi so evaṃ vadeyya, tath'ev'āyaṃ gāvī saṃyuttā iminā'va cammenā'ti, atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā ten'eva cammenā'ti.

meaning_1: name of one of Kakusandha Buddha's chief disciples
example_1: yāvatā kho pana, pāpima, kakusandhassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakā, tesu na ca koci āyasmatā vidhurena samasamo hoti yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya. iminā kho evaṃ, pāpima, pariyāyena āyasmato vidhurassa vidhuro't'eva samaññā udapādi.
commentary: (MNa) vidhuro'ti vigatadhuro, aññehi saddhiṃ asadiso'ti attho.

meaning_1: Vidhura and Sañjīva; Kakusandha Buddha's pair of chief disciples
example_1: kakusandhassa kho pana, pāpima, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhurasañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

commentary: (VINa) vidhūtikā'ti sūciyā vā salākāya vā sinduvārapupph'ādīni vijjhitvā katā.

example_1: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.
yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ, sūriyo'va obhāsayam'antalikkhan'ti.
commentary: (VINa) tena ariyamaggena vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ kāmā te paṭhamā senā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttappakāraṃ mārasenaṃ vidhūpayanto vidhamento viddhaṃsento tiṭṭhati.

meaning_1: dispersed; dispelled; scattered; exorcised; (comm) destroyed; set fire to
example_1: pahīnamānassa na santi ganthā, vidhūpitā mānaganth'assa sabbe, sa vītivatto maññataṃ sumedho, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.
example_2: yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) vidhūpitā'ti viddhaṃsitā jhāpitā vā. (SNa) vidhūpitā'ti vidhamitā.
notes: (Ñāṇananda) Fragrant incense powder is used for the propitiation of gods, while caustic types are used for exorcising evil spirits. So vidhūpita could mean 'smoking out' or 'expelling' of thoughts in this context.

example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti no ācināti, pajahati no upādiyati, visineti no ussineti, vidhūpeti no sandhūpeti
notes: (Ñāṇananda) 'exorcises' It is likely that the two words imply two functions of the ritual associated with incense. While some fragrant kinds of incense are used for propitiating benevolent spirits, certain caustic types are utilized for exorcising evil spirits.

meaning_1: having dispersed; having scattered smoke; having exorcised
meaning_2: having flavoured, having fanned, having fumigated, having scattered
example_1: kiñ'ca n'eva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito? rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṃkhare… viññāṇaṃ n'eva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito
saṅkhāya lokasmi paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.
bhavati parijan'assavo vidheyyo, mah'imaṃ āvasito susaṅgahito, piyavadū hitasukhataṃ jigīsamāno, abhirucitāni guṇāni ācarati.
commentary: (DNa) vidheyyo'ti kattabb'ākattabbesu yathāruci vidhātabbo.

meaning_1: destroyed; ruined; (comm) eaten by termites etc.
example_1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmin'ti bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvar'āsā vā upacchinnā.
commentary: (VINa) vinaṭṭhan'ti upacik'ādīhi khāyitaṃ.

example_1: anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. adaḍḍhe daḍḍhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

vinatāya apaccaṃ venateyyo, ikārass'ekāro vuddhi, rohiṇiyā putto rohiṇeyyo, gaṅgāya apaccaṃ gaṅgeyyo, bhaginiyā putto bhāgineyyo, nadiyāputto nādeyyo. evaṃ anteyyo, āheyyo, kāmeyyo. suciyā apaccaṃ soceyyo, ettha ukārassokāro vuddhi, bālāya apaccaṃ bāleyyo iccādi.evaṃ
commentary: (AP) supaṇṇamātā vinatā (APt) dvayaṃ garuḷānaṃ mātari. vino pakkhino namanti yaṃ vinatā

meaning_2: having encircled, having twisted round, having intertwined

example_1: kathañ'c'ānanda ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hoti?
example_2: eso dhammo eso vinayo etaṃ satthusāsanan'ti

meaning_1: monastic law; code of monastic disciplinary rules
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) vinayapiṭakaṃ vinayo, avasesaṃ buddhavacanaṃ dhammo

example_1: paṇḍitā h'āvuso manussā vīmaṃsakā kismiṃ pan'āyasmantānaṃ chandarāgavinayakkhāyī satthā'ti
example_2: ath'āparaṃ pañca rajāni loke, yesaṃ satīmā vinayāya sikkhe, rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, gandhesu phassesu sahetha rāgaṃ.

example_1: uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

meaning_1: talk about monastic law; discussion about monastic discipline
commentary: (VINa) vinayakathaṃ kathetī'ti vinayakathā nāma kappiy'ākappiya-āpatt'ānāpatti-saṃvara-pahāna-paṭisaṃyutta-kathā, taṃ katheti.

meaning_1: legal act; legal action; disciplinary procedure
legal act in accordance with the discipline
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, visamā parisā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ adhammakammāni pavattanti dhammakammāni nappavattanti, avinayakammāni pavattanti vinayakammāni nappavattanti, adhammakammāni dippanti dhammakammāni na dippanti, avinayakammāni dippanti vinayakammāni na dippanti.
n'ete kāmā yāni citrāni loke, saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo, tiṭṭhanti citrāni tath'eva loke. ath'ettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan'ti.
example_2: ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabbaṃ, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, yaṃ yañ'hi lokasmim'upādiyanti, ten'eva māro anveti jantuṃ.
commentary: (NIDD2) ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabban'ti sabbaṃ ādānataṇhaṃ vinayeyya paṭivinayeyya pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyā'ti, ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabbaṃ.
notes: vinayetha is opt reflx 3rd sg

example_1: tattha añño bhikkhu āgacchati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito byatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
example_2: dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
commentary: (ANa) vinayadharā'ti vinayapiṭakadharā.

meaning_1: fact of being expert in monastic law
construction:
vinaya + dhara + ka + tta
vinayadharaka + tta
example_1: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharakattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.

meaning_1: fact of being expert in monastic law
example_1: ahaṃ kho'mhi vinayadharo, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na vinayadharā'ti. so tena vinayadharattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
example_2: sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho vinayadharattena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

meaning_1: learning of monastic law; studying the rules of monastic discipline
commentary: (VINa) vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī'ti vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇantānaṃ vinayapariyattimūlakaṃ vaṇṇaṃ guṇaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ bhāsati.

meaning_2: code of discipline for the Buddhist monks
example_1: atha kho tiṃsamattā pāveyyakā [pāṭheyyakā (katthaci) vinayapiṭake mahāvagge kathinakkhandhake'pi] bhikkhū sabbe āraññikā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbe sasaṃyojanā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
example_2: yadi, bhante nāgasena, bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ tathāgatappavedito, bhikkhave, dhammavinayo vivaṭo virocati no paṭicchanno'ti, tena hi pātimokkh'uddeso kevalañ'ca vinayapiṭakaṃ pihitaṃ paṭicchannan'ti yaṃ vacanaṃ, taṃ micchā.

commentary: (VINa) āpattivuṭṭhānatā vinayapurekkhāratā'ti āpattīhi vuṭṭhānabhāvo vinayaṃ purato katvā caraṇabhāvo. vadantu maṃ āyasmanto'ti hi evaṃ vadanto āpattīhi vuṭṭhahissati, vinayañ'ca purakkhatvā viharissatī'ti vuccati.

meaning_lit: elided repetition series on monastic law

meaning_1: third book of the Vinaya Piṭaka
meaning_2: third book of the Vinaya Piṭaka
example_1: [idaṃ padaṃ vinayamahāvagga na dissati]
dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca avinaye vinayasaññī, yo ca vinaye avinayasaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

meaning_1: corrupting of the discipline; pollution of the training
example_1: te'pi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā. iti kho, bhikkhave, dhammasandosā vinayasandoso, vinayasandosā dhammasandoso. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ eta'r'ahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
commentary: (ANa) dhammasandosā vinayasandoso'ti dhammasandosena vinayasandoso hoti. kathaṃ pana dhammasmiṃ dussante vinayo dussati nāma? samathavipassanādhammesu gabbhaṃ aggaṇhantesu pañcavidho vinayo na hoti, evaṃ dhamme dussante vinayo dussati. dussīlassa pana saṃvaravinayo nāma na hoti, tasmiṃ asati samathavipassanā gabbhaṃ na gaṇhāti. evaṃ vinayasandosen'api dhammasandoso veditabbo.

meaning_1: who speaks about the discipline; who speaks in accordance with the training
meaning_2: who speaks in accordance with the rules of conduct
example_1: te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ m'āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī c'eso bhikkhu, vinayavādī c'eso bhikkhu, amhākañ'c'eso bhikkhu chandañ'ca ruciñ'ca ādāya voharati
example_2: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
commentary: (MNa) saṃvaravinaya-pahānavinaya-sannissitaṃ katvā vadatī'ti vinayavādī

(VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: support for the training; assistance for the discipline
example_1: tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca, saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinay'ānuggahāya.
commentary: (VINa) vinay'ānuggahāyā'ti sikkhāpadapaññattiyā hi sati saṃvaravinayo ca pahānavinayo ca samathavinayo ca paññattivinayo cā'ti catubbidho'pi vinayo anuggahito hoti upatthambhito sūpatthambhito. tena vuttaṃ, vinay'ānuggahāyā'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of vinaya
example_1: yathādhammaṃ nāma dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ yathādhammaṃ nāma.
example_2: dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
commentary: (VIN) dhammena vinayenā'ti yena dhammena yena vinayena.

example_1: ajja't'agge te, āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa na c'eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo, yam'pi c'aññe samaṇ'uddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sā'pi te n'atthi, cara'pi re, vinassā'ti.

example_1: yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, alam'eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.
example_2: yañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi, mano iti'pi, viññāṇaṃ iti'pi, tatr'āssutavā puthujjano n'ālaṃ nibbindituṃ n'ālaṃ virajjituṃ n'ālaṃ vimuccituṃ.

example_1: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phassā dhammā ca kevalā, etaṃ lok'āmisaṃ ghoraṃ, ettha loko vimucchito.
commentary: (SNa) ettha loko vimucchito'ti etesu chasu ārammaṇesu loko adhimucchito.

example_1: evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako… viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati, nibbidā virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
example_2: accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1) vimutto'ti mutto vimutto parimutto suvimutto accanta-anupādāvimokkhena. (MNa) vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇan'ti iminā paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ dasseti.

example_1: katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti. catutthaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) sīl'aggan'ti aggappattaṃ uttamasīlaṃ. es'eva nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: with liberated mind; with emancipated heart
example_1: yo idha caraṇesu pattipatto, kusalo sabbadā ājānāti dhammaṃ, sabbattha na sajjati vimuttacitto, paṭighā yassa na santi caraṇavā so.
example_2: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) vimuttacitto'ti kammaṭṭhānavimuttiyā vimuttacitto.

meaning_1: fact of having a liberated mind; fact of having an emancipated heart
example_1: vimuttacittattā khv'āhaṃ, sāriputta, mahāpuriso'ti vadāmi. avimuttacittattā no mahāpuriso'ti vadāmi.

meaning_1: fact of liberation; state of emancipation (from)
example_1: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
example_2: tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
commentary: (ANa) vimuttattā ṭhito'ti kilesehi vimuttattā'y'eva ṭhito.

meaning_1: fact of being without; fact of being free (from)
example_1: cattāro ariyamaggā sayaṃ samucchinnehi kilesehi vimuttattā samucchedavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti. cattāri sāmaññaphalāni magg'ānubhāvena kilesānaṃ paṭippassaddh'ante uppannattā paṭippassaddhivimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti.
virāgo pana, bhante, kim'atthiyo'ti? virāgo kho, rādha, vimutt'attho. vimutti pana, bhante, kim'atthiyā'ti?

meaning_1: one's freedom from; oneself as free from
example_1: tassa sabbehi imehi pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassato vimuttam'attānaṃ samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.

meaning_1: mentally liberated; with emancipated mind; with free mind
example_1: muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.
example_2: āvilacitto anāvilaṃ, sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.
commentary: (THIa) khandhapañcake samucchedavimuttiyā vimuttamānasaṃ

meaning_1: excellency of liberation; best kind of release
example_1: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu tīhi anuttariyehi samannāgato hoti, dassan'ānuttariyena, paṭipad'ānuttariyena, vimutt'ānuttariyena.
commentary: (MNa) vimutt'ānuttariyan'ti lokiyalok'uttarā vimutti… vimutt'ānuttariyan'ti aggaphalavimutti.

meaning_1: base for deliverance; reason for release; cause for liberation
example_1: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) vimutt'āyatanānī'ti vimuccanakāraṇāni.

meaning_1: hope of release; expectation of liberation
example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? yā hi'ssa, bhikkhave, pubbe avimuttassa vimutt'āsā sā paṭippassaddhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo vigat'āso.
tato aññā vimuttassa, ñāṇaṃ ve hoti tādino, akuppā me vimuttī'ti, bhavasaṃyojanakkhayā.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
commentary: (DNa) vimuttī'ti arahattaphalaṃ. (MNa) vimuttī'ti ariyaphalaṃ.

meaning_1: talk on liberation; discussion about release
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

asekkhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena paññākkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
commentary: (NIDD1a) vimuttikkhandhenā'ti phalavimutti-sampayutta-kkhandhena.

meaning_1: total understanding of emancipation; knowing and seeing of release; understanding and insight into liberation
example_1: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
example_2: appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.

meaning_1: talk about understanding and insight into liberation
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

meaning_1: aggregate of knowledge and vision of liberation
example_1: aparipuṇṇassa kho vimuttiñāṇadassana-kkhandhassa pāripūriyā aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1a) vimuttiñāṇadassana-kkhandhenā'ti paccavekkhaṇañāṇena.

meaning_1: for the purpose of total understanding of emancipation; for the sake of knowing and seeing of release; for the purpose of understanding and insight into liberation
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

meaning_1: attainment of understanding and insight into liberation; success in knowing and seeing release
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu… attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī, attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

meaning_1: talk of the attainment of knowledge and insight into liberation; discussion about success in knowing and seeing release
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: accomplished in the knowledge and vision of liberation
example_1: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
example_2: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimutti-ñāṇadassana-sampadā-kathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: more accomplished in the knowledge and vision of liberation (than)
example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya attanā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

meaning_1: for the benefit of total understanding of emancipation; for the advantage of knowing and seeing of release; for the good of knowledge and insight into liberation
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

meaning_1: with freedom as the fifth; including liberation as the fifth
example_1: so iminā vimuttipañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati vimuttacitto'va viharati. taṃ kissa hetu?

meaning_1: ripening in liberation; maturing in release
example_1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, paripakkā kho rāhulassa vimuttiparipācaniyā dhammā, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ rāhulaṃ uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khaye vineyyanti.
commentary: (SNa) vimuttiparipācaniyā'ti vimuttiṃ paripācentī'ti vimuttiparipācaniyā.

meaning_1: ripening in liberation; maturing in release
example_1: pañca vimuttiparipācanīyā saññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.
commentary: (DNa) vimuttiparipācanīyā'ti vimutti vuccati arahattaṃ, taṃ paripācentī'ti vimuttiparipācanīyā.

example_1: so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.

meaning_1: factor related to striving for the purification of liberation
example_1: iti evarūpiṃ vimuttipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

meaning_1: having the flavour of freedom; with the taste of liberation; with the essence of emancipation
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
commentary: (UDa) vimuttiraso'ti kilesehi vimuccanaraso. sabbā hi sāsanassa sampatti yāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittassa vimuttiyā hoti.

meaning_1: attainment of liberation; success in emancipation
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu… attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī, attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.
commentary: (MNt) vimuttacittatā pan'assa vimuttisampadā

meaning_1: talk of the attainment of liberation; discussion about success in emancipation
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: skilled in liberation; accomplished in emancipation
example_1: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
example_2: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
commentary: (MNt) vimuttī'ti ariyaphalan'ti vuttaṃ, vimuttisampanno'ti vuttattā. tañ'hi nipphādan'aṭṭhena sampādetabbaṃ, na nibbānan'ti.

meaning_1: more skilled in liberation; more accomplished in emancipation (than)
example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake … attanā vimuttisampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

meaning_1: centred in liberation; having liberation as essence; with release at the core
example_1: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃadhipateyyā'ti? sat'ādhipateyyā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃuttarā'ti? paññ'uttarā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsārā'ti? vimuttisārā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃogadhā'ti? amat'ogadhā, bhante'ti.
example_2: samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) vimutti sāro etthā'ti vimuttisāraṃ

example_1: katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

meaning_1: comfort of liberation; ease of emancipation
example_1: atha kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo rahogato paṭisallīno vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedi, tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.
commentary: (SNa) vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī'ti evaṃ arahattaṃ patvā vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedento.

example_1: sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihat'āghasaṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā bodhirukkhamūle satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
commentary: (VINa) vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī'ti vimuttisukhaṃ phalasamāpattisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayamāno.

meaning_1: who professes a doctrine of deliverance; who teaches liberation
meaning_2: who profess a doctrine of deliverance; who teaches liberation
example_1: santi, kassapa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā vimuttivādā. te anekapariyāyena vimuttiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.

kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, magg'āmaggañāṇadassana, visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

meaning_1: who is liberated; who is free (in)
example_1: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ ārambhapaccayā, sabb'ārambhaṃ paṭinissajja, anārambhe vimuttino.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: I am freed; I am liberated; I am emancipated
example_1: aññassa bhagavā buddho, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, dhamme desiyamānamhi, sotam'odhesim'atthiko, taṃ me amoghaṃ savanaṃ, vimutto'mhi anāsavo.
viññāṇassa nirodhena, taṇhākkhayavimuttino, pajjotass'eva nibbānaṃ, vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti.
example_2: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokkho tassa n'āparo.
commentary: (ANa) vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti cittassa vimutti vimuccanā appavattibhāvo hoti. taṇhākkhayavimuttino hi khīṇ'āsavassa carimakaviññāṇanirodhena parinibbānaṃ viya cetaso vimokkho hoti, na gataṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, apaṇṇattikabhāvūpagamo'y'eva hotī'ti attho.

example_1: yo mahāmeruno kūṭaṃ, vimokkhena aphassayi, vanaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, ye ca bhūmisayā narā.
commentary: (MNa) vimokkhena aphassayī'ti jhānavimokkhena phusi.

meaning_1: should be liberated; should be freed; should be emancipated
example_1: sa kho so, byagghapajjā, ariyasāvako iminā ca sīlapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca cittapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca diṭṭhipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājeti, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimoceti.
commentary: (ANa) vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetī'ti yehi ārammaṇehi cittaṃ vimocetabbaṃ, tesu yathā vimuccati, evaṃ karoti.

example_1: vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
commentary: (VISM) vimocayaṃ cittan'ti paṭhamajjhānena nīvaraṇehi cittaṃ mocento vimocento, dutiyena vitakkavicārehi, tatiyena pītiyā, catutthena sukhadukkhehi cittaṃ mocento vimocento.

meaning_1: explains in detail; describes in full

meaning_1: becomes detached (from); loses interest (in); becomes dispassionate (towards); gets bored (with)
meaning_2: detaches oneself, shows lack of interest in
example_1: rañño'pi kho, bhikkhave, pasenadissa kosalassa atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako tasmim'pi nibbindati. tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pag'eva hīnasmiṃ.
example_2: dhono na hi tena maññati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā, n'āññena visuddhim'icchati, na hi so rajjati no virajjatī'ti.

example_1: sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.

commentary: (NIDD1) na saddho na virajjatī'ti. sabbe bālaputhujjanā rajjanti, puthujjanakalyāṇakaṃ upādāya satta sekkhā virajjanti. arahā n'eva rajjati no virajjati, viratto so khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā khayā dosassa vītadosattā, khayā mohassa vītamohattā. so vuṭṭhavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo… jātimaraṇasaṃsāro n'atthi tassa punabbhavo'ti, na saddho na virajjati. meaning_1: for the sake of detachment; for the purpose of dispassion
example_1: atha kho idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvar'atthaṃ pahān'atthaṃ virāg'atthaṃ nirodh'atthan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) virāg'atthan'ti rāg'ādīnaṃ virajjan'atthāya.

meaning_1: liable to fade; prone to disappear
meaning_2: liable to fade; prone to disappear
example_1: sukhā'pi kho, aggivessana, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā, dukkhā'pi kho, aggivessana, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā
example_2: bhidur'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kāyo, viññāṇaṃ virāgadhammaṃ, sabbe upadhī aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca.
commentary: (SNa) virāgadhamman'ti virajjanakasabhāvaṃ. (ITIa) virāgadhamman'ti virajjanadhammaṃ, palujjanasabhāvan'ti attho.

meaning_1: fact of having a nature to fade; liability to disappear
example_1: taṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṃ'y'eva khayadhammataṃ … vayadhammataṃ … virāgadhammataṃ … nirodhadhammataṃ … vipariṇāmadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ, yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin'ti. atha kho pana, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto.

meaning_1: based on fading of desire; supported by dispassion; by means of detachment
example_1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, satta bojjh'aṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
commentary: (MNa) tathā virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ. tañ'ca kho ariyamaggakkhaṇ'uppattiyā kilesānaṃ samucchedato pariccāgabhāvena ca nibbānapakkhandanabhāvena ca pariṇataṃ paripakkan'ti ayam'eva attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_1: attached to detachment; passionate for dispassion
example_1: sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.

meaning_1: perception of dispassion; recognition of detachment
example_1: katamā c'ānanda, virāgasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhippaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nibbānan'ti.
example_2: yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū virāgasaññaṃ bhāvessanti
notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

example_1: idha tvaṃ, dīghāvu, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī viharāhi, anicce dukkhasaññī, dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī'ti. evañ'hi te, dīghāvu, sikkhitabban'ti.
example_2: sarāgavatthūsu virāgasaññī, rattamhi lokamhi virattacittā, hitvā papañce jitaphanditāni, tath'eva bodhiṃ anupāpuṇiṃsu.
commentary: (APAa) virāgasaññī virattasaññavanto

meaning_lit: discourse on the fading of desire
discourse on the fading of desire

meaning_1: for the benefit of detachment; for the advantage of dispassion
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ
example_2: iti kho, bhikkhave, virāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, nibbidā virāg'atthā virāg'ānisaṃsā, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbid'atthaṃ nibbid'ānisaṃsaṃ

meaning_1: observing the fading of desire; contemplating dispassion
observing dispassion; watching fading of desire; contemplating fading away
example_1: virāg'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, virāg'ānupassī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
example_2: so kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya anicc'ānupassī viharati, vay'ānupassī viharati, virāg'ānupassī viharati, nirodh'ānupassī viharati, paṭinissagg'ānupassī viharati.
commentary: (SNa) virāg'ānupassī'ti virāgaṃ anupassanto. (ANa) virāg'ānupassī'ti ettha dve virāgā khayavirāgo ca accantavirāgo ca. tattha saṅkhārānaṃ khayaṃ khayato passanā vipassanā'pi, accantavirāgaṃ nibbānaṃ virāgato dassanamaggañāṇam'pi virāg'ānupassanā. tadubhayasamaṅgipuggalo virāg'ānupassī nāma.

example_1: rāgo kho, āvuso, appasāvajjo dandhavirāgī, doso mahāsāvajjo khippavirāgī, moho mahāsāvajjo dandhavirāgī'ti.
example_2: atthi dukkhaṃ adhimattaṃ, atthi parittaṃ, atthi dandhavirāgi, atthi khippavirāgi. ayaṃ vuccati dukkhassa vemattatā.

example_1: paroparañ'ca jānāsi, atho rāgavirāginaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, sattānaṃ āgatiṃ gatin'ti.

construction:
vi + √raj > rag > rāg + *a + una
virāga + una
example_1: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
commentary: (MNa) virāgunan'ti vigacchanasabhāvaṃ.

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: fading of desire and calming; dispassion and tranquility; detachment and peace
example_1: agge dhamme pasannānaṃ, virāg'ūpasame sukhe, agge saṅghe pasannānaṃ, puññakkhette anuttare.
commentary: (ITIa) virāg'ūpasame'ti virāge upasame ca, sabbassa rāgassa sabbesaṃ kilesānaṃ accantavirāga-hetubhūte accanta-upasama-hetubhūte cā'ti attho.

example_1: diṭṭhiyogaṃ samūhacca, avijjañ'ca virājayaṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, te ve yog'ātigā munī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) virājayan'ti virājento, virājetvā vā. virājento'ti hi vutte maggo kathito hoti, virājetvā'ti vutte phalaṃ.

meaning_1: having detached (from); having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having become indifferent (to); having become dispassionate (towards)
meaning_2: having detached; having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having made indifferent (to)
example_1: idh'eva cittāni virājayitvā, kāmesu ādīnavam'addasaṃsu, te kāmasaṃyojanabandhanāni, pāpimayogāni duraccayāni.
commentary: (DNa) cittāni virājayitvā'ti pañcakāmaguṇikacittāni virājayitvā.

example_1: yesaṃ rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, tesaṃ vijaṭitā jaṭā.
synonym: niddhanta, ninnīta, nīhaṭa, parisuddha, visuddha, vīvadāta, vodāta

example_1: hitvā agāraṃ pabbajitā, hitvā puttaṃ pasuṃ viyaṃ, hitvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, avijjañ'ca virājiya, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, te lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) virājiyā'ti virājetvā.

meaning_1: detaches; loses interest (in); loses desire (for); makes indifferent (to)
example_1: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā pathavīdhātuyā nibbindati, pathavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
example_2: sa kho so, byagghapajjā, ariyasāvako iminā ca sīlapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca cittapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca diṭṭhipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājeti, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimoceti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍīyeyya. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kaṅkā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ virājeyyuṃ.

meaning_1: having cleansed; having purified; having removed
meaning_2: having discarded, having removed, having destroyed
example_1: devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.
example_2: pañca kāmaguṇā loke, manochaṭṭhā paveditā, ettha chandaṃ virājetvā, evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

meaning_1: having detached; having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having made indifferent (to)
example_1: so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.
commentary: (ANa) virājetvā'ti ettha maggakkhaṇe virājeti nāma, phalakkhaṇe virattaṃ nāma hoti. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: kathaṃ ārādhanā hoti, kathaṃ hoti virādhanā, iti puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, magge paṭipadāsu ca.
commentary: (DNa) ārādhanā'ti sampādanā. virādhanā'ti asampādanā. (DNt) sampādanā'ti maggassa upasampādanaṃ tassa sampāpanaṃ samma'd'eva pāpanaṃ. virādhanā'ti anārādhanā anupāyapaṭipatti.

example_1: mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

meaning_1: missed; failed to attain; did not succeed (in)
example_1: yo papañcam'anuyutto, papañc'ābhirato mago, virādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.
commentary: (NIDD1) kammavirādhayitvā'ti puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā viraddhaṃ mayā, aparaddhaṃ mayā, khalitaṃ mayā, galitaṃ mayā, aññāya aparaddho ahan'ti vedhati pavedhati sampavedhatī'ti, pavedhati kammavirādhayitvā. (SNPa) so taṃ sīlabbat'ādi-kammaṃ puññ'ābhisaṅkhār'ādi-kammaṃ vā virādhayitvā pavedhatī.

example_1: nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
commentary: (THa) kiñ'c'āpi te, citta, virādhitaṃ mayā'ti, ambho citta, kiṃ nāma te mayā viraddhaṃ, taṃ kathehī'ti adhippāyo.

meaning_1: misses; loses hold; fails to grasp
example_1: sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi… seyyathā'pi vā pana, bhikkhu, puriso narakappapāte papatanto hatthehi ca pādehi ca pathaviṃ virādheyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.
commentary: (MNa) virādheyyā'ti hatthena gahaṇayutte vā pādena patiṭṭhānayutte vā ṭhāne gahaṇapatiṭṭhānāni kātuṃ na sakkuṇeyya.

meaning_2: having missed, having omitted, having failed

example_1: bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, viriccamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.
commentary: (UDa) viriccamāno'ti abhiṇhaṃ pavattalohitavirecano'va samāno.

example_1: bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, viriñcamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.

n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi viriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) na vīriyaṃ ārabhatī'ti duvidham'pi vīriyaṃ n'ārabhati. appattassā'ti jhāna-vipassanā-maggaphala-dhammassa appattassa pattiyā. anadhigatassā'ti tass'eva anadhigatassa adhigam'atthāya. asacchikatassā'ti tass'eva apaccakkhakatassa sacchikaraṇ'atthāya. (MNa) vīrabhāvato vidhinā īrayitabbato ca vīriyaṃ. taṃ paggahalakkhaṇaṃ, upatthambhanarasaṃ, anosīdanapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.

meaning_1: highest state of effort; perfection of energy
power that is effort; strength of energy
example_1: katamāni pañca? saddhābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sekhabalāni.
commentary: (ANa) kosajje na kampatī'ti vīriyabalaṃ.

example_1: paripuṇṇakāyo suruci, sujāto cārudassano, suvaṇṇavaṇṇo'si bhagavā, susukkadāṭho'si viriyavā.
commentary: (THa) so vīriyavā āraddhavīriyo akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāyā'ti attho.

example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā vā akusalā dhammā parihāyanti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave viriy'ārambho. āraddhavīriyassa, bhikkhave, anuppannā c'eva kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā ca akusalā dhammā parihāyantī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) vīriy'ārambho'ti catukiccassa sammappadhānavīriyassa ārambho, āraddhapaggahitaparipuṇṇavīriyatā'ti attho.

meaning_1: is blocked; is obstructed; is opposed (by)
example_1: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.
example_2: tath'eva isayo hiṃsaṃ, saññate brahmacārino, adhammacārī khattiyo, so saggena virujjhati.

meaning_1: is contrary; is contradictory; is opposite in meaning (to)
example_1: paṇḍitapaṭirūpakānañ'hi santike kathetuṃ dukkhaṃ hoti, te pade pade akkhare akkhare dosam'eva vadanti. ek'antapaṇḍitā pana kathaṃ sutvā sukathitaṃ pasaṃsanti, dukkathite pāḷipada-attha-byañjanesu yaṃ yaṃ virujjhati, taṃ taṃ ujuṃ katvā denti.
āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.
commentary: (NIDD1) virutañ'ca… virutaṃ vuccati migavākkaṃ. migavākkapāṭhakā migavākkaṃ ādisanti, sakuntānaṃ vā catuppadānaṃ vā rutaṃ vassitaṃ jānantī'ti. evaṃ migavākkapāṭhakā migavākkaṃ ādisanti.

meaning_1: hostile; opposed; in opposition; (comm) obstructed by hostility and anger
example_1: aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu, attadaṇḍesu nibbutaṃ, sādānesu anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
example_2: ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.
commentary: (ANa) viruddhā'ti virodhasaṅkhātena kopena viruddhā.

meaning_1: (comm) giving medicine to revive a stillbirth
example_1: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ
commentary: (DNa) viruddhagabbhakaraṇan'ti viruddhassa vilīnassa aṭṭhitassa matassa gabbhassa karaṇaṃ. puna avināsāya bhesajjadānan'ti attho. gabbho hi vātena, pāṇakehi, kammunā cā'ti tīhi kāraṇehi vinassati. tattha vātena vinassante nibbāpanīyaṃ sītalaṃ bhesajjaṃ deti, pāṇakehi vinassante pāṇakānaṃ paṭikammaṃ karoti, kammunā vinassante pana buddhā'pi paṭibāhituṃ na sakkonti.

meaning_1: (of a wound) heals; cures; grows over
example_1: tassa imissā ca sappāyakiriyāya asuci visadoso apanīto anupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo viruheyya.

atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, māluvābījaṃ n'eva moro gileyya, na mago khādeyya, na davaḍāho ḍaheyya, na vanakammikā uddhareyyuṃ, na upacikā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, bījañ'ca pan'assa taṃ pāvussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhaṃ samma'd'eva viruheyya.
synonym: udeti, pabbati, pavaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍheti, vaddhati

meaning_1: in the sense of the place of growth

example_1: te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane, arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā.
example_2: apagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā, na ca te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.
commentary: (ANa) virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti sīl'ādīhi guṇehi vaḍḍhanato vuddhiṃ, niccalabhāvena virūḷhiṃ, sabbattha patthaṭatāya vepullaṃ pāpuṇanti.

example_1: muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
commentary: (THa) virūpo'ti tena muṇḍabhāvena parūḷhalomatāya chinnabhinnakāsāya vatthatāya virūpo vevaṇṇiyaṃ upagato.

meaning_1: name of a royal family of serpents
example_1: sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya. katamāni cattāri? virūp'akkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.

meaning_1: name of one of the Four Great Kings
meaning_2: name of the overlord of Nāgas
example_1: pacchimāya disāya virūp'akkho mahārājā puratth'ābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā, uttarāya disāya vessavaṇo mahārājā dakkhiṇābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.
commentary: (DNa) virūp'akkho nāgarājā nāgānaṃ koṭisatasahassena parivuto koṭisatasahassamaṇimayāni mahāphalakāni ca suvaṇṇasattiyo ca gāhāpetvā pacchimāya disāya puratthim'ābhimukho dvīsu devalokesu devatā purato katvā nisinno.

commentary: (SNa) dibbacakkhu visujjhī'ti bhagavato rūpadassan'atthāya visuddhaṃ ahosi. (THa) dibbacakkhu visujjhi me'ti evaṃvidhe samādhimhi sampādite mayhaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ visujjhi, ekādasahi upakkilesehi vimuttiyā visuddhaṃ ahosi.
