(SNa) jātu vedagū'ti ahaṃ ek'aṃsen'eva vedagū, vedasaṅkhātena ñāṇena neyyesu gato, vedaṃ vā gato adhigato, paṇḍito'ham'asmī'ti attho.

example_1: etādisaṃ yaññam'anussarantā, ye vedajātā vicaranti loke, vineyya maccheramalaṃ samūlaṃ, aninditā saggam'upenti ṭhānan'ti.
example_2: so bāvarī attamano udaggo, taṃ devataṃ pucchati vedajāto, katamamhi gāme nigamamhi vā pana, katamamhi vā janapade lokanātho, yattha gantvāna passemu, sambuddhaṃ dvipad'uttamaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) vedajātā'ti tuṭṭhijātā. (VVa) vedajātā'ti jātasomanassā.

example_1: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti
commentary: (SNa) yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati

example_1: evam'eva kho, bho gotama, rūp'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo rūpe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati, vedan'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo vedan'āyaṃ patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati

meaning_1: (pleasant, unpleasant or neutral) felt experience; feeling; feeling tone; hedonic tone; sensation (coming from six sense experience); second of the five aggregates
example_1: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
example_2: ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, vedanaṃ n'ābhinandato, evaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.

example_1: vedanaṃ pharusaṃ jāniṃ, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, garukaṃ vā'pi ābādhaṃ, cittakkhepañ'ca pāpuṇe.
example_2: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.

example_1: samudayan'ti-ādīsu avijjāsamudayā cakkhusamudayo'ti-ādinā vedanākammaṭṭhāne vuttanayena phass'āyatanānaṃ samuday'ādayo veditabbā.
commentary: (DNt) vedanānaṃ samudayan'ti-ādipāḷi vedanākammaṭṭhānan'ti daṭṭhabbā.

meaning_1: classes of feeling; categories of felt experience
example_1: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

meaning_1: aggregate of felt experience; mass of feeling; second of the five aggregates
example_1: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

meaning_1: wearing away of feeling; exhaustion of (painful) sensation
example_1: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo, āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo'ti dukkhavaṭṭakkhayena vedanākkhayo. dukkhavaṭṭasmiñ'hi khīṇe vedanāvaṭṭam'pi khīṇam'eva hoti.

meaning_1: related to felt experience; connected with feeling; concerning sensation; kind of feeling
example_1: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
commentary: (ANa) vedanāgat'ādīni sampayuttavedanādīnaṃ vasena veditabbāni (ANa) rūpam'eva rūpagataṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: katamāni cattāri? rūp'aggaṃ, vedanā'ggaṃ, saññā'ggaṃ, bhav'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) rūp'aggan'ti yaṃ rūpaṃ sammasitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, idaṃ rūp'aggaṃ nāma. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

meaning_1: one of the feelings; a certain felt experience (among)
example_1: vedanāsu vedan'āññatar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ, assāsapassāsānaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikāraṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) vedan'āññataran'ti tīsu vedanāsu aññataraṃ, sukhavedanaṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

example_1: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, thale kato udakaṃ ottharati, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, khittacittassa, vedan'āṭṭassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) vedan'āṭṭo'ti balavatiyā dukkhavedanāya phuṭṭho mucchāpareto

meaning_1: having the ability to feel; sensate
meaning_2: having the ability to feel; sensate
example_1: na h'eva kho me vedanā attā, no'pi appaṭisaṃvedano me attā, attā me vediyati, vedanādhammo hi me attā'ti iti vā hi, ānanda, attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati.
commentary: (DNa) attā me vediyati, vedanādhammo hi me attā'ti iminā saññā-saṅkhāra-viññāṇakkhandha-vatthukā. idañ'hi khandhattayaṃ vedanāsampayuttattā vediyati. etassa ca vedanādhammo avippayuttasabhāvo.

meaning_1: realm of feeling; world of sensation
example_1: vedanādhātuyā… saññādhātuyā… saṅkhāradhātuyā ce bhikkhave… viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti, rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
example_2: vedanādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. vedanādhāturāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound by desire to the realm of feeling
example_1: vedanādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. vedanādhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ okasārī'ti vuccati. saññādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko.

meaning_1: diversity of felt experiences; variety of feelings
example_1: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ
commentary: (DNa) vedanānānattan'ti cakkhusamphassaj'ādi-vedanānānattaṃ.

meaning_1: fact of impermanence of feeling; fact of instability of felt experience
example_1: vedanaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, vedan'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. vedanaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto, vedan'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto vedanāya nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.
taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

meaning_1: ending of feeling; cessation of felt experience
example_1: channaṃ tv'eva, phagguna, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho
example_2: phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.

meaning_1: path of practice leading to the end of felt experience
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

meaning_1: leading to the end of felt experience
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
example_2: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako vedanañ'ca pajānāti, vedanāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

meaning_1: following felt experience; contemplating feeling tone
example_1: vedan'ānupassanā niṭṭhitā.

meaning_1: contemplating feeling; who observes felt experience
example_1: vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
example_2: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati… vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) vedanāsū'ti ettha tisso vedanā, tā ca lokiyā eva, cittam'pi lokiyaṃ, tathā dhammā. yathā pana vedanā anupassitabbā, tathā anupassanto esa vedan'ānupassī'ti veditabbo.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of vedanāpaccaya
meaning_1: dependent on felt experience; due to sensation
example_1: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ

meaning_1: concept of felt experience; what is called sensation
example_1: phassapaññattiyā sati vedanāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. vedanāpaññattiyā sati saññāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about feeling tone

meaning_1: produced by felt experience; generated by sensation
example_1: taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

meaning_1: imprisoned by feeling; held captive by felt sensation
meaning_lit: bound with the bond of feeling
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano vedanābandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

meaning_1: suffering a feeling; afflicted by pain
example_1: añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedayatī'ti kho, kassapa, vedan'ābhitunnassa sato paraṃkataṃ dukkhan'ti iti vadaṃ ucchedaṃ etaṃ pareti.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in feeling; delighting in sensation
example_1: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti

meaning_1: enjoying feeling tone; taking pleasure in sensation
example_1: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti

meaning_1: freed by the exhaustion of feelings; liberated through the dissolution of felt experience
example_1: vedanāsaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.
notes: saṅkhāvimutta is the preferable reading

meaning_1: free from classification in terms of feeling
example_1: yāya vedanāya tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, sā vedanā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. vedanāsaṅkhāyavimutto, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

meaning_1: source of feeling; arising of feeling
example_1: phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.
example_2: cha'y'ime, āvuso, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. vedanāsamudayā taṇhāsamudayo, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho

meaning_1: with felt experience as source; originating from feeling
example_1: taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

meaning_1: leading to the arising of feeling
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, katamā nu kho, bhante, vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā? katamo vedanānirodho, katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā?

meaning_1: converging upon feeling; coming together in sensation
example_1: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā'ti? phassasamudayā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā'ti? vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā'ti? samādhippamukhā, bhante'ti.
example_2: chandamūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, manasikārasambhavā sabbe dhammā, phassasamudayā sabbe dhammā, vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā
commentary: (ANa) vedanāya samosarantī'ti vedanāsamosaraṇā.

meaning_1: happy with feeling; pleased with felt sensation
example_1: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti …

meaning_1: one remains among feelings, closely observing feelings
commentary: (PM) kathaṃ vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati? idh'ekacco sukhaṃ vedanaṃ aniccato anupassati, no niccato… paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati. aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati… paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahati. imehi sattahi ākārehi vedanaṃ anupassati. vedanā upaṭṭhānaṃ, no sati.

meaning_1: (understanding of the) subtlety of felt experience; fineness of feelings
example_1: vedanāsokhummena samannāgato hoti paramena, tena ca vedanāsokhummena aññaṃ vedanāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassati, tena ca vedanāsokhummena aññaṃ vedanāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti.
vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ vedanā, mama vedanā'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

meaning_1: born from rolling around after the change of feeling
example_1: tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.
commentary: (SNa) vipariṇām'ānuparivattijā'ti vipariṇāmassa anuparivattito vipariṇām'ārammaṇacittato jātā.

meaning_1: rolling around after the change of feeling
example_1: tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.
commentary: (SNa) rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattiviññāṇaṃ hotī'ti mama rūpaṃ vipariṇatan'ti vā ahu vata m'etaṃ, dāni vata me n'atthī'ti vā ādinā nayena kammaviññāṇaṃ rūpassa bhed'ānuparivatti hoti.
notes: See rūpavipariṇāmānuparivattī.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhapalepanena, so sallassa'pi vedanāhetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
example_2: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā, na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.

example_1: yo ca kho, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yathā vedanīyaṃ ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā'ssa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti
tathā hi ayam'āyasmā na c'eva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakk'āvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) paṇḍitavedanīyan'ti paṇḍitehi jānitabbakaṃ.

meaning_1: attached to feeling; attracted to feeling; engaged with felt experience
example_1: vedan'upayaṃ… saññ'upayaṃ… saṅkhār'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

meaning_1: accumulation of feeling that is clung to
example_1: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
example_2: kummo'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandhassa, vedan'upādānakkhandhassa, saññ'upādānakkhandhassa, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandhassa, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandhassa.

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: accumulation of feeling that is clung to
example_1: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

meaning_1: attached to feeling; attracted to sensation; engaged with felt experience
example_1: vedan'ūpāyaṃ vā āvuso… saññ'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso… saṅkhār'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.

meaning_1: who has complete knowledge; epithet of an arahant
meaning_lit: gone to the end of the Vedas
meaning_2: who excels in the knowledge of the Vedas
example_1: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yaññ'opanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ved'antagū'ti catunnaṃ maggavedānaṃ antaṃ, catūhi vā maggavedehi kilesānaṃ antaṃ gato.
notes: Originally a Brahman term for someone with a complete knowledge of the Vedas.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhante, rājā khattiyo muddh'āvasitto adhun'ābhisitto rajjena, uḷāraṃ so labhati vedapaṭilābhaṃ, uḷāraṃ so labhati somanassapaṭilābhaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) vedapaṭilābhan'ti tuṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ.

meaning_2: who excels in the knowledge of the Vedas

commentary: (ANa) vedabahulo'ti pītipāmojjabahulo.

example_1: ko nu kho, bhante, vedayatī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, vedayatī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.
example_2: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, vedanaṃ vadetha? vedayatī'ti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā vedanā'ti vuccati. kiñ'ca vedayati? sukham'pi vedayati, dukkham'pi vedayati, adukkham'asukham'pi vedayati

example_1: añchāmi naṃ na muñcāmi, asmā sokapariddavā, ko me bandhaṃ muñcaṃ loke, sambodhiṃ vedayissati.
commentary: (THa) vedayissa'ti ācikkhissatī'ti attho.

example_1: nanu me tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha idh'ekaccassa yaṃ evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti
sukhavedaniyaṃ, bhikkhu, phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā. so sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti. dukkhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.

example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, ye kho keci atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ, na'y'ito bhiyyo.

meaning_1: which is felt; felt experience; feeling
example_1: yam'p'idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā tam'pi suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā.
example_2: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
commentary: (SNa) vedayitānī'ti vedanā.

meaning_1: property of being felt; quality of being experienced
questions-and-answers; catechism; one of the nine kinds of suttas
example_1: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sammādiṭṭhi-sakkapañha-saṅkhārabhājaniya-mahāpuṇṇama-sutt'ādayo sabbe'pi vedañ'ca tuṭṭhiñ'ca laddhā laddhā pucchitasutt'antā vedallan'ti veditabbā.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatam'addhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā. te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā abhidhammakathaṃ vedallakathaṃ kathentā kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamamānā na bujjhissanti.
commentary: (ANa) vedallakathan'ti vedapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ ñāṇamissakakathaṃ.

example_1: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññā vosito muni.
example_2: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.
commentary: (NIDD1) yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhamman'ti. yo imaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ jānāti so dhammaṃ vedi aññāsi apassi paṭivijjhī'ti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ.

example_1: kiṃ caritassa puggalassa kiṃ sappāyan'ti ettha pana sen'āsanaṃ tāva rāgacaritassa adhotavedikaṃ bhūmaṭṭhakaṃ akatapabbhārakaṃ tiṇakuṭikaṃ paṇṇasāl'ādīnaṃ aññataraṃ raj'okiṇṇaṃ jatukābharitaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ atiuccaṃ vā atinīcaṃ vā ujjaṅgalaṃ sāsaṅkaṃ asucivisamamaggaṃ
commentary: (VINt) vedikā'ti cetiyassa upari caturassacayo vuccati. (VISMa) adhotavedikan'ti aparisuddhaparikkhepavedikaṃ.

example_1: sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ, adukkham'asukhaṃ saha, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ.

meaning_1: can be known; should be understood (by)
example_1: iminā kho etaṃ, āvuso, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ
example_2: so evam'assa veditabbo, āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto lok'āmis'ādhimutto purisapuggalo'ti.

example_1: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
commentary: (DNa) paccattaṃ veditabbo'ti attanā'va veditabbo. (SNa) sabbehi ugghaṭitaññūādīhi viññūhi bhāvito me maggo, adhigataṃ phalaṃ, sacchikato nirodho'ti attani attani veditabbo'ti paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti.

meaning_1: this should be known; this should be understood
example_1: puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.
example_2: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asubhasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ anusandahati appaṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā

example_1: veditvā so sucaritassa phalaṃ, uṇhīsasīsattam'idh'ajjhagamā, byākaṃsu byañjananimittadharā, pubbaṅ'gamo bahujanaṃ hessati.
addasā kho sakko devānam'indo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass'uttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) vediyake pabbate'ti so kira pabbato pabbatapāde jātena maṇivedikāsadisena nīlavanasaṇḍena samantā parikkhitto, tasmā vediyakapabbato' tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gato. (DNt) vedi eva vediko, vediko eva vediyo ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā, tasmiṃ vediyake. ten'āha maṇivedikā-sadisenā'ti-ādi, indanīl'ādi-maṇimaya-vedikāsadisenā'ti attho.

example_1: passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati
example_2: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
notes: not passive despite appearances

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, vediyamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vipāko.
example_2: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī'ti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī'ti pajānāti
notes: not passive

example_1: so'haṃ sallassa'pi vedhanahetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
sīladassanasampannaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavedinaṃ, attano kamma kubbānaṃ, taṃ jano kurute piyaṃ.
notes: vedinaṃ is masc acc sg

example_1: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
example_2: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
commentary: (ANa) sukhaṃ vedetī'ti sukhaṃ paṭilabhati.

example_1: jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ'y'eva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā, yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, yadi vā na tādiso. tathā mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vedissāmā'ti.
example_2: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañci'd'eva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti. pucch'āvuso sāriputta, sutvā vedissāmā'ti.
synonym: avabujjhati, aveti, ājānāti, paccabyati, pajānāti, bujjhati, munāti

meaning_2: having felt, having sensed, having known

meaning_1: which knows; which feels; which experiences
example_1: atha vā pan'assa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti, yo me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassatī'ti
commentary: (MNa) vedayatī'ti vedeyyo, jānāti anubhavati cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. kiṃ vedetī'ti, tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.

meaning_1: belonging to the Videha country; Videhan
example_1: atha kho thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi, kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo, ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati?
example_2: sukh'āvaho dukkhanudo, vedehassa yasassino, matiṃ te paṭihaññāmi, usuṃ palasatena vā.
commentary: (SNa) vedehamunino'ti paṇḍitamunino. paṇḍito hi ñāṇasaṅkhātena vedena īhati sabbakiccāni karoti, tasmā vedeho'ti vuccati. vedeho ca so muni cā'ti, vedehamuni. (JAa) vedehan'ti videharaṭṭhasāmikaṃ. (JAa) vedehassā'ti tava videharājassa.

meaning_1: epithet of Ānanda; Videhan sage; (comm) wise sage
example_1: atha kho thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi, kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo, ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati?
example_2: tathāgataṃ jetavane vasantaṃ, apucchi vedehamunī nat'aṅgo, sabbaññubuddhā kira nāma honti, bhavanti te hetubhi kehi vīra.
commentary: (SNa) vedehamunino'ti paṇḍitamunino. paṇḍito hi ñāṇasaṅkhātena vedena īhati sabbakiccāni karoti, tasmā vedeho'ti vuccati. vedeho ca so muni cā'ti, vedehamuni. (APAa) vedehamunī'ti vedeharaṭṭhe jātā vedehī, vedehiyā putto vedehiputto. monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ, tena ito gato pavatto'ti muni. vedehiputto ca so muni ce'ti vedehiputtamunī'ti vattabbe vaṇṇ'āgamo'ti-ādinā niruttinayena i-kārassa attaṃ putta-saddassa ca lopaṃ katvā vedehamunī'ti vuttaṃ.
notes: Note the contradiction between the commentaries.

meaning_1: name of a laywoman in Sāvatthī
example_1: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā vedehikā nāma gahapatānī ahosi. vedehikāya, bhikkhave, gahapatāniyā evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, soratā vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā vedehikā gahapatānī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) vedehikā'ti videharaṭṭhavāsikassa dhītā. atha vā vedo'ti paññā vuccati, vedena īhati iriyatī'ti vedehikā, paṇḍitā'ti attho

example_1: assosi kho rājā pasenadi kosalo, rājā kira māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā mamaṃ abbhuyyāto yena kāsī'ti.
example_2: tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) vedehiputto'ti vedehī'ti paṇḍit'ādhivacanam'etaṃ, paṇḍit'itthiyā putto'ti attho.

meaning_2: son of a princess from Videha

meaning_1: name of a Sakyan family clan
meaning_2: name of a Sakyan family group
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati vedhaññā nāma sakyā, tesaṃ ambavane pāsāde.
commentary: (DNa) vedhaññā nāma sakyā'ti dhanumhi katasikkhā vedhaññanāmakā eke sakyā.

meaning_1: shakes; trembles; is agitated; is distressed; is disconcerted
example_1: yathā'pi pabbato selo, acalo suppatiṭṭhito, evaṃ mohakkhayā bhikkhu, pabbato'va na vedhatī'ti.
example_2: ucc'āvacesu sayanesu, kīvanto tattha bheravā, yehi bhikkhu na vedheyya, nigghose sayan'āsane.
synonym: kampati, calati, pariphandati, pavedhati, phandati, byathati, vikampati, saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati

meaning_1: shakes; trembles; wavers; is agitated; is distressed; is disconcerted (about)
example_1: yato ca kho paṇḍito āpadāsu, na vedhatī atthavinicchayaññū, paccatthikāssa dukhitā bhavanti, disvā mukhaṃ avikāraṃ purāṇaṃ.
example_2: yassa nittiṇṇo paṅko, maddito kāmakaṇṭako, mohakkhayaṃ anuppatto, sukhadukkhesu na vedhatī sa bhikkhū'ti.
synonym: kampati, calati, caleti, paripphandati, pariphandati, pavedhati, pavedhatī, phandati, byathati, vikampati, saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati
commentary: (ANa) na vedhatī'ti na kampati n'ānusocati. (UDa) sukhadukkhesu na vedhatī sa bhikkhū'ti so bhinnakileso bhikkhu iṭṭh'ārammaṇa-samāyogato uppannesu sukhesu aniṭṭh'ārammaṇa-samāyogato uppannesu dukkhesu ca na vedhati na kampati, taṃ nimittaṃ cittavikāraṃ n'āpajjati. sukhadukkhesū'ti ca desanāmattaṃ, sabbesu'pi lokadhammesu na vedhatī'ti veditabbaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena, so sallassa'pi vedhanahetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.

meaning_1: due to the piercing; due to the puncturing (of)
example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena, so sallassa'pi vedhanahetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
piṇḍapātaṃ caritvāna, daṇḍam'olubbha dubbalā, vedhamānehi gattehi, tatth'eva nipatiṃ chamā, disvā ādīnavaṃ kāye, atha cittaṃ vimucci me'ti.
example_2: kassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto, sadā udakam'otari, vedhamānehi gattehi, sītaṃ vedayase bhusaṃ.
commentary: (THIa) vedhamānehi kampamānehi gattehi sarīrāvayavehi

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

meaning_1: family of basket weavers; family of bamboo workers
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
commentary: (ANa) venakule'ti vilīvakārakule.

meaning_1: belonging to a family of basket weavers
example_1: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.

meaning_1: caste of basket weavers; caste of bamboo workers
example_1: jāti nāma dve jātiyo, hīnā ca jāti ukkaṭṭhā ca jāti. hīnā nāma jāti, caṇḍālajāti, venajāti, nesādajāti, rathakārajāti, pukkusajāti. esā hīnā nāma jāti.
commentary: (VINa) venajātī'ti tacchakajāti, veṇukārajātī'ti'pi vadanti.

meaning_1: annihilationist; proponent of the doctrine of annihilation
example_1: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ, bhikkhave, evam'akkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, venayiko samaṇo gotamo, sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) venayiko'ti vinayati vināsetī'ti vinayo, so eva venayiko, sattavināsako'ti adhippāyo.
notes: see venayika 2, 3, 4, 5

meaning_1: destroyer of tradition; (comm) destroying the natural order
example_1: venayiko bhavaṃ gotamo'ti
commentary: (ANa) puna brāhmaṇo tadeva abhivādan'ādikammaṃ bhagavati apassanto, ayaṃ idaṃ lokajeṭṭhakakammaṃ vineti vināseti… maññamāno bhagavantaṃ venayiko'ti āha. tatr'āyaṃ pad'attho vinayatī'ti vinayo, vināsetī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
notes: see venayika 1, 3, 4, 5

meaning_1: who should be taught a lesson; who should be rebuked
meaning_2: who has to be led away, got rid of
example_1: venayiko bhavaṃ gotamo'ti
commentary: (ANa) atha vā yasmā etaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ na karoti, tasmā ayaṃ vinetabbo niggaṇhitabbo'ti maññamāno bhagavantaṃ venayiko'ti āha… vinayo eva venayiko. vinayaṃ vā arahatī'ti venayiko, niggahaṃ arahatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
notes: see venayika 1, 2, 4, 5

example_1: ahañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi. ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya, venayiko samaṇo gotamo'ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) bhagavā pana yasmā rāg'ādīnaṃ vinayāya vūpasamāya dhammaṃ deseti, tasmā venayiko hoti. ayam'eva c'ettha pad'attho, vinayāya dhammaṃ desetī'ti venayiko.

meaning_1: violent wind; gale-force wind; (comm) high-altitude wind
example_1: tattha yo pakkhī gacchati tam'enaṃ verambhā vātā khipanti. tassa verambhavātakkhittassa aññen'eva pādā gacchanti, aññena pakkhā gacchanti, aññena sīsaṃ gacchati, aññena kāyo gacchati.

meaning_1: thrown about by violent wind; tossed about by gale-force winds
example_1: so rāg'ānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati. tassa aññe cīvaraṃ haranti, aññe pattaṃ haranti, aññe nisīdanaṃ haranti, aññe sūcigharaṃ haranti, verambhavātakkhittass'eva sakuṇassa.
vesālī vajji nāḷandā, bhāradvāja soṇo ca ghosito, hāliddiko nakulapitā, lohicco verahaccānī'ti.

aparassa eko veriko kuddho hoti, ghātetu'kāmo naṃ vicarati, so, evaṃ me sotthi bhavissatī'ti sayam'eva liṅgaṃ gahetvā palāyati.

meaning_1: name of a layman in Āḷavī; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in supporting a group with the four bases for sustaining relationships

example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthako āḷavako.

meaning_1: fidgeting with the hands; fiddling with the hands

meaning_1: in one's possession; under one's control; secured
example_1: yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.

example_1: sac'assa hoti avisayhaṃ, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv'eva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma
commentary: (VINa) hatthavilaṅghakenā'ti hatth'ukkhepakena. (MNa) tato dve janā hatthena hatthaṃ saṃsibbantā dvīsu hatthesu ṭhapetvā upaṭṭhapenti. taṃ sandhāy'āha, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhapemā'ti.

example_1: pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
commentary: (SNa) hīn'attarūpā na pāraṃ gamā te'ti hīn'attasabhāvā te nibbānaṅgamā na honti. hīn'attharūpā'ti'pi pāṭho, hīn'atthajātikā parihīn'atthā'ti attho. (SNt) hīn'attarūpā'ti hīn'ādhimuttikatāya nihīnacittasabhāvā.

meaning_1: coarse and refined; inferior and superior

meaning_2: fact of being coarse and refined; fact of being inferior and superior

meaning_1: coarse and refined; inferior and superior
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo andho? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikareyya, tathārūpam'pi'ssa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusal'ākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajj'ānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.

meaning_1: fact of being inferior and superior; coarse and refined state

meaning_1: hard to protect; difficult to guard
example_1: phandanaṃ capalaṃ cittaṃ, durakkhaṃ dunnivārayaṃ, ujuṃ karoti medhāvī, usukāro'va tejanaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) dūrakkhan'ti kiṭṭhasambādhe ṭhāne kiṭṭhakhādakagoṇaṃ viya ek'ekasmiṃ sappāy'ārammaṇe'y'eva duṭṭhapanato dūrakkhaṃ.

meaning_1: landing where it likes; alighting wherever it wants
example_1: dunniggahassa lahuno, yatthakāmanipātino, cittassa damatho sādhu, cittaṃ dantaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) tassa dunniggahassa lahuno. yatthakāmanipātino'ti yattha katthaci'd'eva nipatanasīlassa. etañ'hi labhitabbaṭṭhānaṃ vā alabhitabbaṭṭhānaṃ vā yuttaṭṭhānaṃ vā ayuttaṭṭhānaṃ vā na jānāti, n'eva jātiṃ oloketi, na gottaṃ, na vayaṃ. yattha yattha icchati, tattha tatth'eva nipatatī'ti yatthakāmanipātī'ti vuccati.

example_1: dūraṅ'gamaṃ ekacāraṃ, asarīraṃ guh'āsayaṃ, ye cittaṃ saṃyamessanti, mokkhanti mārabandhanā.
commentary: (DHPa) uppattikāle ek'ekam'eva cittaṃ uppajjati, tasmiṃ niruddhe puna ek'ekam'eva uppajjatī'ti ekacaraṃ nāma jātaṃ.

meaning_1: who has an unstable mind; who is mentally ungrounded
example_1: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.
commentary: (DHPa) anavaṭṭhitacittassā'ti cittaṃ nām'etaṃ kassaci nibaddhaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā n'atthi. yo pana puggalo assapiṭṭhe ṭhapitakumbhaṇḍaṃ viya ca thusarāsimhi koṭṭitakhāṇuko viya ca khallāṭasīse ṭhapitakadambapupphaṃ viya ca na katthaci saṇṭhāti, kadāci buddhasāvako hoti, kadāci ājīvako, kadāci nigaṇṭho, kadāci tāpaso. evarūpo puggalo anavaṭṭhitacitto nāma. tassa anavaṭṭhitacittassa. (JAa) anavaṭṭhitacittassā'ti appatiṭṭhitacittassa.

meaning_1: whose faith fluctuates; who has wavering conviction
example_1: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.
commentary: (DHPa) saddhammaṃ avijānato'ti sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-bhedaṃ imaṃ saddhammaṃ avijānantassa parittasaddhatāya vā uplavasaddhatāya vā pariplavapasādassa kām'āvacara-rūp'āvacar'ādi-bhedā paññā na paripūrati.

meaning_1: whose mind is not oozing (with lust); who is not mentally sodden
example_1: anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) anavassutacittassā'ti rāgena atintacittassa.

meaning_1: who has abandoned good and evil; who has transcended merit and wrongdoing
example_1: anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) puññapāpapahīnassā'ti catutthamaggena pahīnapuññassa c'eva pahīnapāpassa ca khīṇ'āsavassa.

example_1: ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vijessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
pheṇ'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, marīcidhammaṃ abhisambudhāno, chetvāna mārassa papupphakāni, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche.
commentary: (DHPa) pheṇ'ūpaman'ti imaṃ kes'ādisamūhasaṅkhātaṃ kāyaṃ abaladubbal'aṭṭhena anaddhaniyatāvakālik'aṭṭhena pheṇapiṇḍasarikkhako'ti viditvā.

example_1: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandhamapoṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ sagandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, saphalā hoti kubbato.
commentary: (DHPa) sagandhakan'ti campakanīl'uppal'ādi-bhedaṃ.

example_1: appamatto ayaṃ gandho, yv'āyaṃ tagaracandanaṃ, yo ca sīlavataṃ gandho, vāti devesu uttamo.
yathā saṅkāradhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) saṅkāradhānasmin'ti saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, kacavararāsimhī'ti attho.

meaning_1: imagining wise; thinking (oneself to be) intelligent
example_1: yo bālo maññati bālyaṃ, paṇḍito vā'pi tena so, bālo ca paṇḍitamānī, sa ve bālo'ti vuccati.
commentary: (JAa) paṇḍitamānī'ti yo sayaṃ bālo hutvā ahaṃ paṇḍito'ti attānaṃ maññamāno paṇḍitānaṃ ovādaṃ akatvā sakassa cittassa vasaṃ gacchati, so sacittassa vasaṃ gantvā yath'āyaṃ dubbacaka'pi matasayanaṃ sayito, evaṃ sayethā'ti attho.

meaning_1: sweet tasting; as sweet as honey
example_1: madhuvā maññati bālo, yāva pāpaṃ na paccati, yadā ca paccati pāpaṃ, bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati.
commentary: (DHPa) madhuvā'ti bālassa hi pāpaṃ akusalakammaṃ karontassa taṃ kammaṃ madhu viya madhurarasaṃ viya iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti. iti naṃ so madhuṃ'va maññati.

meaning_1: householders and monastics; laypeople and renunciants
example_1: mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici, iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.

meaning_1: reason for material gain; cause for worldly acquisition
example_1: aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.
commentary: (DHPa) aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī'ti lābh'ūpanisā nām'esā aññā eva, aññā nibbānagāminī paṭipadā. lābh'uppādakena hi bhikkhunā thokaṃ akusalakammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, kāyavaṅk'ādīni kātabbāni honti. yasmiñ'hi kāle kāyavaṅk'ādīsu kiñci karoti, tadā lābho uppajjati. pāyasapātiyañ'hi vaṅkaṃ akatvā ujukam'eva hatthaṃ otāretvā ukkhipantassa hattho makkhitamattako'va hoti, vaṅkaṃ katvā otāretvā ukkhipantassa pana pāyasapiṇḍaṃ uddharanto'va nikkhamati, evaṃ kāyavaṅk'ādīni karaṇakāle'y'eva lābho uppajjati.

meaning_1: like Inda's column; similar to the gate post of a city
example_1: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhil'upamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.
commentary: (DHPa) so ime maṃ catūhi paccayehi sakkaronti, ime pana na sakkarontī'ti sakkārañ'ca asakkārañ'ca karontesu n'eva anurujjhati, no virujjhati, atha kho pathavisamo ca indakhil'upamo eva ca hoti.

example_1: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.

meaning_1: concerned with verses which are unbeneficial; unrelated to profitable poems
example_1: yo ca gāthā sataṃ bhāse, anatthapadasañhitaṃ, ekaṃ dhammapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
commentary: (DHPa) anatthapadasaṃhitā'ti ākāsavaṇṇanādi-vasena anatthakehi padehi saṃhitā.

meaning_1: ultimate winner in war; supreme victor in battle
example_1: yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo.
commentary: (DHPa) sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo'ti so saṅgāmajinānaṃ uttamo pavaro saṅgāmasīsayodho'ti.

meaning_1: paying respect to the elderly; honouring the seniors; venerating the venerable
example_1: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vaddh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) vuḍḍh'āpacāyino'ti gihissa vā tadahupabbajite daharasāmaṇere'pi, pabbajitassa vā pana pabbajjāya vā upasampadāya vā vuḍḍhatare guṇavuḍḍhe apacāyamānassa, abhivādanena vā niccaṃ pūjentassā'ti attho.

example_1: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, kusīto hīnavīriyo, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, vīriyam'ārabhato daḷhaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) vīriyam'ārabhato daḷhan'ti duvidha-jjhāna-nibbattana-samatthaṃ thiraṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhantassa.

meaning_1: where standing; where staying; where remaining
example_1: na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjatī so jagatippadeso, yatraṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.
commentary: (JAa) yatthaṭṭhitā'ti yasmiṃ bhūmibhāge ṭhitā.

example_1: sukhakāmāni bhūtāni, yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati, attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhaṃ.
commentary: (UDa) attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhan'ti so puggalo attano sukhaṃ esanto gavesanto patthento pecca paraloke manussasukhaṃ dibbasukhaṃ nibbānasukhanti tividham'pi sukhaṃ na labhati, añña'd'atthu tena daṇḍena dukkham'eva labhatī'ti attho.

meaning_1: will give up; will abandon; will let go (of)
example_1: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, pahassatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

meaning_1: abode of disease; nest of illness
example_1: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganiḍḍhaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) tañ'ca kho sabbarogānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena roganīḷaṃ, (ITIa) akkhirog'ādīnaṃ anekesaṃ rogānaṃ nīḷaṃ kulāvakan'ti roganīḷaṃ.

example_1: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganiḍḍhaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.

meaning_1: smeared with flesh and blood; coated with meat and blood
example_1: aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.

meaning_1: transmigration through many births; cyclical existence having multiple rebirths
example_1: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakāraṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.
commentary: (THa) anekajātisaṃsāran'ti anekajātisatasahassasaṅkhyaṃ idaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭaṃ, addhuno adhippetattā accantasaṃyogekavacanaṃ.

meaning_1: intent on one's own benefit; interested in personal welfare
example_1: atta'd'atthaṃ par'atthena, bahunā'pi na hāpaye, atta'd'attham'abhiññāya, sadatthapasuto siyā.
commentary: (DHPa) evarūpañ'hi atta'd'attham'abhiññāya ayaṃ me attano attho'ti sallakkhetvā, sadatthapasuto siyā'ti tasmiṃ sake atthe uyyuttapayutto bhaveyyā'ti.

meaning_1: like a royal carriage; like the king's coach
example_1: etha passath'imaṃ lokaṃ, cittaṃ rājarath'ūpamaṃ, yattha bālā visīdanti, n'atthi saṅgo vijānataṃ.

meaning_1: freed from the net; escaped from the snare
example_1: andhabhūto ayaṃ loko, tanuk'ettha vipassati, sakuṇo jālamutto'va, appo saggāya gacchati.
commentary: (DHPa) jālamutto'vā'ti yathā chekena sākuṇikena jālena ottharitvā gayhamānesu vaṭṭakesu koci'd'eva jālato muccati. sesā antojālam'eva pavisanti. tathā maraṇajālena otthaṭesu sattesu bahū apāyagāmino honti

meaning_1: who has overcome (concern for) the next world; who has rejected (interest in) the afterlife
example_1: ekaṃ dhammaṃ atītassa, musāvādissa jantuno, vitiṇṇaparalokassa, n'atthi pāpaṃ akāriyaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) vitiṇṇaparalokassā'ti vissaṭṭhaparalokassa. evarūpo hi manussasampattiṃ devasampattiṃ avasāne nibbānasampattin'ti imā tisso'pi sampattiyo na passati.

meaning_1: having infinite range; of boundless domain
example_1: yassa jitaṃ n'āvajīyati, jitaṃ yassa no yā'ti koci loke, taṃ buddham'anantagocaraṃ, apadaṃ kena padena nessatha.
commentary: (DHPa) anantagocaran'ti anant'ārammaṇassa sabbaññutaññāṇassa vasena apariyanta gocaraṃ.

meaning_1: purifying one's own mind; cleaning one's heart; (comm) removing the five hindrances
example_1: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā, sacittapariyodāpanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) sacittapariyodapanan'ti pañcahi nīvaraṇehi attano cittassa vodāpanaṃ. (VISMa) sakaṃ cittaṃ sacittaṃ, sacittassa sabbaso kilesānaṃ samucchindanena visodhanaṃ sacittapariyodāpanaṃ. evaṃ pana paññākicce matthakappatte uttari karaṇīyābhāvato sāsanassa paññ'uttaratā veditabbā.

example_1: na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito.
commentary: (DHPa) kahāpaṇavassenā'ti yaṃ so apphoṭetvā sattaratanavassaṃ vassāpesi, taṃ idha kahāpaṇavassan'ti vuttaṃ. tena'pi hi vatthukāmakilesakāmesu titti nāma n'atthi. evaṃ duppūrā esā taṇhā.

meaning_1: delighted with the wearing away of craving; taking pleasure in the depletion of desire
example_1: api dibbesu kāmesu, ratiṃ so n'ādhigacchati, taṇhakkhayarato hoti, sammāsambuddhasāvako.
commentary: (DHPa) taṇhakkhayarato'ti arahatte c'eva nibbāne ca abhirato hoti, taṃ patthayamāno viharati. meaning_1: who has surmounted mental proliferation; who has transcended endless conceptualization
example_1: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.
commentary: (DHPa) papañcasamatikkante'ti samatikkanta-taṇhā-diṭṭhi-māna-papañce.

example_1: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhā'disā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) khandhasamā'ti khandhehi samā. yathā parihariyamānā khandhā dukkhā, evaṃ aññaṃ dukkhaṃ nāma n'atthi.

commentary: (NIDD2) āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā'ti param'atthaṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. param'atthassa pattiyā lābhāya paṭilābhāya adhigamāya phassanāya sacchikiriyāya āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ sampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesū'ti, āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā. (SNPa) param'attho vuccati nibbānaṃ, tassa pattiyā param'atthapattiyā. etena vīriy'ārambhena pattabbaphalaṃ dasseti.

example_1: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (NIDD2) alīnacitto akusītavuttī'ti so paccekasambuddho anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya… anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya… uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahatī'ti, evaṃ alīnacitto akusītavutti. (SNPa) akusītavuttī'ti etena ṭhāna-āsana-caṅkaman'ādīsu kāyassa anavasīdanaṃ.

meaning_1: not getting disheartened; not becoming discouraged
with strong energy; with steady effort
example_1: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (NIDD2) daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti so paccekasambuddho daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu avaṭṭhitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kulejeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu adhikusalesu dhammesū'ti, daḷhanikkamo. (SNPa) daḷhanikkamo'ti etena kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru cā'ti evaṃ pavattaṃ padahanavīriyaṃ dasseti, yaṃ taṃ anupubbasikkh'ādīsu padahanto kāyena c'eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passatī'ti vuccati. atha vā etena maggasampayuttavīriyaṃ dasseti. tañ'hi daḷhañ'ca bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gatattā, nikkamo ca sabbaso paṭipakkhā nikkhantattā, tasmā taṃsamaṅgīpuggalo'pi daḷho nikkamo assā'ti daḷhanikkamo'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: continuously undertaking; persistently taking upon oneself; practicing consistently
endowed with endurance and power; having stamina and strength
example_1: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (NIDD2) thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti so paccekasambuddho thāmena ca balena ca vīriyena ca parakkamena ca paññāya ca upeto hoti samupeto upāgato samupāgato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato'ti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. (SNPa) thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti maggakkhaṇe kāyathāmena ñāṇabalena ca upapanno, atha vā thāmabhūtena balena upapanno'ti thāmabal'ūpapanno, thirañāṇabal'ūpapanno'ti vuttaṃ hoti. etena tassa vīriyassa vipassanāñāṇasampayogaṃ dīpento yoniso padahanabhāvaṃ sādheti.

meaning_1: not neglecting meditation; not forgetting jhāna
example_1: paṭisallānaṃ jhānam'ariñcamāno, dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārī, ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (NIDD2) jhānam'ariñcamāno'ti so paccekasambuddho dvīhi kāraṇehi jhānaṃ na riñcati, anuppannassa vā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyutto, anuppannassa vā dutiyassa jhānassa… anuppannassa vā tatiyassa jhānassa… anuppannassa vā catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyutto'ti, evam'pi jhānaṃ na riñcati.

commentary: (SNPa) dāṭhā balam'assa atthī'ti dāṭhabalī.

example_1: mettaṃ upekkhaṃ karuṇaṃ vimuttiṃ, āsevamāno muditañ'ca kāle, sabbena lokena avirujjhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (SNPa) āsevamāno'ti tisso tikacatukkajjhānavasena, upekkhaṃ catutthajjhānavasena bhāvayamāno.

meaning_1: for a purpose; for a reason

commentary: (NIDD2) bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā'ti att'atthakāraṇā par'atthakāraṇā ubhay'atthakāraṇā diṭṭhadhammik'atthakāraṇā samparāyik'atthakāraṇā param'atthakāraṇā bhajanti sambhajanti sevanti nisevanti saṃsevanti paṭisevantīti, bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā. (SNPa) kāraṇaṃ attho etesan'ti kāraṇ'atthā, bhajanāya sevanāya ca n'āññaṃ kāraṇam'atthi, attho eva nesaṃ kāraṇaṃ, atthahetu sevantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: self-centred; looking out only for one's own benefit; serving only oneself
meaning_lit: with self benefit wisdom; (comm) wisdom standing in oneself
example_1: bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā, nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā, att'aṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
commentary: (SNPa) attani ṭhitā etesaṃ paññā, attānaṃ'y'eva olokenti, na aññan'ti att'aṭṭhapaññā. diṭṭh'atthapaññā'ti ayam'pi kira porāṇapāṭho, sampati diṭṭhi'y'eva atthe etesaṃ paññā, āyatiṃ na pekkhantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (APAa) att'aṭṭhapaññā'ti attani ṭhitā etesaṃ paññā. attānam'eva oloketi, na aññanti attho. att'atthapaññā'ti'pi pāṭho, tassa attano attham'eva oloketi, na paratthan'ti attho. diṭṭh'atthapaññā'ti ayam'pi kira porāṇapāṭho, tassa sampati diṭṭhe'y'eva atthe etesaṃ paññā, na āyatin'ti attho.

commentary: (NIDD2) vimokkho tassa n'āparo'ti n'atthi tassa aparo vimokkho. yena vimokkhena vimucceyya vimutto so. kataṃ tassa vimokkhena karaṇīyan'ti, vimokkho tassa n'āparo. (SNPa) vimokkho tassa n'āparo'ti tassa añño vimokkho n'atthi.

meaning_1: afflicted with old age and death; overcome by aging and dying
example_1: majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ'ca me dīpam'akkhāhi, yathā'y'idaṃ n'āparaṃ siyā.
commentary: (NIDD2) jarāmaccuparetānan'ti jarāya phuṭṭhānaṃ paretānaṃ samohitānaṃ samannāgatānaṃ. maccunā phuṭṭhānaṃ paretānaṃ samohitānaṃ samannāgatānaṃ, jātiyā anugatānaṃ jarāya anusaṭānaṃ byādhinā abhibhūtānaṃ maraṇena abbhāhatānaṃ atāṇānaṃ aleṇānaṃ asaraṇānaṃ asaraṇībhūtānan'ti, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ.

(NIDD1a) asaraṇībhūtā'ti sayaṃ saraṇakiccaṃ na karontī'ti asaraṇībhūtā. (PMa) asaraṇībhūto'ti pure uppattiyā attano abhāven'eva asaraṇo, uppattisamakālam'eva asaraṇībhūto'ti attho. (MNt) asaraṇībhūtan'ti sabbakālam'pi appaṭisaraṇaṃ. (VISMa) saraṇan'ti gahetuṃ ayuttatāya asaraṇībhūtato. anassādato'ti idaṃ pāḷiyaṃ n'atthi. sati ca tecattālīsa ākārā siyuṃ. rūpappavattiyaṃ sabbādīnavūpaladdhiyā ādīnavato. samudayato atthaṅ'gamato'ti idaṃ dvayaṃ yathā aniccato dassanaṃ panāḷikāya, niccasāravirahadīpanena vā suññatāvibhāvanaṃ hoti, evaṃ suññatāvibhāvanan'ti katvā vuttaṃ.

example_1: majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ'ca me dīpam'akkhāhi, yathā'y'idaṃ n'āparaṃ siyā.

commentary: (NIDD2) jarāmaccuparikkhayan'ti jarāmaraṇassa pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānan'ti, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ.

commentary: (NIDD2) jatukaṇṇī'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa gottaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro'ti, icc'āyasmā jatukaṇṇi. (NIDD2) jatukaṇṇī'ti bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gottena ālapati.

meaning_1: who has abandoned pleasure; who has left behind delight
example_1: okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
commentary: (NIDD2) nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttan'ti nandī vuccati taṇhā. yo rāgo sārāgo… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ. sā nandī sā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. tasmā buddho nandiñ'jaho. (SNPa) nandiñ'jahan'ti anāgatarūp'ādipatthanājahaṃ. ekā eva hi taṇhā thutivasena idha nānappakārato vuttā.

meaning_1: who has abandoned mental fabrication; who has left imagination behind
example_1: okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
commentary: (NIDD2) kappā'ti dve kappā, taṇhākappo ca diṭṭhikappo ca… ayaṃ taṇhākappo… ayaṃ diṭṭhikappo. buddhassa bhagavato taṇhākappo pahīno diṭṭhikappo paṭinissaṭṭho. taṇhākappassa pahīnattā diṭṭhikappassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā tasmā buddho kappañ'jaho. (SNPa) kappañ'jahan'ti duvidhakappajahaṃ.

meaning_1: devoid of the perception of forms; without awareness of materiality
example_1: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.
commentary: (NIDD2) vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti katamā rūpasaññā? rūp'āvacarasamāpattiṃ samāpannassa vā upapannassa vā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārissa vā saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ, ayaṃ rūpasaññā. vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti catasso arūpasamāpattiyo paṭiladdhassa rūpasaññā vibhūtā honti vigatā atikkantā samatikkantā vītivattā'ti, vibhūtarūpasaññissa. (SNPa) vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti samatikkantarūpasaññissa.

meaning_1: who has abandoned the whole body; who has left the entire body behind
example_1: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

example_1: ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.

commentary: (THa) sataliṅgassā'ti līnam'atthaṃ gamentī'ti liṅgāni, atthesu saddassa pavattinimittāni, tāni pana sataṃ anekāni liṅgāni etassā'ti sataliṅgo. anek'attho hi idha satasaddo, sataṃ sahassan'ti-ādīsu viya na saṅkhyāvises'attho tassa sataliṅgassa.

example_1: sataliṅgassa atthassa, satalakkhaṇadhārino, ek'aṅgadassī dummedho, satadassī ca paṇḍito'ti.
commentary: (THa) satalakkhaṇadhārino'ti anekalakkhaṇavato. lakkhīyati etenā'ti lakkhaṇaṃ, paccayabhāvino atthassa attano phalaṃ paṭicca paccayabhāvo, tena hi so ayaṃ imassa kāraṇan'ti lakkhīyati. so ca ekass'eva atthassa anekappabhedo upalabbhati, ten'āha satalakkhaṇadhārino'ti. atha vā lakkhīyantī'ti lakkhaṇāni, tassa tassa atthassa saṅkhatat'ādayo pakāravisesā te pana atthato avatthāvisesā veditabbā.

meaning_1: seeing one hundred (aspects); understanding a hundred (angles)

commentary: (THa) van'ābhiratiyā vasena vanavaccho'ti paññāyittha. aparabhāge mahāsatte mah'ābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā mahāpadhānaṃ padahante, aham'pi siddhatthakumārena saha araññe viharissāmī'ti nikkhamitvā tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā himavante vasanto abhisambuddhabhāvaṃ sutvā bhagavato santikaṃ upagantvā pabbajitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā araññe vasamāno nacirass'eva vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahattaṃ sacchākāsi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne (THa) arahattaṃ pana patvā vivek'ābhiratiyā vane'y'eva vasi, tena vanavaccho'ti samaññā udapādi.

commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto kassapassa bhagavato sāsane mātule pabbajante tena saddhiṃ pabbajitvā bahuṃ vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde vanavacchattherassa bhāgineyyo hutvā nibbatto, sivako'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. tassa mātā attano jeṭṭhabhātike vanavacche sāsane pabbajitvā pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā araññe viharante taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā puttaṃ āha, tāta sivaka, therassa santike pabbajitvā theraṃ upaṭṭhaha, mahallako dāni thero'ti. so mātu ekavacaneneva ca pubbe kat'ādhikāratāya ca mātulattherassa santikaṃ gantvā pabbajitvā taṃ upaṭṭhahanto araññe vasati.
notes: Theragāthā verse 14 (TH1.14, TH14) is attributed to him.

notes: Theragāthā verse 39 (TH1.39, TH39) is attributed to him.

example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantānaṃ yadidaṃ sobhito.
commentary: (ANa) tassa pañhakamme ayam'anupubbikathā, ayam'pi kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatīnagare kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā vayappatto satthu dhammadesanaṃ suṇanto satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ pubbenivāsañāṇalābhīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. so yāvajīvaṃ kusalakammaṃ katvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇakule nibbatti, sobhito'ti'ssa nāmaṃ akaṃsu. (THa) satimā paññavā'ti āyasmato sobhitattherassa gāthā. kā uppatti? ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikāro tattha tattha bhave puññāni upacinanto padum'uttarassa bhagavato kāle haṃsavatīnagare kulagehe nibbattitvā vayappatto satthu dhammadesanaṃ suṇanto satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ pubbenivāsañāṇalābhīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā sayam'pi taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ uddissa patthanaṃ katvā puññāni katvā sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto sumedhassa bhagavato kāle brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā viññutaṃ patto brāhmaṇānaṃ vijjāsippesu nipphattiṃ gantvā nekkhamm'ādhimutto ghar'āvāsaṃ pahāya tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā himavantassa samīpe araññ'āyatane assamaṃ kāretvā vanamūlaphalāphalena yāpento buddh'uppādaṃ sutvā sabbattha ekarattivāsen'eva bhaddavatīnagare satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā pasannamānaso tuvaṃ satthā ca ketu cā'tiādīhi chahi gāthāhi abhitthavi, satthā c'assa bhāviniṃ sampattiṃ pakāsesi. so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇakule nibbatti. sobhito'ti'ssa nāmaṃ akaṃsu. so aparena samayena satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā chaḷabhiñño ahosi. pubbenivāsañāṇe ciṇṇavasī ca ahosi.

commentary: (THa) appahīnabhāvena santāne anu anu sentī'ti anusayā, kāmarāg'ādayo anusayā. tesaṃ jālena otthato abhibhūto'ti anusayājāla'm'otthato. makāro padasandhikaro, gāthāsukh'atthaṃ dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: accompanied by the source of craving
example_1: pañcanīvaraṇe yutto, vitakkena samappito, taṇhāmūlen'ānugato, mohacchādanachādito.
commentary: (THa) taṇhāmūlen'ānugato'ti, taṇhāsaṅkhātena bhavamūlena anubaddho.

meaning_1: veiled by delusion; shrouded in illusion
meaning_lit: covered by the covering of delusion
example_1: pañcanīvaraṇe yutto, vitakkena samappito, taṇhāmūlen'ānugato, mohacchādanachādito.
commentary: (THa) mohacchādanachādito'ti, sammohasaṅkhātena āvaraṇena paliguṇṭhito.

example_1: ev'āyaṃ vattate kāyo, kammayantena yantito, sampatti ca vipaty'antā, nānābhāvo vipajjati.
commentary: (THa) sukatadukkaṭena kammasaṅkhātena yantena yantito saṅghaṭito.

meaning_1: ending in disaster; culminating in calamity
example_1: ev'āyaṃ vattate kāyo, kammayantena yantito, sampatti ca vipaty'antā, nānābhāvo vipajjati.
commentary: (THa) sampatti ca vipaty'antā'ti yā ettha sampatti, sā vipattipariyosānā.

example_1: ye'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti, gūthalittaṃ'va pannagaṃ, bhavamūlaṃ vamitvāna, parinibbissanti'n'āsavā'ti.
commentary: (THa) ye'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti, gūthalittaṃ'va pannagan'ti yathā nāma puriso sukhakāmo jīvitu'kāmo gūthagataṃ āsīvisaṃ disvā jigucchaniyatāya vā sappaṭibhayatāya vā vivajjeti na allīyati, evam'evaṃ ye paṇḍitā kulaputtā asucibhāvena jegucchaṃ anicc'ādibhāvena sappaṭibhayaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti chandarāgappahānena pajahanti.

example_1: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc'indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjh'aṅgā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo
commentary: (DNa) cattāro sammappadhānā'ti paggah'aṭṭhena ekalakkhaṇā, kiccavasena nānākiccā. idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāyā'ti-ādinā nayena samathavipassanāmaggavasena lokiyalok'uttara-missakā'va cattāro sammappadhānā desitā. (MNa) sammappadhānā'ti maggapadhānena sammappadhānā. (SNa) yoniso sammappadhānā'ti upāyavīriyena kāraṇavīriyena. (THa) sammappadhānasampanno'ti sampanna-catubbidha-sammappadhāno, tehi kattabbakiccaṃ sampādetvā ṭhito'ti attho.

meaning_1: cleaning all the defilements; purifying all impurities
example_1: yadā sivaṃ dvecaturaṅgagāminaṃ, magg'uttamaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, paññāya passitva sato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
commentary: (THa) sabbehi kilesamalehi sattānaṃ sodhanato sabbakilesasodhanaṃ. (THa) sabbakilesasodhanan'ti anavasesakilesamalavisodhanaṃ.

meaning_1: eradicating stains, coldness and sorrow; banishing impurity, hard-heartedness and grief
example_1: yadā sukhī malakhilasokanāsano, niraggaḷo nibbanatho visallo, sabb'āsave byantikato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindatī'ti.
commentary: (THa) malakhilasokanāsano'ti rāg'ādīnaṃ malānaṃ pañcannañ'ca cetokhilānaṃ ñātiviyog'ādihetukassa sokassa ca pahāyako.

meaning_1: inhabited by wild beasts; frequented by fierce animals
example_1: vivittaṃ appanigghosaṃ, vāḷamiganisevitaṃ, seve sen'āsanaṃ bhikkhu, paṭisallānakāraṇā.
commentary: (THa) vāḷamiganisevitan'ti, sīhabyagghadīpivāḷamigehi caritaṃ. (THa) vāḷamiganisevite'ti, sīhabyagghādīhi vāḷamigehi upasevite vane.

meaning_1: purpose of privacy; reason of seclusion
example_1: vivittaṃ appanigghosaṃ, vāḷamiganisevitaṃ, seve sen'āsanaṃ bhikkhu, paṭisallānakāraṇā.
commentary: (THa) paṭisallānakāraṇā'ti, paṭisallānanimittaṃ, nān'ārammaṇato nivattetvā kammaṭṭhāne'y'eva cittassa paṭi paṭi samma'd'eva allīyan'atthaṃ.

example_1: saṅkārapuñjā āhatvā, susānā rathiyāhi ca, tato saṅghāṭikaṃ katvā, lūkhaṃ dhāreyya cīvaraṃ.
commentary: (THa) āhatvā'ti āharitvā.

example_1: saṅkārapuñjā āhitvā, susānā rathiyāhi ca, tato saṅghāṭikaṃ katvā, lūkhaṃ dhāreyya cīvaraṃ.
yathā jaḷo va mūgo va, attānaṃ dassaye tathā, n'ātivelaṃ sambhāseyya, saṅghamajjhamhi paṇḍito.
commentary: (THa) n'ātivelaṃ sambhāseyyā'ti ativelaṃ atikkantapamāṇaṃ na bhāseyya, mattabhāṇī assā'ti attho.

meaning_1: taken hold of tightly; properly grasped; held firmly
example_1: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.
example_2: pubb'āparaññū atthaññū, niruttipadakovido, suggahītañ'ca gaṇhāti, atthañ'c'opaparikkhati.
commentary: (THa) suggahītanimittassā'ti evaṃ me manasi karoto cittaṃ samāhitaṃ ahosī'ti tadākāraṃ sallakkhento suṭṭhu gahitasamādhinimitto assa. suggahītanimitto so'ti'pi pāṭho, so yogī'ti attho. (THa) suggahītañ'ca gaṇhātī'ti ten'eva kovidabhāvena atthato byañjanato ca dhammaṃ sugahitam'eva katvā gaṇhāti. (JAa) suggahītasmiṃ kaṭṭhasmin'ti mukhena suṭṭhu ḍaṃsitvā gahite daṇḍake.

meaning_1: with meditation subject properly grasped; with the theme of contemplation taken hold of tightly
example_1: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.
commentary: (THa) suggahītanimittassā'ti evaṃ me manasi karoto cittaṃ samāhitaṃ ahosī'ti tadākāraṃ sallakkhento suṭṭhu gahitasamādhinimitto assa. suggahītanimitto so'ti'pi pāṭho, so yogī'ti attho.

meaning_1: skilled in (the causes for the arising of) mental states; expert in the inclinations of the mind
example_1: suggahītanimitt'assa, cittass'uppādakovido, samaṃ anuyuñjeyya, kālena ca vipassanaṃ.
commentary: (THa) cittass'uppādakovido'ti evaṃ bhāvayato cittaṃ līnaṃ hoti, evaṃ uddhatan'ti līnassa uddhatassa ca cittassa uppattikāraṇe kusalo assa. līne hi citte dhammavicaya-vīriya-pītisambojjh'aṅgā bhāvetabbā, uddhate passaddhi-samādhi-upekkhā-sambojjh'aṅgā. satisambojjh'aṅgo pana sabbattha icchitabbo.

meaning_1: possessing energy and perseverance; endowed with effort and persistence; (or) with persistent effort
example_1: vīriyasātaccasampanno, yuttayogo sadā siyā, na ca appatvā dukkh'antaṃ, vissāsaṃ eyya paṇḍito.
commentary: (THa) satatabhāvo sātaccaṃ, vīriyassa sātaccaṃ, tena sampanno samannāgato, satatapavattavīriyo, niccapaggahitavīriyo'ti attho.

meaning_1: end of suffering; cessation of stress
example_1: vīriyasātaccasampanno, yuttayogo sadā siyā, na ca appatvā dukkh'antaṃ, vissāsaṃ eyya paṇḍito.
commentary: (THa) dukkh'antan'ti vaṭṭadukkhassa antaṃ pariyosānaṃ nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ appatvā vissāsaṃ na eyya na gaccheyya.

example_1: evaṃ viharamānassa, suddhikāmassa bhikkhuno, khīyanti āsavā sabbe, nibbutiñ'c'ādhigacchatī'ti.
commentary: (THa) suddhikāmassā'ti, ñāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ accantavisuddhiṃ nibbānaṃ arahattañ'ca icchantassa.

example_1: buddhesu sagāravatā, dhamme apaciti yathābhūtaṃ, saṅghe ca cittikāro, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
commentary: (THa) cittīkāro'ti sakkāro sammānanaṃ. etan'ti ratanattayagarukaraṇaṃ.

meaning_1: basis for success; road to power; basis for spiritual power
example_1: bhāveyya ca bojjh'aṅge, iddhipādāni indriyāni balāni, aṭṭh'aṅgamaggamariyaṃ, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1a) catunnaṃ iddhipādānan'ti ettha chandavīriyacittavīmaṃsāsu ek'eko ijjhatī'ti iddhi, samijjhati nipphajjatī'ti attho. ijjhanti vā etāya sattā iddhā vuddhā ukkaṃsagatā hontī'ti iddhi. paṭhamena atthena iddhi'y'eva pādo'ti iddhipādo, iddhikoṭṭhāso'ti attho. dutiyena atthena iddhiyā pādo'ti iddhipādo, pādo'ti patiṭṭhā adhigam'upāyo'ti attho.

meaning_1: (comm) name of a mountain; (or) name of a bird
example_1: kiṃ tav'attho vane tāta, ujjuhāno'va pāvuse, verambhā ramaṇīyā te, paviveko hi jhāyinaṃ.
commentary: (THa) ujjuhāno'va pāvuse'ti ujjuhāno kira nāma eko pabbato, so pana gahanasañchanno bahusoṇḍikandaro, tahaṃ tahaṃ sandamānasalilo, vassakāle asappāyo, tasmā ujjuhāno vā pabbato eta'r'ahi pāvusakāle tava kim'atthiyo'ti attho. keci pan'ettha ujjuhāno nāma eko sakuṇo sītaṃ na sahati, vassakāle vanagumbe nilīno acchatī'ti vadanti. tesaṃ matena ujjuhānassa viya sakuṇassa pāvusakāle ko tava attho vane'ti?

meaning_1: connected with seclusion; concerned with solitude; related to detachment
example_1: yathā abbhāni verambho, vāto nudati pāvuse, saññā me abhikiranti, vivekapaṭisaññutā.

family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: saṃkiccathero eko'va, katakicco anāsavo, ekādasanipātamhi, gāthā ekādas'eva cā'ti.
commentary: (THa) ñātakā hotu, vaḍḍhitakāle amhākaṃ ayyassa sāriputtattherassa santike taṃ pabbājessāmā'ti vatvā saṅkunā chinnakkhikoṭitāya saṃkicco'ti vadantā aparabhāge saṃkicco'ti vohariṃsu. so sattavassikakāle attano gabbhagatasseva mātu maraṇaṃ, gabbhe ca attano pavattiṃ sutvā saṃvegajāto pabbajissāmī'ti āha. ñātakā sādhu, tātā'ti dhammasenāpatissa santikaṃ netvā, bhante, imaṃ pabbājethā'ti adaṃsu. thero taṃ tacapañcakakammaṭṭhānaṃ datvā pabbājesi.
notes: Theragāthā verses 597-607 (TH11.1, TH240) are attributed to him.

example_1: sīlaṃ rakkheyya medhāvī, patthayāno tayo sukhe, pasaṃsaṃ vittilābhañ'ca, pecca sagge pamodanaṃ.
commentary: (THa) vittilābhan'ti tuṭṭhilābhaṃ. vittalābhan'ti ca paṭhan'ti, dhanalābhan'ti attho. sīlavā hi appamattatāya mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.

example_1: ādi sīlaṃ patiṭṭhā ca, kalyāṇānañ'ca mātukaṃ, pamukhaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, tasmā sīlaṃ visodhaye.
commentary: (THa) kalyāṇānañ'ca mātukan'ti samathavipassan'ādīnaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ mātubhūtaṃ, janakan'ti, attho.

example_1: idh'eva kittiṃ labhati, pecca sagge ca summano, sabbattha sumano dhīro, sīlesu susamāhito.
synonym: attamana, avighātavant, āraddhacitta, tuṭṭhi, patīta, patītarūpa, pamodavant, mudita, sammudita, sukhita, susajjita, somanassajāta

meaning_1: with little food; not having much to eat
example_1: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
commentary: (THa) ahaṃ pana sabbakālaṃ kasiravuttitāya hīno uddhanaṃ upaṭṭhapitaukkhaliko dassanayuttaṃ thevakam'pi apassiṃ yevā'ti dassento appabhojano'ti āha.

meaning_1: having food; with food to eat; regarding food
example_1: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
example_2: abhinnakaṭṭho'si anābhat'odako, ahāpit'aggī'si asiddhabhojano, na me tuvaṃ ālapasī mam'ajja, naṭṭhaṃ nu kiṃ cetasikañ'ca dukkhaṃ.
commentary: (Aa) asiddhabhojano'ti na te kiñci amhākaṃ kandamūlaṃ vā paṇṇaṃ vā seditaṃ.

example_1: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
commentary: (THa) nīcakulikā daliddā'pi keci anīcakamm'ājīvā honti, mayhaṃ pana na tathā'ti dassento āha hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsī'ti.

meaning_1: having compassion for the whole world; concerned for all the world
example_1: tato kāruṇiko satthā, sabbalok'ānukampako, ehi bhikkhū'ti maṃ āha, sā me ās'ūpasampadā.
commentary: (CPa) sabbalok'ānukampako'ti vibhāgaṃ akatvā mahākaruṇāya sabbalokaṃ anuggaṇhanako.

example_1: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ, pubbajātim'anussariṃ, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhayiṃ, rattiyā pacchime yāme, tamokhandhaṃ padālayiṃ.
commentary: (VVa) visodhayī'ti adhigacchi. adhigamo'y'eva hi tassa visodhanaṃ.

meaning_1: surrounded by the heavenly host; accompanied by the assembly of gods
example_1: tato disvāna maṃ satthā, devasaṅghapurakkhataṃ, sitaṃ pātukaritvāna, imam'atthaṃ abhāsatha.
commentary: (THa) devasaṅghapurakkhatan'ti devaggahaṇena upapattidevabhāvato brahmāno'pi gahitā.

example_1: sabbamitto sabbasakho, sabbabhūt'ānukampako, mettacittañ'ca bhāvemi, abyāpajjarato sadā.
commentary: (THa) sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ mitto, sabbe vā te mayhaṃ mittā'ti sabbamitto. mettañ'hi bhāvento sattānaṃ piyo hoti. sabbasakho'ti, etthā'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: yathā'pi bhaddo ājañño, dhure yutto dhurassaho, mathito atibhārena, saṃyugaṃ n'ātivattati.
commentary: (THa) saṃyugan'ti, attano khandhe ṭhapitaṃ yugaṃ

meaning_1: power of time; authority of time
example_1: kāle kālavasaṃ pattā, bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā, narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, te'dha socanti māṇavā.
commentary: (THa) kālavasaṃ pattā'ti lābh'ādikālassa ca vasaṃ upagatā, lābh'ādinā somanassitā alābh'ādinā ca domanassitā'ti attho.

meaning_1: power of existence and nonexistence; sway of being and non-being
example_1: kāle kālavasaṃ pattā, bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā, narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, te'dha socanti māṇavā.
commentary: (THa) bhav'ābhavavasaṃ gatā'ti bhavassa abhavassa ca vasaṃ upagatā vuddhihāniyo anuvattantā te.

meaning_1: raised or lowered; elevated or depressed; elated or downcast
example_1: ye ca dukkhe sukhasmiñ'ca, majjhe sibbinim'accagū, ṭhitā te indakhīlo'va, na te unnataonatā.
na h'eva lābhe n'ālābhe, na yase na ca kittiyā, na nindāyaṃ pasaṃsāya, na te dukkhe sukhamhi.
commentary: (THa) lābhe'ti cīvar'ādīnaṃ paccayānaṃ paṭilābhe. alābhe'ti tesaṃ'y'eva appaṭilābhe apagame.

example_1: yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ, viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo, ayaso'va seyyo viññūnaṃ, na yaso appabuddhinaṃ.
synonym: adhīra, apaṇḍita, avicakkhaṇa, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedha, dummedhī
commentary: (THa) yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ, viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo'ti yo appabuddhīnaṃ duppaññānaṃ vasena puggalassa yaso labbhati

meaning_1: praise by fools; approval of idiots
example_1: dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahā'va seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.
commentary: (THa) yañ'ce bālappasaṃsanā'ti bālehi aviddasūhi yā nāma pasaṃsanā.

example_1: dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahā'va seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.

meaning_1: suffering of solitude; discomfort of seclusion
example_1: sukhañ'ca kāmamayikaṃ, dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyaṃ, pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ.
commentary: (THa) dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyan'ti pavivekato nibbattaṃ kāyakilamathavasena pavattaṃ visamāsanupatāp'ādihetukaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ pana nirāmisavivaṭṭ'ūpanissayatāya viññūnaṃ pāsaṃsā. tena vuttaṃ pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo'ti.

meaning_1: derived from sense desire; coming from sensual pleasure
example_1: sukhañ'ca kāmamayikaṃ, dukkhañ'ca pavivekiyaṃ, pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ.

meaning_1: abandoned sense desire and anger; (or) dispelled the agitation of sense desire
example_1: kāmakopappahīnā ye, santacittā bhav'ābhave, caranti loke asitā, n'atthi tesaṃ piyāpiyaṃ.
commentary: (THa) kāmakopapahīnā'ti ariyamaggena sabbaso'va pahīnā anurodhapaṭivirodhā.

example_1: rajam'uhatañ'ca vātena, yathā megho-upasammaye, evaṃ sammanti saṅkappā, yadā paññāya passati.
commentary: (THa) rajam'uhatañ'ca vātenā'ti ca-iti nipātamattaṃ. yathā gimhānaṃ pacchime māse vātena ūhataṃ uṭṭhitaṃ rajaṃ mahāmegho vassanto upasammaye, vūpasameyya.

meaning_1: floods and the snare; deluges and the trap
example_1: oghapāso daḷhakhilo, pabbato duppadālayo, chetvā khilañ'ca pāsañ'ca, selaṃ bhetvāna dubbhidaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.
commentary: (THa) oghapāso'ti kām'ogho, bhav'ogho, diṭṭh'ogho, avijj'ogho'ti (dha. sa. 1156, vibha. 938) evaṃ vuttā cattāro oghā, antalikkhacaro pāso, yv'āyaṃ carati mānaso'ti (mahāva. 33, saṃ. ni. 1.151) evaṃ vutto rāgapāso ca.

example_1: oghapāso daḷhakhilo, pabbato duppadālayo, chetvā khilañ'ca pāsañ'ca, selaṃ bhetvāna dubbhidaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.
commentary: (THa) daḷhakhilo'ti satthari kaṅkhati, dhamme kaṅkhati, saṅghe kaṅkhati, sikkhāya kaṅkhati, sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto'ti (ma. ni. 1.185, a. ni. 5.205) evaṃ vutto daḷho thiro pañcavidho cetokhilo ca.

meaning_1: continuity of conditions; succession of conditioned states
example_1: suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.
commentary: (THa) saṅkhārasantatin'ti kilesa-kammavipāka-ppabheda-saṅkhāra-pabandhaṃ. (NIDD2a) suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatin'ti suddhaṃ passantassa jānantassa saṅkhārānaṃ santatiṃ abbocchinnasaṅkhārasantatiṃ.

example_1: daharā tvaṃ rūpavatī, aham'pi daharo yuvā, pañc'aṅgikena turiyena, ehi kheme ramāmase.

commentary: (THIa) khemā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi, suvaṇṇavaṇṇā kañcanasannibhattacā. sā vayappattā bimbisārarañño gehaṃ gatā. satthari veḷuvane viharante rūpamattā hutvā rūpe dosaṃ dassetī'ti satthu dassanāya na gacchati.

commentary: (THIa) tato paṭṭhāya sā kuṇḍalakesā'ti nāma jātā. sā tattha uggahetabbaṃ samayaṃ vādamaggañ'ca uggahetvā ettakaṃ nāma ime jānanti, ito uttari viseso n'atthī'ti ñatvā tato apakkamitvā yattha yattha paṇḍitā atthi, tattha tattha gantvā tesaṃ jānanasippaṃ uggahetvā attanā saddhiṃ kathetuṃ samatthaṃ adisvā yaṃ yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisati, tassa dvāre vālukārāsiṃ katvā tattha jambusākhaṃ ṭhapetvā yo mama vādaṃ āropetuṃ sakkoti, so imaṃ sākhaṃ maddatū'ti samīpe ṭhitadārakānaṃ saññaṃ datvā vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati. satt'āham'pi jambusākhāya tath'eva ṭhitāya taṃ gahetvā pakkamati.

commentary: (THIa) sā tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsarantī imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālakule nibbatti, muttā'tissā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā upanissayasampannatāya vīsativassakāle mahāpajāpatigotamiyā santike pabbajitvā sikkhamānāva hutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpetvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karoti. sā ekadivasaṃ bhattakiccaṃ katvā piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā therīnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ vattaṃ dassetvā divāṭṭhānaṃ gantvā raho nisinnā vipassanāya manasikāraṃ ārabhi. satthā surabhigandhakuṭiyā nisinno'va obhāsaṃ vissajjetvā tassā purato nisinno viya attānaṃ dassetvā mutte muccassu yogehī'ti imaṃ gātham'āha.
notes: Therīgāthā verse 2 (TH1.2, TH2) is attributed to her.

family_set: names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: itthaṃ sudaṃ puṇṇā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
commentary: (THIa) mānopanissayavasena kammassa katattā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde anāthapiṇḍikassa seṭṭhino gharadāsiyā kucchimhi nibbatti, puṇṇā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā sīhanādasutt'antadesanāya (ma. ni. 1.146 ādayo) sot'āpannā hutvā pacchā udakasuddhikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dametvā seṭṭhinā sambhāvitā hutvā tena bhujissabhāvaṃ pāpitā taṃ pabbajjaṃ anujānāpetvā pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karontī na cirass'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne.

family_set: names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: vipulaṃ annañ'ca pānañ'ca, samaṇānaṃ pavecchasi, rohinī dāni pucchāmi, kena te samaṇā piyā.
example_2: itthaṃ sudaṃ rohinī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
commentary: (THIa) sā tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsarantī anukkamena upacitavimokkhasambhārā hutvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde vesāliyaṃ mahāvibhavassa brāhmaṇassa gehe nibbattitvā rohinī'ti laddhanāmā viññutaṃ patvā, satthari vesāliyaṃ viharante vihāraṃ gantavā dhammaṃ sutvā sot'āpannā hutvā mātāpitūnaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā sāsane pasādaṃ uppādetvā te anujānāpetvā sayaṃ pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karontī na cirass'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. (THIa) rohinī dāni pucchāmī'ti, amma rohini, taṃ ahaṃ idāni pucchāmī'ti brāhmaṇo attano dhītaraṃ pucchanto āha.

family_set: names of arahants; names of nuns

notes: Therīgāthā verses 37-38 (TH2.10, TH28) are attributed to her.

family_set: names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: itthaṃ sudaṃ aparā sāmā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
